sections.label: Invocation
sections.name: उमा राम गुन गूढ़ पंडित मुनि पावहिं बिरति

verses.sa:
मूलं धर्मतरोर्विवेकजलधेः पूर्णेन्दुमानन्ददं ।
वैराग्याम्बुजभास्करं ह्यघघनध्वान्तापहं तापहम् ।
मोहाम्भोधरपूगपाटनविधौ स्वःसम्भवं शङ्करं ।
वन्दे ब्रह्मकुलं कलंकशमनं श्रीरामभूपप्रियम् ॥
verses.tr:
mūlaṃ dharmatarorvivekajaladheḥ pūrṇendumānandadaṃ
vairāgyāmbujabhāskaraṃ hyaghaghanadhvāntāpahaṃ tāpaham
mohāmbhodharapūgapāṭanavidhau svaḥsambhavaṃ śaṅkaraṃ
vande brahmakulaṃ kalaṃkaśamanaṃ śrīrāmabhūpapriyam
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
सान्द्रानन्दपयोदसौभगतनुं पीताम्बरं सुन्दरं ।
पाणौ बाणशरासनं कटिलसत्तूणीरभारं वरम् ।
राजीवायतलोचनं धृतजटाजूटेन संशोभितं ।
सीतालक्ष्मणसंयुतं पथिगतं रामाभिरामं भजे ॥
verses.tr:
sāndrānandapayodasaubhagatanuṃ pītāmbaraṃ sundaraṃ
pāṇau bāṇaśarāsanaṃ kaṭilasattūṇīrabhāraṃ varam
rājīvāyatalocanaṃ dhṛtajaṭājūṭena saṃśobhitaṃ
sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutaṃ pathigataṃ rāmābhirāmaṃ bhaje

verses.sa:
उमा राम गुन गूढ़ पंडित मुनि पावहिं बिरति ।
पावहिं मोह बिमूढ़ जे हरि बिमुख न धर्म रति ॥
verses.tr:
umā rām gun gūr̤h paṃḍit muni pāvahiṃ birati
pāvahiṃ moh bimūr̤h je hari bimukh na dharm rati
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I reverence the Br&imanic race; the very root of the tree of piety; the full moon of the sea of intelligence; the joygiver; the sun of the lotus of asceticism; the destroyer of sin; the dispeller of darkness; the healer of distress; the most auspicious conjunction in the high heaven of wisdom, which scatters the thick clouds of delusion; the sin cleansing; the beloved of king Rama.

I worship him, whose body resembles a cloud teeming with abundant delights; the yellow-apparelled; the benuti-. ful: the hero with bow and arrows in hand and well-fitted quiver gleaming by his side; with the large lotus eyes; the long tresses of whose hair are bound into a knot on his head, all glorious to behold; the way-farer accompanied by Sita and Lakshman, the charmer of charmers.
O Uma, the saints, who are learned in Rama’s mysterious qualities, enjoy peace of mind; but fools, we are Hari’s enemies and have no love for religion, reap only delusion,

sections.label: Doha 1
sections.name: अति कृपाल रघुनायक सदा दीन पर नेह

verses.sa:
पुर नर भरत प्रीति मैं गाई ।
मति अनुरूप अनूप सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
pur nar bharat prīti maiṃ gāī
mati anurūp anūp suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अब प्रभु चरित सुनहु अति पावन ।
करत जे बन सुर नर मुनि भावन ॥
verses.tr:
ab prabhu carit sunahu ati pāvan
karat je ban sur nar muni bhāvan

verses.sa:
एक बार चुनि कुसुम सुहाए ।
निज कर भूषन राम बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār cuni kusum suhāe
nij kar bhūṣan rām banāe

verses.sa:
सीतहि पहिराए प्रभु सादर ।
बैठे फटिक सिला पर सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
sītahi pahirāe prabhu sādar
baiṭhe phaṭik silā par suṃdar

verses.sa:
सुरपति सुत धरि बायस बेषा ।
सठ चाहत रघुपति बल देखा ॥
verses.tr:
surapati sut dhari bāyas beṣā
saṭh cāhat raghupati bal dekhā

verses.sa:
जिमि पिपीलिका सागर थाहा ।
महा मंदमति पावन चाहा ॥
verses.tr:
jimi pipīlikā sāgar thāhā
mahā maṃdamati pāvan cāhā

verses.sa:
सीता चरन चौंच हति भागा ।
मूढ़ मंदमति कारन कागा ॥
verses.tr:
sītā caran cauṃc hati bhāgā
mūr̤h maṃdamati kāran kāgā

verses.sa:
चला रुधिर रघुनायक जाना ।
सींक धनुष सायक संधाना ॥
verses.tr:
calā rudhir raghunāyak jānā
sīṃk dhanuṣ sāyak saṃdhānā

verses.sa:
अति कृपाल रघुनायक सदा दीन पर नेह ।
ता सन आइ कीन्ह छलु मूरख अवगुन गेह ॥
verses.tr:
ati kṛpāl raghunāyak sadā dīn par neh
tā san āi kīnh chalu mūrakh avagun geh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: { have sung to the best of my ability the incomparable and charming affection shown by the citizens and Bharat: hearken now to the all-holy acts of the Lord, that he wrought in the forest, to the delight of gods, men and saints. Onceupon a time Rama picked some lovely flowers and with his own hands made a wreath, with which he reverently decked Sita. As she sat in her glory on the crystal rock, the son of the king of the gods, took the form of a crow and wickedly thought to make trial of Rama’s might, like an ant so imbecile of mind as to attempt to sound the depths of ocean. With its beak it bit Sita in the foot and flew away, the foolish crow, in its utter stupidity. The blood flowed; Raghundyak saw it and made ready his bow and arrow, fashioned merely of reeds.
The All-merciful Rama, ever full of compassion for the poor, even he it was upon whom the wicked wretch came and played this trick.

sections.label: Doha 2
sections.name: कीन्ह मोह बस द्रोह जद्यपि तेहि कर बध उचित

verses.sa:
प्रेरित मंत्र ब्रह्मसर धावा ।
चला भाजि बायस भय पावा ॥
verses.tr:
prerit maṃtr brahmasar dhāvā
calā bhāji bāyas bhaya pāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धरि निज रुप गयउ पितु पाहीं ।
राम बिमुख राखा तेहि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dhari nij rup gayau pitu pāhīṃ
rām bimukh rākhā tehi nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भा निरास उपजी मन त्रासा ।
जथा चक्र भय रिषि दुर्बासा ॥
verses.tr:
bhā nirās upajī man trāsā
jathā cakr bhaya riṣi durbāsā

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मधाम सिवपुर सब लोका ।
फिरा श्रमित ब्याकुल भय सोका ॥
verses.tr:
brahmadhām sivapur sab lokā
phirā śramit byākul bhaya sokā

verses.sa:
काहूँ बैठन कहा न ओही ।
राखि को सकइ राम कर द्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
kāhūm̐ baiṭhan kahā na ohī
rākhi ko sakai rām kar drohī

verses.sa:
मातु मृत्यु पितु समन समाना ।
सुधा होइ बिष सुनु हरिजाना ॥
verses.tr:
mātu mṛtyu pitu saman samānā
sudhā hoi biṣ sunu harijānā

verses.sa:
मित्र करइ सत रिपु कै करनी ।
ता कहँ बिबुधनदी बैतरनी ॥
verses.tr:
mitr karai sat ripu kai karanī
tā kaham̐ bibudhanadī baitaranī

verses.sa:
सब जगु ताहि अनलहु ते ताता ।
जो रघुबीर बिमुख सुनु भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
sab jagu tāhi analahu te tātā
jo raghubīr bimukh sunu bhrātā

verses.sa:
नारद देखा बिकल जयंता ।
लागि दया कोमल चित संता ॥
verses.tr:
nārad dekhā bikal jayaṃtā
lāgi dayā komal cit saṃtā

verses.sa:
पठवा तुरत राम पहिं ताही ।
कहेसि पुकारि प्रनत हित पाही ॥
verses.tr:
paṭhavā turat rām pahiṃ tāhī
kahesi pukāri pranat hit pāhī

verses.sa:
आतुर सभय गहेसि पद जाई ।
त्राहि त्राहि दयाल रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
ātur sabhaya gahesi pad jāī
trāhi trāhi dayāl raghurāī

verses.sa:
अतुलित बल अतुलित प्रभुताई ।
मैं मतिमंद जानि नहिं पाई ॥
verses.tr:
atulit bal atulit prabhutāī
maiṃ matimaṃd jāni nahiṃ pāī

verses.sa:
निज कृत कर्म जनित फल पायउँ ।
अब प्रभु पाहि सरन तकि आयउँ ॥
verses.tr:
nij kṛt karm janit phal pāyaum̐
ab prabhu pāhi saran taki āyaum̐

verses.sa:
सुनि कृपाल अति आरत बानी ।
एकनयन करि तजा भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni kṛpāl ati ārat bānī
ekanayan kari tajā bhavānī

verses.sa:
कीन्ह मोह बस द्रोह जद्यपि तेहि कर बध उचित ।
प्रभु छाड़ेउ करि छोह को कृपाल रघुबीर सम ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh moh bas droh jadyapi tehi kar badh ucit
prabhu chār̤eu kari choh ko kṛpāl raghubīr sam
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The divine arrow, winged with a charm, sped forth; the crow in terror took to flight and assuming his proper form went to his father, who would not shelter him, as he was Rama's enemy. He was io despair, and as panicstricken ' in soul as was the Rishi DurvAsas by the terror of Vishnu's discus, Weary and worn with fear and remorse, he traversed the realm of Brahma, the city of Siva and every other sphere; bat no one even asked him to sit down; who can befriend an enemy of Rama’s Hearken Garar:his own mother becomes his death; his father is changed as it were into the king of the infernal) regions; ambrosia turns to poison; a friend does him all the harm of a hundred enemies; the Ganges is converted into the Vaitarani’, and all the world burns hotter than fire—mark me, brother—when a man opposes Rama. When Narad saw Jayanta’s distress, being tender-hearted and good, he took pity on him and sent him straight to Rama. There he cried * Save me, O thou that art the suppliant’s friend ° In terror and confusion he went and clasped his feet, crying “Quarter, quarter, O merciful Raghurdi Thy might is immeasurable, and immeasurable thy majesty; in ignorance of mind, I knew thee not. I have reaped the fruit of my own actions; now my Lord, succour me, for to thee I have come for refuge.” When the Merciful heard this most piteous appeal, he dismissed him Bhavani, with the Loss of one eye. Sorathd 2,
Although im his infatuation be had committed such an offence that death was his due, the Lord had compassion upon him and set him free; who is so merciful as Raghubir?

sections.label: Doha 3
sections.name: प्रभु आसन आसीन भरि लोचन सोभा निरखि

verses.sa:
रघुपति चित्रकूट बसि नाना ।
चरित किए श्रुति सुधा समाना ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati citrakūṭ basi nānā
carit kie śruti sudhā samānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बहुरि राम अस मन अनुमाना ।
होइहि भीर सबहिं मोहि जाना ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri rām as man anumānā
hoihi bhīr sabahiṃ mohi jānā

verses.sa:
सकल मुनिन्ह सन बिदा कराई ।
सीता सहित चले द्वौ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
sakal muninh san bidā karāī
sītā sahit cale dvau bhāī

verses.sa:
अत्रि के आश्रम जब प्रभु गयऊ ।
सुनत महामुनि हरषित भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
atri ke āśram jab prabhu gayaū
sunat mahāmuni haraṣit bhayaū

verses.sa:
पुलकित गात अत्रि उठि धाए ।
देखि रामु आतुर चलि आए ॥
verses.tr:
pulakit gāt atri uṭhi dhāe
dekhi rāmu ātur cali āe

verses.sa:
करत दंडवत मुनि उर लाए ।
प्रेम बारि द्वौ जन अन्हवाए ॥
verses.tr:
karat daṃḍavat muni ur lāe
prem bāri dvau jan anhavāe

verses.sa:
देखि राम छबि नयन जुड़ाने ।
सादर निज आश्रम तब आने ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām chabi nayan jur̤āne
sādar nij āśram tab āne

verses.sa:
करि पूजा कहि बचन सुहाए ।
दिए मूल फल प्रभु मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā kahi bacan suhāe
die mūl phal prabhu man bhāe

verses.sa:
प्रभु आसन आसीन भरि लोचन सोभा निरखि ।
मुनिबर परम प्रबीन जोरि पानि अस्तुति करत ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu āsan āsīn bhari locan sobhā nirakhi
munibar param prabīn jori pāni astuti karat
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama stayed on at Chitra-kut and performed many acts that were like the scriptures or ambrosia for excellence.

At last, he thought to himself—‘ There will be a crowd here, now that every one knows of me.’ So the two brothers with Sita took leave of all the saints and went on their way. When the Lord drew near to Atri’s hermitage, the holy man was rejoiced at the news, and quivering in every limb he sprang up and ran to meet him. On seeing him. Rama advanced hurriedly and was falling to the ground before him, but the saint took him to his bosom. Both wept tears of affection. At the sight of Rama’s beauty, his eyes were gladdened and he reverently conducted him to his cell, where doing him every honour he addressed him in gracious terms and offered him roots and fruits such as his soul relished.
As the Lord took his seat, the great saint supremely wise, gazed with streaming eyes upon his beauty, and joining his hands in supplication he thus hymned his praise:—

sections.label: Doha 4
sections.name: बिनती करि मुनि नाइ सिरु कह कर जोरि बहोरि

verses.sa: नमामि भक्त वत्सलं। कृपालु शील कोमलं ॥
verses.tr: namāmi bhakt vatsalaṃ kṛpālu śīl komalaṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: भजामि ते पदांबुजं। अकामिनां स्वधामदं ॥
verses.tr: bhajāmi te padāṃbujaṃ akāmināṃ svadhāmadaṃ

verses.sa: निकाम श्याम सुंदरं। भवाम्बुनाथ मंदरं ॥
verses.tr: nikām śyām suṃdaraṃ bhavāmbunāth maṃdaraṃ

verses.sa: प्रफुल्ल कंज लोचनं। मदादि दोष मोचनं ॥
verses.tr: praphull kaṃj locanaṃ madādi doṣ mocanaṃ

verses.sa: प्रलंब बाहु विक्रमं। प्रभोऽप्रमेय वैभवं ॥
verses.tr: pralaṃb bāhu vikramaṃ prabho'prameya vaibhavaṃ

verses.sa: निषंग चाप सायकं। धरं त्रिलोक नायकं ॥
verses.tr: niṣaṃg cāp sāyakaṃ dharaṃ trilok nāyakaṃ

verses.sa: दिनेश वंश मंडनं। महेश चाप खंडनं ॥
verses.tr: dineś vaṃś maṃḍanaṃ maheś cāp khaṃḍanaṃ

verses.sa: मुनींद्र संत रंजनं। सुरारि वृंद भंजनं ॥
verses.tr: munīṃdr saṃt raṃjanaṃ surāri vṛṃd bhaṃjanaṃ

verses.sa: मनोज वैरि वंदितं। अजादि देव सेवितं ॥
verses.tr: manoj vairi vaṃditaṃ ajādi dev sevitaṃ

verses.sa: विशुद्ध बोध विग्रहं। समस्त दूषणापहं ॥
verses.tr: viśuddh bodh vigrahaṃ samast dūṣaṇāpahaṃ

verses.sa: नमामि इंदिरा पतिं। सुखाकरं सतां गतिं ॥
verses.tr: namāmi iṃdirā patiṃ sukhākaraṃ satāṃ gatiṃ

verses.sa: भजे सशक्ति सानुजं। शची पतिं प्रियानुजं ॥
verses.tr: bhaje saśakti sānujaṃ śacī patiṃ priyānujaṃ

verses.sa: त्वदंघ्रि मूल ये नराः। भजंति हीन मत्सरा ॥
verses.tr: tvadaṃghri mūl ye narāḥ bhajaṃti hīn matsarā

verses.sa: पतंति नो भवार्णवे। वितर्क वीचि संकुले ॥
verses.tr: pataṃti no bhavārṇave vitark vīci saṃkule

verses.sa: विविक्त वासिनः सदा। भजंति मुक्तये मुदा ॥
verses.tr: vivikt vāsinaḥ sadā bhajaṃti muktaye mudā

verses.sa: निरस्य इंद्रियादिकं। प्रयांति ते गतिं स्वकं ॥
verses.tr: nirasya iṃdriyādikaṃ prayāṃti te gatiṃ svakaṃ

verses.sa: तमेकमभ्दुतं प्रभुं। निरीहमीश्वरं विभुं ॥
verses.tr: tamekamabhdutaṃ prabhuṃ nirīhamīśvaraṃ vibhuṃ

verses.sa: जगद्गुरुं च शाश्वतं। तुरीयमेव केवलं ॥
verses.tr: jagadguruṃ ca śāśvataṃ turīyamev kevalaṃ

verses.sa: भजामि भाव वल्लभं। कुयोगिनां सुदुर्लभं ॥
verses.tr: bhajāmi bhāv vallabhaṃ kuyogināṃ sudurlabhaṃ

verses.sa: स्वभक्त कल्प पादपं। समं सुसेव्यमन्वहं ॥
verses.tr: svabhakt kalp pādapaṃ samaṃ susevyamanvahaṃ

verses.sa: अनूप रूप भूपतिं। नतोऽहमुर्विजा पतिं ॥
verses.tr: anūp rūp bhūpatiṃ nato'hamurvijā patiṃ

verses.sa: प्रसीद मे नमामि ते। पदाब्ज भक्ति देहि मे ॥
verses.tr: prasīd me namāmi te padābj bhakti dehi me

verses.sa: पठंति ये स्तवं इदं। नरादरेण ते पदं ॥
verses.tr: paṭhaṃti ye stavaṃ idaṃ narādareṇ te padaṃ

verses.sa: व्रजंति नात्र संशयं। त्वदीय भक्ति संयुता ॥
verses.tr: vrajaṃti nātr saṃśayaṃ tvadīya bhakti saṃyutā

verses.sa:
बिनती करि मुनि नाइ सिरु कह कर जोरि बहोरि ।
चरन सरोरुह नाथ जनि कबहुँ तजै मति मोरि ॥
verses.tr:
binatī kari muni nāi siru kah kar jori bahori
caran saroruh nāth jani kabahum̐ tajai mati mori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘T reverence thee, the lover of the devout; the merciful, the tender-hearted; I worship thy lotus feet, which bestow upon the unsensual thine own abode in heaven. 1 adore thee, the wondrously dark and beautiful; the mount Mandar to churn the ocean of existence; with eyes like the full blown lotas; the dispeller of pride and every other vice; the long-armed hero of immeasurable power and glory; the mighty Lord of the three spheres, equipped with quiver and bow and arrows; the ornament of the Solar race; the breaker of Siva’s bow; the delight of the greatest sages and saints; the destroyer of all the enemies of the gods; the adored of Kamadev’s foe (i. e., of Siva); the reverenced of Brahma and the other divinities; the home; of enlightened intelligence; the dispeller ef all error; Lakshmi’s lord; the mine of felicity; the salvation of the saints. I worship thee with thy spouse and thy brother, thyself the beloved younger brother of Sachi’s lord.' Men, who unselfishly worship thy holy feet, sink not in the ocean of existence, tost with the billows of controversy. They who in the hope of salvation, with subdued passions, ever

delightedly worship thee, having discarded every object of sense, are advanced to thy own sphere in heaven. I worship thee, the one, the mysterious Lord, the unchangeable and omnipresent power, the eternal governor of the world, the one absolute and universal spirit; the joy of all men day after day. I reverently adore thee, the king of incomparable beauty, the lord of the earth-born Sita; be gracious to me and grant me devotion to thy lotus feet.” They who reverently repeat this hymn, full of faith in thee, will undoubtedly attain to thy heaven.
Again with bowed head and folded hands the saint made supplication and cried,‘ Never, O Lord, may my soul abandon thy lotus feet.

sections.label: Doha 5
sections.name: सहज अपावनि नारि पति सेवत सुभ गति लहइ

verses.sa:
अनुसुइया के पद गहि सीता ।
मिली बहोरि सुसील बिनीता ॥
verses.tr:
anusuiyā ke pad gahi sītā
milī bahori susīl binītā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रिषिपतिनी मन सुख अधिकाई ।
आसिष देइ निकट बैठाई ॥
verses.tr:
riṣipatinī man sukh adhikāī
āsiṣ dei nikaṭ baiṭhāī

verses.sa:
दिब्य बसन भूषन पहिराए ।
जे नित नूतन अमल सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
dibya basan bhūṣan pahirāe
je nit nūtan amal suhāe

verses.sa:
कह रिषिबधू सरस मृदु बानी ।
नारिधर्म कछु ब्याज बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
kah riṣibadhū saras mṛdu bānī
nāridharm kachu byāj bakhānī

verses.sa:
मातु पिता भ्राता हितकारी ।
मितप्रद सब सुनु राजकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
mātu pitā bhrātā hitakārī
mitaprad sab sunu rājakumārī

verses.sa:
अमित दानि भर्ता बयदेही ।
अधम सो नारि जो सेव न तेही ॥
verses.tr:
amit dāni bhartā bayadehī
adham so nāri jo sev na tehī

verses.sa:
धीरज धर्म मित्र अरु नारी ।
आपद काल परिखिअहिं चारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhīraj dharm mitr aru nārī
āpad kāl parikhiahiṃ cārī

verses.sa:
बृद्ध रोगबस जड़ धनहीना ।
अधं बधिर क्रोधी अति दीना ॥
verses.tr:
bṛddh rogabas jar̤ dhanahīnā
adhaṃ badhir krodhī ati dīnā

verses.sa:
ऐसेहु पति कर किएँ अपमाना ।
नारि पाव जमपुर दुख नाना ॥
verses.tr:
aisehu pati kar kiem̐ apamānā
nāri pāv jamapur dukh nānā

verses.sa:
एकइ धर्म एक ब्रत नेमा ।
कायँ बचन मन पति पद प्रेमा ॥
verses.tr:
ekai dharm ek brat nemā
kāyam̐ bacan man pati pad premā

verses.sa:
जग पति ब्रता चारि बिधि अहहिं ।
बेद पुरान संत सब कहहिं ॥
verses.tr:
jag pati bratā cāri bidhi ahahiṃ
bed purān saṃt sab kahahiṃ

verses.sa:
उत्तम के अस बस मन माहीं ।
सपनेहुँ आन पुरुष जग नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
uttam ke as bas man māhīṃ
sapanehum̐ ān puruṣ jag nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मध्यम परपति देखइ कैसें ।
भ्राता पिता पुत्र निज जैंसें ॥
verses.tr:
madhyam parapati dekhai kaiseṃ
bhrātā pitā putr nij jaiṃseṃ

verses.sa:
धर्म बिचारि समुझि कुल रहई ।
सो निकिष्ट त्रिय श्रुति अस कहई ॥
verses.tr:
dharm bicāri samujhi kul rahaī
so nikiṣṭ triya śruti as kahaī

verses.sa:
बिनु अवसर भय तें रह जोई ।
जानेहु अधम नारि जग सोई ॥
verses.tr:
binu avasar bhaya teṃ rah joī
jānehu adham nāri jag soī

verses.sa:
पति बंचक परपति रति करई ।
रौरव नरक कल्प सत परई ॥
verses.tr:
pati baṃcak parapati rati karaī
raurav narak kalp sat paraī

verses.sa:
छन सुख लागि जनम सत कोटि ।
दुख न समुझ तेहि सम को खोटी ॥
verses.tr:
chan sukh lāgi janam sat koṭi
dukh na samujh tehi sam ko khoṭī

verses.sa:
बिनु श्रम नारि परम गति लहई ।
पतिब्रत धर्म छाड़ि छल गहई ॥
verses.tr:
binu śram nāri param gati lahaī
patibrat dharm chār̤i chal gahaī

verses.sa:
पति प्रतिकुल जनम जहँ जाई ।
बिधवा होई पाई तरुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
pati pratikul janam jaham̐ jāī
bidhavā hoī pāī tarunāī

verses.sa:
सहज अपावनि नारि पति सेवत सुभ गति लहइ ।
जसु गावत श्रुति चारि अजहु तुलसिका हरिहि प्रिय ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj apāvani nāri pati sevat subh gati lahai
jasu gāvat śruti cāri ajahu tulasikā harihi priya
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सुनु सीता तव नाम सुमिर नारि पतिब्रत करहि ।
तोहि प्रानप्रिय राम कहिउँ कथा संसार हित ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sītā tav nām sumir nāri patibrat karahi
tohi prānapriya rām kahium̐ kathā saṃsār hit

trans: The amiable and modest Sita clasped Agastya by the feet.with frequent embraces. The soul of the Rishi’s wife was filled with joy; she gave her her blessing and seated her by her side. Then arrayed her in heavenly robes and jewels which remained ever bright and beautiful. In simple and affectionate phrase the saintly dame spoke and instructed her in matters of wifely duty. ‘Hearken, royal lady; mother, father, brethren and friends are all good in a limited degree; but a husband, Vaidehi, is an unlimited blessing; and vile is the woman who worships him not. Courage, virtue, a friend and a woman are four things that are tried in time of adversity. Though her lord be old diseased, important and poor, blind, deaf, passionate and utterly vile, yet even so the wife who treats him with disrespect shall suffer many torments in hell. Her one duty, her one fast and penance consist in a devotion of body,

. word and thought to her husband’s feet. There are four kinds of faithful wife in the world, as the Vedas, Puranas and saints all] say. The best is so firmly settled in mind that she could not even dream of there being any other man living: the next regards another's husband as her own brother or father, or son; she whois restrained by thought of duty and consideration for her family is said in the scriptures to be a woman of low character; but reckon her the very lowest of all, who is restrained only by fear and want of opportanity.. She who deceives her husband and. Carries on an intrigue, with another man shall be cast for a hundred ages into the hell called the terrible. Who such a wretch as she, who for a moment’s pleasure considers not the torment that shall endure through a hundred million. the torment that shall endure through a bandred million lives? Without any difficulty a woman attains to salvation, if only without guile she adhere to her duty asa faithful wife; while she, who lives to despite her spouse becomes a widow while still a girl.

An utterly wicked woman who is faithful to her husband has a happy fate when she dies; so sing the four Vedas and so too in these days sings Hari’s poor friend, Tulsi. Hearken, Sita; a woman will be kept faithful, if she invoke your name; for you love Rama like your own life; these words that I say are for the good of the world.”

sections.label: Doha 6
sections.name: कलिमल समन दमन मन राम सुजस सुखमूल

verses.sa:
सुनि जानकीं परम सुखु पावा ।
सादर तासु चरन सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
suni jānakīṃ param sukhu pāvā
sādar tāsu caran siru nāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब मुनि सन कह कृपानिधाना ।
आयसु होइ जाउँ बन आना ॥
verses.tr:
tab muni san kah kṛpānidhānā
āyasu hoi jāum̐ ban ānā

verses.sa:
संतत मो पर कृपा करेहू ।
सेवक जानि तजेहु जनि नेहू ॥
verses.tr:
saṃtat mo par kṛpā karehū
sevak jāni tajehu jani nehū

verses.sa:
धर्म धुरंधर प्रभु कै बानी ।
सुनि सप्रेम बोले मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
dharm dhuraṃdhar prabhu kai bānī
suni saprem bole muni gyānī

verses.sa:
जासु कृपा अज सिव सनकादी ।
चहत सकल परमारथ बादी ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu kṛpā aj siv sanakādī
cahat sakal paramārath bādī

verses.sa:
ते तुम्ह राम अकाम पिआरे ।
दीन बंधु मृदु बचन उचारे ॥
verses.tr:
te tumh rām akām piāre
dīn baṃdhu mṛdu bacan ucāre

verses.sa:
अब जानी मैं श्री चतुराई ।
भजी तुम्हहि सब देव बिहाई ॥
verses.tr:
ab jānī maiṃ śrī caturāī
bhajī tumhahi sab dev bihāī

verses.sa:
जेहि समान अतिसय नहिं कोई ।
ता कर सील कस न अस होई ॥
verses.tr:
jehi samān atisaya nahiṃ koī
tā kar sīl kas na as hoī

verses.sa:
केहि बिधि कहौं जाहु अब स्वामी ।
कहहु नाथ तुम्ह अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
kehi bidhi kahauṃ jāhu ab svāmī
kahahu nāth tumh aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
अस कहि प्रभु बिलोकि मुनि धीरा ।
लोचन जल बह पुलक सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi prabhu biloki muni dhīrā
locan jal bah pulak sarīrā

verses.sa:
तन पुलक निर्भर प्रेम पुरन नयन मुख पंकज दिए ।
मन ग्यान गुन गोतीत प्रभु मैं दीख जप तप का किए ॥
verses.tr:
tan pulak nirbhar prem puran nayan mukh paṃkaj die
man gyān gun gotīt prabhu maiṃ dīkh jap tap kā kie
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जप जोग धर्म समूह तें नर भगति अनुपम पावई ।
रधुबीर चरित पुनीत निसि दिन दास तुलसी गावई ॥
verses.tr:
jap jog dharm samūh teṃ nar bhagati anupam pāvaī
radhubīr carit punīt nisi din dās tulasī gāvaī

verses.sa:
कलिमल समन दमन मन राम सुजस सुखमूल ।
सादर सुनहि जे तिन्ह पर राम रहहिं अनुकूल ॥
verses.tr:
kalimal saman daman man rām sujas sukhamūl
sādar sunahi je tinh par rām rahahiṃ anukūl
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कठिन काल मल कोस धर्म न ग्यान न जोग जप ।
परिहरि सकल भरोस रामहि भजहिं ते चतुर नर ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭhin kāl mal kos dharm na gyān na jog jap
parihari sakal bharos rāmahi bhajahiṃ te catur nar

trans: On hearing this Janaki was overjoyed and reverently bowed her head at her feet. Then the All-merciful said to the saint, ‘With your permission I would go to some other wood. Continue to be ever gracious to me and knowing me to be your servant, cease not yourkindness.” On hearing this speech of the Lord, the champion of righteousness, the wise saint affectionately replied: “O Rama, you are he whose favour is desired by Brahma, Siva, Sanat-kumdra, and the other gods and by all the preachers of salvation; the passionless the kindly, the friend of the helpless, who thus modestly be speak me. Now I understand the cleverness of Lakshmi who has left every other god and worships you alone. Of a truth there is none your equal; how then could your goodness be other than it is How can I, my lord, tell you what wood to visit Say, master, for you read. the heart.” Having thus spoken, the saint strong-minded as be was, trembled in every limb and his eyes streamed with tears as he gazed upon the Lord.

Trembling exceedingly in every limb he fixed his loving eyes upon his Lotus face: ‘It is the reward of prayer and penance that I have beheld the Lord, who transcends the senses and every faculty of thought and reason.” By prayer and meditation and religious observances, men attain to the crowning virtue of faith; therefore day andinight,Tulsi Das sings the holy acts of Raghubir.
Rama's praises remove the pollution of this wicked age, subdue the soul, are the source of beatitude; and Rama continues gracious to all who reverently hear them.
Grievous is the burden, of the sin of the world; no religion, nor knowledge, nor meditation, nor penance avails against it; they are wise who discard trust in all else and worship Rama ooly.

sections.label: Doha 7
sections.name: देखी राम मुख पंकज मुनिबर लोचन भृंग

verses.sa:
मुनि पद कमल नाइ करि सीसा ।
चले बनहि सुर नर मुनि ईसा ॥
verses.tr:
muni pad kamal nāi kari sīsā
cale banahi sur nar muni īsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आगे राम अनुज पुनि पाछें ।
मुनि बर बेष बने अति काछें ॥
verses.tr:
āge rām anuj puni pācheṃ
muni bar beṣ bane ati kācheṃ

verses.sa:
उमय बीच श्री सोहइ कैसी ।
ब्रह्म जीव बिच माया जैसी ॥
verses.tr:
umaya bīc śrī sohai kaisī
brahm jīv bic māyā jaisī

verses.sa:
सरिता बन गिरि अवघट घाटा ।
पति पहिचानी देहिं बर बाटा ॥
verses.tr:
saritā ban giri avaghaṭ ghāṭā
pati pahicānī dehiṃ bar bāṭā

verses.sa:
जहँ जहँ जाहि देव रघुराया ।
करहिं मेध तहँ तहँ नभ छाया ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jaham̐ jāhi dev raghurāyā
karahiṃ medh taham̐ taham̐ nabh chāyā

verses.sa:
मिला असुर बिराध मग जाता ।
आवतहीं रघुवीर निपाता ॥
verses.tr:
milā asur birādh mag jātā
āvatahīṃ raghuvīr nipātā

verses.sa:
तुरतहिं रुचिर रूप तेहिं पावा ।
देखि दुखी निज धाम पठावा ॥
verses.tr:
turatahiṃ rucir rūp tehiṃ pāvā
dekhi dukhī nij dhām paṭhāvā

verses.sa:
पुनि आए जहँ मुनि सरभंगा ।
सुंदर अनुज जानकी संगा ॥
verses.tr:
puni āe jaham̐ muni sarabhaṃgā
suṃdar anuj jānakī saṃgā

verses.sa:
देखी राम मुख पंकज मुनिबर लोचन भृंग ।
सादर पान करत अति धन्य जन्म सरभंग ॥
verses.tr:
dekhī rām mukh paṃkaj munibar locan bhṛṃg
sādar pān karat ati dhanya janm sarabhaṃg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Tbe Lord of gods and men and saints, after bowing his head at the lotus feet of the sage, proceeded to the wood. Rama first and after him his brother, in the garb of hermits all full and complete Between the two the incarnation of Lakshmi shone forth like Maya between (God and the soul. The rivers and thickets and precipitous and mountain- passes all recognized their lord and made the way smooth for him. Wherever the divine Raghu^i passed, the clouds made a canopy inthe heaven. As they went along the road the demon Viridha met them. While he was yet coming Raghubir overthrew him, then at once he assumed beauteous form; and Rama seeing him sorrowful dismissed him to his own sphere. Then the All-beautiful with his brother ‘and a^naki visited the sage Sarabhanga.
At the sight of Rama’s lotus face the bee-like eyes-of the

sections.label: Doha 8
sections.name: सीता अनुज समेत प्रभु नील जलद तनु स्याम

verses.sa:
कह मुनि सुनु रघुबीर कृपाला ।
संकर मानस राजमराला ॥
verses.tr:
kah muni sunu raghubīr kṛpālā
saṃkar mānas rājamarālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जात रहेउँ बिरंचि के धामा ।
सुनेउँ श्रवन बन ऐहहिं रामा ॥
verses.tr:
jāt raheum̐ biraṃci ke dhāmā
suneum̐ śravan ban aihahiṃ rāmā

verses.sa:
चितवत पंथ रहेउँ दिन राती ।
अब प्रभु देखि जुड़ानी छाती ॥
verses.tr:
citavat paṃth raheum̐ din rātī
ab prabhu dekhi jur̤ānī chātī

verses.sa:
नाथ सकल साधन मैं हीना ।
कीन्ही कृपा जानि जन दीना ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sakal sādhan maiṃ hīnā
kīnhī kṛpā jāni jan dīnā

verses.sa:
सो कछु देव न मोहि निहोरा ।
निज पन राखेउ जन मन चोरा ॥
verses.tr:
so kachu dev na mohi nihorā
nij pan rākheu jan man corā

verses.sa:
तब लगि रहहु दीन हित लागी ।
जब लगि मिलौं तुम्हहि तनु त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
tab lagi rahahu dīn hit lāgī
jab lagi milauṃ tumhahi tanu tyāgī

verses.sa:
जोग जग्य जप तप ब्रत कीन्हा ।
प्रभु कहँ देइ भगति बर लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jog jagya jap tap brat kīnhā
prabhu kaham̐ dei bhagati bar līnhā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सर रचि मुनि सरभंगा ।
बैठे हृदयँ छाड़ि सब संगा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sar raci muni sarabhaṃgā
baiṭhe hṛdayam̐ chār̤i sab saṃgā

verses.sa:
सीता अनुज समेत प्रभु नील जलद तनु स्याम ।
मम हियँ बसहु निरंतर सगुनरुप श्रीराम ॥
verses.tr:
sītā anuj samet prabhu nīl jalad tanu syām
mam hiyam̐ basahu niraṃtar sagunarup śrīrām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: saint reverently drank thereof; blessed indeed was Sarabhanga to have been born.
Said the saint: “Hearken, gracious Raghubir, the swan of Sankara’s Lake. I had taken my departure to the halls of
- the Creator, but I heard say that Rama is coming into the forest. Day and night I have been watching the road; now

I have seen my lord and my heart is at rest. I am deficient, my lord, in all] that is good, but you have graciously acknowledged me as your humble servant. Now, sire, I have no request to make; I have accomplished my vow, O ravisher of the soul of the faithful, to wait in expectation of the suppliant’s friend till I saw you and then to discard my body. I.have practised meditation, sacrifice, prayers, penance and fasting, and have received the g ft of faith as a boon of the lord. In this manner with his funeral pile all ready prepared, saint Sarabhanga has sat and waited, with a heart freed from every attachment.
May the Lord, whose body is dark of hue as a sombre raincloud, incarnate in form as the divine Rama, dwell for ever io my soul together with Sita and his brother | *’

sections.label: Doha 9
sections.name: निसिचर हीन करउँ महि भुज उठाइ पन कीन्ह

verses.sa:
अस कहि जोग अगिनि तनु जारा ।
राम कृपाँ बैकुंठ सिधारा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi jog agini tanu jārā
rām kṛpām̐ baikuṃṭh sidhārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ताते मुनि हरि लीन न भयऊ ।
प्रथमहिं भेद भगति बर लयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tāte muni hari līn na bhayaū
prathamahiṃ bhed bhagati bar layaū

verses.sa:
रिषि निकाय मुनिबर गति देखि ।
सुखी भए निज हृदयँ बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi nikāya munibar gati dekhi
sukhī bhae nij hṛdayam̐ biseṣī

verses.sa:
अस्तुति करहिं सकल मुनि बृंदा ।
जयति प्रनत हित करुना कंदा ॥
verses.tr:
astuti karahiṃ sakal muni bṛṃdā
jayati pranat hit karunā kaṃdā

verses.sa:
पुनि रघुनाथ चले बन आगे ।
मुनिबर बृंद बिपुल सँग लागे ॥
verses.tr:
puni raghunāth cale ban āge
munibar bṛṃd bipul sam̐g lāge

verses.sa:
अस्थि समूह देखि रघुराया ।
पूछी मुनिन्ह लागि अति दाया ॥
verses.tr:
asthi samūh dekhi raghurāyā
pūchī muninh lāgi ati dāyā

verses.sa:
जानतहुँ पूछिअ कस स्वामी ।
सबदरसी तुम्ह अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
jānatahum̐ pūchia kas svāmī
sabadarasī tumh aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
निसिचर निकर सकल मुनि खाए ।
सुनि रघुबीर नयन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar nikar sakal muni khāe
suni raghubīr nayan jal chāe

verses.sa:
निसिचर हीन करउँ महि भुज उठाइ पन कीन्ह ।
सकल मुनिन्ह के आश्रमन्हि जाइ जाइ सुख दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar hīn karaum̐ mahi bhuj uṭhāi pan kīnh
sakal muninh ke āśramanhi jāi jāi sukh dīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When he had thus said, the fire of his devotion consumed his body, and by RAma's favour he ascended to Vaikunth. The saint was not absorbed into the divinity for this. reason, that he had already received the mysterious gift of faith. When the assembled Rishis saw-the great saint’s translation, they were mightily rejoiced at heart and all broke forth into hymns of praise, ‘Glory to the champion of the humble, the fountain of mercy.’ Then Raghunath went on further into the forest, and a great company of holy men with him. Seeing a heap of bones, he asked the saints about them and was moved with much compassion. “I know, but why ask, Master? You are all-seeing and know even our thoughts. These are all saints whom the demon hosts have devoured.” On hearing this, Raghubir’s eyes filled with tears.
He raised his arms and vowed to rid the earth of demons: then gladdened the saints by visiting them all in turn at their hermitages.

sections.label: Doha 10
sections.name: तब मुनि हृदयँ धीर धीर गहि पद बारहिं बार

verses.sa:
मुनि अगस्ति कर सिष्य सुजाना ।
नाम सुतीछन रति भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
muni agasti kar siṣya sujānā
nām sutīchan rati bhagavānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मन क्रम बचन राम पद सेवक ।
सपनेहुँ आन भरोस न देवक ॥
verses.tr:
man kram bacan rām pad sevak
sapanehum̐ ān bharos na devak

verses.sa:
प्रभु आगवनु श्रवन सुनि पावा ।
करत मनोरथ आतुर धावा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu āgavanu śravan suni pāvā
karat manorath ātur dhāvā

verses.sa:
हे बिधि दीनबंधु रघुराया ।
मो से सठ पर करिहहिं दाया ॥
verses.tr:
he bidhi dīnabaṃdhu raghurāyā
mo se saṭh par karihahiṃ dāyā

verses.sa:
सहित अनुज मोहि राम गोसाई ।
मिलिहहिं निज सेवक की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
sahit anuj mohi rām gosāī
milihahiṃ nij sevak kī nāī

verses.sa:
मोरे जियँ भरोस दृढ़ नाहीं ।
भगति बिरति न ग्यान मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
more jiyam̐ bharos dṛr̤h nāhīṃ
bhagati birati na gyān man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
नहिं सतसंग जोग जप जागा ।
नहिं दृढ़ चरन कमल अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ satasaṃg jog jap jāgā
nahiṃ dṛr̤h caran kamal anurāgā

verses.sa:
एक बानि करुनानिधान की ।
सो प्रिय जाकें गति न आन की ॥
verses.tr:
ek bāni karunānidhān kī
so priya jākeṃ gati na ān kī

verses.sa:
होइहैं सुफल आजु मम लोचन ।
देखि बदन पंकज भव मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
hoihaiṃ suphal āju mam locan
dekhi badan paṃkaj bhav mocan

verses.sa:
निर्भर प्रेम मगन मुनि ग्यानी ।
कहि न जाइ सो दसा भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
nirbhar prem magan muni gyānī
kahi na jāi so dasā bhavānī

verses.sa:
दिसि अरु बिदिसि पंथ नहिं सूझा ।
को मैं चलेउँ कहाँ नहिं बूझा ॥
verses.tr:
disi aru bidisi paṃth nahiṃ sūjhā
ko maiṃ caleum̐ kahām̐ nahiṃ būjhā

verses.sa:
कबहुँक फिरि पाछें पुनि जाई ।
कबहुँक नृत्य करइ गुन गाई ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐k phiri pācheṃ puni jāī
kabahum̐k nṛtya karai gun gāī

verses.sa:
अबिरल प्रेम भगति मुनि पाई ।
प्रभु देखैं तरु ओट लुकाई ॥
verses.tr:
abiral prem bhagati muni pāī
prabhu dekhaiṃ taru oṭ lukāī

verses.sa:
अतिसय प्रीति देखि रघुबीरा ।
प्रगटे हृदयँ हरन भव भीरा ॥
verses.tr:
atisaya prīti dekhi raghubīrā
pragaṭe hṛdayam̐ haran bhav bhīrā

verses.sa:
मुनि मग माझ अचल होइ बैसा ।
पुलक सरीर पनस फल जैसा ॥
verses.tr:
muni mag mājh acal hoi baisā
pulak sarīr panas phal jaisā

verses.sa:
तब रघुनाथ निकट चलि आए ।
देखि दसा निज जन मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghunāth nikaṭ cali āe
dekhi dasā nij jan man bhāe

verses.sa:
मुनिहि राम बहु भाँति जगावा ।
जाग न ध्यानजनित सुख पावा ॥
verses.tr:
munihi rām bahu bhām̐ti jagāvā
jāg na dhyānajanit sukh pāvā

verses.sa:
भूप रूप तब राम दुरावा ।
हृदयँ चतुर्भुज रूप देखावा ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp rūp tab rām durāvā
hṛdayam̐ caturbhuj rūp dekhāvā

verses.sa:
मुनि अकुलाइ उठा तब कैसें ।
बिकल हीन मनि फनि बर जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
muni akulāi uṭhā tab kaiseṃ
bikal hīn mani phani bar jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
आगें देखि राम तन स्यामा ।
सीता अनुज सहित सुख धामा ॥
verses.tr:
āgeṃ dekhi rām tan syāmā
sītā anuj sahit sukh dhāmā

verses.sa:
परेउ लकुट इव चरनन्हि लागी ।
प्रेम मगन मुनिबर बड़भागी ॥
verses.tr:
pareu lakuṭ iv carananhi lāgī
prem magan munibar bar̤abhāgī

verses.sa:
भुज बिसाल गहि लिए उठाई ।
परम प्रीति राखे उर लाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhuj bisāl gahi lie uṭhāī
param prīti rākhe ur lāī

verses.sa:
मुनिहि मिलत अस सोह कृपाला ।
कनक तरुहि जनु भेंट तमाला ॥
verses.tr:
munihi milat as soh kṛpālā
kanak taruhi janu bheṃṭ tamālā

verses.sa:
राम बदनु बिलोक मुनि ठाढ़ा ।
मानहुँ चित्र माझ लिखि काढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
rām badanu bilok muni ṭhār̤hā
mānahum̐ citr mājh likhi kār̤hā

verses.sa:
तब मुनि हृदयँ धीर धीर गहि पद बारहिं बार ।
निज आश्रम प्रभु आनि करि पूजा बिबिध प्रकार ॥
verses.tr:
tab muni hṛdayam̐ dhīr dhīr gahi pad bārahiṃ bār
nij āśram prabhu āni kari pūjā bibidh prakār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Saint Agastya had a learned disciple, by name Sutikshna © devoted to God; io thought, word and deed one of Rama’s faithful servants, who had never even dreamt of any other hope or divinity. When he heard of the Lord’s approach, he rushed out hurriedly, full of longing desire:‘O God, the compassionate Raguhreri will be gracious to even a wretch like'me. The holy Rama and his brother will receive me as their own servant. I have no assured confidence of heart, no faith, nor command over self, nor wisdom - of intellect; no communion with saints, no practice in meditation, prayer, or vigil, and no steadfast devotion to his lotus feet; only the promise of the All-merciful: ‘He is my friend who goeth to none other.’ To-day my eyes will be blest with the sight of the lotus-faced, the deliverer from the bondage of existence.’ The saint, philosopher as he was, was so utterly overwhelmed with love that his state, Bhavani, was beyond all description. He could not see his way either in this direction or in that, nor remember who he was, or where he was going; at one time he would turn and go back, at another would dance and sing songs of praise. The saint’s love and faith waxed yet more vehement as the Lord watched him stealthily from behind a tree. Then Raghubir, who removes all the troubles of the world, after witnessing his exceeding devotion, manifested himself in his son]. The saint was struck motionless in the middle of the road, and his body bristled like the jack-fruit with every hair on end. Then Raghunath drew near, rejoicing to witness the emotion of his servant, and tried many ways to rouse him; but he neither awoke nor derived any happiness from the vision; till Rama doffed his kingly guise and mentally revealed himself as the four-armed god. The saint thereupon started up in alarm, like a poor snake that has been robbed of its jewel’; but seeing before him the dark-hued Rama with Sita and his younger brother, the abode of delight, he fell like a dog ut his feet, drowned in love and supremely happy. With his strong arms he took and lifted him and clasped him to his bosom with the utmost affection. As he embraced the saint, the All-merciful showed forth like a tamdla tree clasped by a tree of gold: and the saint as he gazed on Rama’s face stood so still that you would take him for a figure painted in a picture,
At last the saint growing bolder at heart, after again and again clasping his feet, conducted the Lord to his hermitage and did everything io his honour.

sections.label: Doha 11
sections.name: अनुज जानकी सहित प्रभु चाप बान धर राम

verses.sa:
कह मुनि प्रभु सुनु बिनती मोरी ।
अस्तुति करौं कवन बिधि तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kah muni prabhu sunu binatī morī
astuti karauṃ kavan bidhi torī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
महिमा अमित मोरि मति थोरी ।
रबि सन्मुख खद्योत अँजोरी ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā amit mori mati thorī
rabi sanmukh khadyot am̐jorī

verses.sa:
श्याम तामरस दाम शरीरं ।
जटा मुकुट परिधन मुनिचीरं ॥
verses.tr:
śyām tāmaras dām śarīraṃ
jaṭā mukuṭ paridhan municīraṃ

verses.sa:
पाणि चाप शर कटि तूणीरं ।
नौमि निरंतर श्रीरघुवीरं ॥
verses.tr:
pāṇi cāp śar kaṭi tūṇīraṃ
naumi niraṃtar śrīraghuvīraṃ

verses.sa:
मोह विपिन घन दहन कृशानुः ।
संत सरोरुह कानन भानुः ॥
verses.tr:
moh vipin ghan dahan kṛśānuḥ
saṃt saroruh kānan bhānuḥ

verses.sa:
निशिचर करि वरूथ मृगराजः ।
त्रातु सदा नो भव खग बाजः ॥
verses.tr:
niśicar kari varūth mṛgarājaḥ
trātu sadā no bhav khag bājaḥ

verses.sa:
अरुण नयन राजीव सुवेशं ।
सीता नयन चकोर निशेशं ॥
verses.tr:
aruṇ nayan rājīv suveśaṃ
sītā nayan cakor niśeśaṃ

verses.sa:
हर ह्रदि मानस बाल मरालं ।
नौमि राम उर बाहु विशालं ॥
verses.tr:
har hradi mānas bāl marālaṃ
naumi rām ur bāhu viśālaṃ

verses.sa:
संशय सर्प ग्रसन उरगादः ।
शमन सुकर्कश तर्क विषादः ॥
verses.tr:
saṃśaya sarp grasan uragādaḥ
śaman sukarkaś tark viṣādaḥ

verses.sa:
भव भंजन रंजन सुर यूथः ।
त्रातु सदा नो कृपा वरूथः ॥
verses.tr:
bhav bhaṃjan raṃjan sur yūthaḥ
trātu sadā no kṛpā varūthaḥ

verses.sa:
निर्गुण सगुण विषम सम रूपं ।
ज्ञान गिरा गोतीतमनूपं ॥
verses.tr:
nirguṇ saguṇ viṣam sam rūpaṃ
jñān girā gotītamanūpaṃ

verses.sa:
अमलमखिलमनवद्यमपारं ।
नौमि राम भंजन महि भारं ॥
verses.tr:
amalamakhilamanavadyamapāraṃ
naumi rām bhaṃjan mahi bhāraṃ

verses.sa:
भक्त कल्पपादप आरामः ।
तर्जन क्रोध लोभ मद कामः ॥
verses.tr:
bhakt kalpapādap ārāmaḥ
tarjan krodh lobh mad kāmaḥ

verses.sa:
अति नागर भव सागर सेतुः ।
त्रातु सदा दिनकर कुल केतुः ॥
verses.tr:
ati nāgar bhav sāgar setuḥ
trātu sadā dinakar kul ketuḥ

verses.sa:
अतुलित भुज प्रताप बल धामः ।
कलि मल विपुल विभंजन नामः ॥
verses.tr:
atulit bhuj pratāp bal dhāmaḥ
kali mal vipul vibhaṃjan nāmaḥ

verses.sa:
धर्म वर्म नर्मद गुण ग्रामः ।
संतत शं तनोतु मम रामः ॥
verses.tr:
dharm varm narmad guṇ grāmaḥ
saṃtat śaṃ tanotu mam rāmaḥ

verses.sa:
जदपि बिरज ब्यापक अबिनासी ।
सब के हृदयँ निरंतर बासी ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi biraj byāpak abināsī
sab ke hṛdayam̐ niraṃtar bāsī

verses.sa:
तदपि अनुज श्री सहित खरारी ।
बसतु मनसि मम काननचारी ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi anuj śrī sahit kharārī
basatu manasi mam kānanacārī

verses.sa:
जे जानहिं ते जानहुँ स्वामी ।
सगुन अगुन उर अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
je jānahiṃ te jānahum̐ svāmī
sagun agun ur aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
जो कोसल पति राजिव नयना ।
करउ सो राम हृदय मम अयना ॥
verses.tr:
jo kosal pati rājiv nayanā
karau so rām hṛdaya mam ayanā

verses.sa:
अस अभिमान जाइ जनि भोरे ।
मैं सेवक रघुपति पति मोरे ॥
verses.tr:
as abhimān jāi jani bhore
maiṃ sevak raghupati pati more

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन राम मन भाए ।
बहुरि हरषि मुनिबर उर लाए ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan rām man bhāe
bahuri haraṣi munibar ur lāe

verses.sa:
परम प्रसन्न जानु मुनि मोही ।
जो बर मागहु देउ सो तोही ॥
verses.tr:
param prasann jānu muni mohī
jo bar māgahu deu so tohī

verses.sa:
मुनि कह मै बर कबहुँ न जाचा ।
समुझि न परइ झूठ का साचा ॥
verses.tr:
muni kah mai bar kabahum̐ na jācā
samujhi na parai jhūṭh kā sācā

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि नीक लागै रघुराई ।
सो मोहि देहु दास सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi nīk lāgai raghurāī
so mohi dehu dās sukhadāī

verses.sa:
अबिरल भगति बिरति बिग्याना ।
होहु सकल गुन ग्यान निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
abiral bhagati birati bigyānā
hohu sakal gun gyān nidhānā

verses.sa:
प्रभु जो दीन्ह सो बरु मैं पावा ।
अब सो देहु मोहि जो भावा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu jo dīnh so baru maiṃ pāvā
ab so dehu mohi jo bhāvā

verses.sa:
अनुज जानकी सहित प्रभु चाप बान धर राम ।
मम हिय गगन इंदु इव बसहु सदा निहकाम ॥
verses.tr:
anuj jānakī sahit prabhu cāp bān dhar rām
mam hiya gagan iṃdu iv basahu sadā nihakām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said the saint: “Hearken, Lord, to my supplication; but how can I hymn thy praise? Thy greatness is immeasurable and my wit is scant, as ineffectual asa fire-Hy in the presence of the sun, I adore without ceasing the divine Raghubir, with body dark of hue as a string of lotuses, with his Knotted hair for a crown and an anchorite’s dress for his robe. with bow and arrows in hand and quiver by his side. A fire to consume the dense forest of delusion, a sun to animate lotus growth of the saints, a lion against the elephant herd of demons, hawk to scatter the birds metempsychosis, may he ever protect us with eyes bright as the lotus; appa-relled with glory; the moon of Sita’s partridge-like eyes; the swan in the lake of Siva’s son]; the broad-chested, strong-armed Rama, him I adore. A Garur to devour the serpent of doubt; the queller of violence, wrangling and pain; the conqueror of death; the delight of the company of heaven: the home of compassion, may he ever protect us. At once bodiless and embodied, like and unlike, endowed with form and formless; transcending all thought, speech and _perception; pure, all-pervading, faultless, illimitable, Rama, the loosener of earth’s burdens, him I adore. A forest of trees of Paradise for his faithful people; the dispeller of passion, avarice, pride and lust; the All-beautiful; the bridge to cross the ocean of life, the champion of the Solar race, may he ever protect us. With unlimited might of arm, the home of strength; the true disperser of the manifold impurities of this iron age; ‘the shield of righteousness; the giver of delights, the assemblage of all good qualities; may he, my Rama, ever grant us prosperity. Though he be passionless, all-pervading, eternal, and ever dwelleth in the hearts of all; yet in his character of the wood-roaming conqueror of Khara, with his brother and bride, may he abide in my thoughts They who understand know him to be the Lord, though embodied, the bodiless ruler of the soul, the lotus-eyed sovereign of Kosala; then make thy abode in my heart, 0 Rama. Never be this sentiment forgotten;I am his servant and Raghupati is

my Lord.” Rama was pleased at heart on hearing the sain't speech, and in his delight pressed him again te his bosom: * Know, O Saint, that [ am highly gratified: ask any boon and [ will grant it you.” Said the saint: “I have never begged a boon, nor can I discern between true and false. Whatever seems good to you, O Raghurai, that bestow upon me, for you are your servant's benefactor,
‘“T pive you steadfast faith, self-control, and wisdom, ‘and make you a storehouse of all virtue and knowledge. I have received, my lord, the boon that you have given, now grant me my own wish.
O my lord Rama, with your brother and Janaki, yourself equipt with bow and arrows, for ever abide like the moon in the heaven of my soul.’”

sections.label: Doha 12
sections.name: मुनि समूह महँ बैठे सन्मुख सब की ओर

verses.sa:
एवमस्तु करि रमानिवासा ।
हरषि चले कुभंज रिषि पासा ॥
verses.tr:
evamastu kari ramānivāsā
haraṣi cale kubhaṃj riṣi pāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बहुत दिवस गुर दरसन पाएँ ।
भए मोहि एहिं आश्रम आएँ ॥
verses.tr:
bahut divas gur darasan pāem̐
bhae mohi ehiṃ āśram āem̐

verses.sa:
अब प्रभु संग जाउँ गुर पाहीं ।
तुम्ह कहँ नाथ निहोरा नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ab prabhu saṃg jāum̐ gur pāhīṃ
tumh kaham̐ nāth nihorā nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
देखि कृपानिधि मुनि चतुराई ।
लिए संग बिहसै द्वौ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi kṛpānidhi muni caturāī
lie saṃg bihasai dvau bhāī

verses.sa:
पंथ कहत निज भगति अनूपा ।
मुनि आश्रम पहुँचे सुरभूपा ॥
verses.tr:
paṃth kahat nij bhagati anūpā
muni āśram pahum̐ce surabhūpā

verses.sa:
तुरत सुतीछन गुर पहिं गयऊ ।
करि दंडवत कहत अस भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
turat sutīchan gur pahiṃ gayaū
kari daṃḍavat kahat as bhayaū

verses.sa:
नाथ कौसलाधीस कुमारा ।
आए मिलन जगत आधारा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth kausalādhīs kumārā
āe milan jagat ādhārā

verses.sa:
राम अनुज समेत बैदेही ।
निसि दिनु देव जपत हहु जेही ॥
verses.tr:
rām anuj samet baidehī
nisi dinu dev japat hahu jehī

verses.sa:
सुनत अगस्ति तुरत उठि धाए ।
हरि बिलोकि लोचन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
sunat agasti turat uṭhi dhāe
hari biloki locan jal chāe

verses.sa:
मुनि पद कमल परे द्वौ भाई ।
रिषि अति प्रीति लिए उर लाई ॥
verses.tr:
muni pad kamal pare dvau bhāī
riṣi ati prīti lie ur lāī

verses.sa:
सादर कुसल पूछि मुनि ग्यानी ।
आसन बर बैठारे आनी ॥
verses.tr:
sādar kusal pūchi muni gyānī
āsan bar baiṭhāre ānī

verses.sa:
पुनि करि बहु प्रकार प्रभु पूजा ।
मोहि सम भाग्यवंत नहिं दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
puni kari bahu prakār prabhu pūjā
mohi sam bhāgyavaṃt nahiṃ dūjā

verses.sa:
जहँ लगि रहे अपर मुनि बृंदा ।
हरषे सब बिलोकि सुखकंदा ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ lagi rahe apar muni bṛṃdā
haraṣe sab biloki sukhakaṃdā

verses.sa:
मुनि समूह महँ बैठे सन्मुख सब की ओर ।
सरद इंदु तन चितवत मानहुँ निकर चकोर ॥
verses.tr:
muni samūh maham̐ baiṭhe sanmukh sab kī or

sections.label: Doha 13
sections.name: गीधराज सैं भैंट भइ बहु बिधि प्रीति बढ़ाइ

verses.sa:
तब रघुबीर कहा मुनि पाहीं ।
तुम्ह सन प्रभु दुराव कछु नाही ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghubīr kahā muni pāhīṃ
tumh san prabhu durāv kachu nāhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तुम्ह जानहु जेहि कारन आयउँ ।
ताते तात न कहि समुझायउँ ॥
verses.tr:
tumh jānahu jehi kāran āyaum̐
tāte tāt na kahi samujhāyaum̐

verses.sa:
अब सो मंत्र देहु प्रभु मोही ।
जेहि प्रकार मारौं मुनिद्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
ab so maṃtr dehu prabhu mohī
jehi prakār mārauṃ munidrohī

verses.sa:
मुनि मुसकाने सुनि प्रभु बानी ।
पूछेहु नाथ मोहि का जानी ॥
verses.tr:
muni musakāne suni prabhu bānī
pūchehu nāth mohi kā jānī

verses.sa:
तुम्हरेइँ भजन प्रभाव अघारी ।
जानउँ महिमा कछुक तुम्हारी ॥
verses.tr:
tumhareim̐ bhajan prabhāv aghārī
jānaum̐ mahimā kachuk tumhārī

verses.sa:
ऊमरि तरु बिसाल तव माया ।
फल ब्रह्मांड अनेक निकाया ॥
verses.tr:
ūmari taru bisāl tav māyā
phal brahmāṃḍ anek nikāyā

verses.sa:
जीव चराचर जंतु समाना ।
भीतर बसहि न जानहिं आना ॥
verses.tr:
jīv carācar jaṃtu samānā
bhītar basahi na jānahiṃ ānā

verses.sa:
ते फल भच्छक कठिन कराला ।
तव भयँ डरत सदा सोउ काला ॥
verses.tr:
te phal bhacchak kaṭhin karālā
tav bhayam̐ ḍarat sadā sou kālā

verses.sa:
ते तुम्ह सकल लोकपति साईं ।
पूँछेहु मोहि मनुज की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
te tumh sakal lokapati sāīṃ
pūm̐chehu mohi manuj kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
यह बर मागउँ कृपानिकेता ।
बसहु हृदयँ श्री अनुज समेता ॥
verses.tr:
yah bar māgaum̐ kṛpāniketā
basahu hṛdayam̐ śrī anuj sametā

verses.sa:
अबिरल भगति बिरति सतसंगा ।
चरन सरोरुह प्रीति अभंगा ॥
verses.tr:
abiral bhagati birati satasaṃgā
caran saroruh prīti abhaṃgā

verses.sa:
जद्यपि ब्रह्म अखंड अनंता ।
अनुभव गम्य भजहिं जेहि संता ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi brahm akhaṃḍ anaṃtā
anubhav gamya bhajahiṃ jehi saṃtā

verses.sa:
अस तव रूप बखानउँ जानउँ ।
फिरि फिरि सगुन ब्रह्म रति मानउँ ॥
verses.tr:
as tav rūp bakhānaum̐ jānaum̐
phiri phiri sagun brahm rati mānaum̐

verses.sa:
संतत दासन्ह देहु बड़ाई ।
तातें मोहि पूँछेहु रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
saṃtat dāsanh dehu bar̤āī
tāteṃ mohi pūm̐chehu raghurāī

verses.sa:
है प्रभु परम मनोहर ठाऊँ ।
पावन पंचबटी तेहि नाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
hai prabhu param manohar ṭhāūm̐
pāvan paṃcabaṭī tehi nāūm̐

verses.sa:
दंडक बन पुनीत प्रभु करहू ।
उग्र साप मुनिबर कर हरहू ॥
verses.tr:
daṃḍak ban punīt prabhu karahū
ugr sāp munibar kar harahū

verses.sa:
बास करहु तहँ रघुकुल राया ।
कीजे सकल मुनिन्ह पर दाया ॥
verses.tr:
bās karahu taham̐ raghukul rāyā
kīje sakal muninh par dāyā

verses.sa:
चले राम मुनि आयसु पाई ।
तुरतहिं पंचबटी निअराई ॥
verses.tr:
cale rām muni āyasu pāī
turatahiṃ paṃcabaṭī niarāī

verses.sa: गीधराज सैं भैंट भइ बहु बिधि प्रीति बढ़ाइ ॥
verses.tr: gīdharāj saiṃ bhaiṃṭ bhai bahu bidhi prīti bar̤hāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: गोदावरी निकट प्रभु रहे परन गृह छाइ ॥
verses.tr: godāvarī nikaṭ prabhu rahe paran gṛh chāi

trans: Then said Raghubir to the saint: “My lord, nothing is bid from you; you know why I have come, and therefore, sire, there is no need to inform you. Give me now some charm by which I may destroy the persecutors of the saints.” The sage smiled when he heard the lord's speech: ‘“ You ask me, but what do I know By virtue of my devotion to you, O destroyer of sin, I understand a little of your greatness. Your delusive power is a vast fig tree, its clustering fruit the countless multitude of worlds, while all things animate and inanimate are like the insects that dwell inside, and think their own particular fig the only one in existence. This fruit is devoured by harsh and inexorable fate, but even he trembles in fear of you. You, sire, are the sovereign af all the spheres, and you ask of me, as: though you were only a man, OQ fountain of mercy, I beg this boon; dwell in my heart Lakshmi and your brother, and grant me steadfast faith, piety, fellowship with the saints and unbroken love for your lotus feet. Though you are supreme spirit, indivisible and eternal, beyond the reach of perception, the adoration of the saints, yet I declare and recognize your incarnation, and again and again adore the embodiment of Brahm and Rati. You always exalt your own servants, and this, Raghu^i, is the reason why you consult me. There is, my lord, a very charming and holy spot called. Panchavati. Sanctify the whole Dandaka forest, in which it is, and relieve it of the saint’s grievous curse, by taking up your abode there, Rama; and thus show mercy to all the saints.” On receiving his permission, Rama set out and quickly arrived at Panchavati. Dohe 10.
After meeting the king of the vultures and warmly renewing old friendship, Rama stayed near the Godavari, where he made himself a thatched cottage.

sections.label: Doha 14
sections.name: ईस्वर जीव भेद प्रभु सकल कहौ समुझाइ

verses.sa:
जब ते राम कीन्ह तहँ बासा ।
सुखी भए मुनि बीती त्रासा ॥
verses.tr:
jab te rām kīnh taham̐ bāsā
sukhī bhae muni bītī trāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गिरि बन नदीं ताल छबि छाए ।
दिन दिन प्रति अति हौहिं सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
giri ban nadīṃ tāl chabi chāe
din din prati ati hauhiṃ suhāe

verses.sa:
खग मृग बृंद अनंदित रहहीं ।
मधुप मधुर गंजत छबि लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
khag mṛg bṛṃd anaṃdit rahahīṃ
madhup madhur gaṃjat chabi lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
सो बन बरनि न सक अहिराजा ।
जहाँ प्रगट रघुबीर बिराजा ॥
verses.tr:
so ban barani na sak ahirājā
jahām̐ pragaṭ raghubīr birājā

verses.sa:
एक बार प्रभु सुख आसीना ।
लछिमन बचन कहे छलहीना ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār prabhu sukh āsīnā
lachiman bacan kahe chalahīnā

verses.sa:
सुर नर मुनि सचराचर साईं ।
मैं पूछउँ निज प्रभु की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
sur nar muni sacarācar sāīṃ
maiṃ pūchaum̐ nij prabhu kī nāī

verses.sa:
मोहि समुझाइ कहहु सोइ देवा ।
सब तजि करौं चरन रज सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
mohi samujhāi kahahu soi devā
sab taji karauṃ caran raj sevā

verses.sa:
कहहु ग्यान बिराग अरु माया ।
कहहु सो भगति करहु जेहिं दाया ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu gyān birāg aru māyā
kahahu so bhagati karahu jehiṃ dāyā

verses.sa: ईस्वर जीव भेद प्रभु सकल कहौ समुझाइ ॥
verses.tr: īsvar jīv bhed prabhu sakal kahau samujhāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: जातें होइ चरन रति सोक मोह भ्रम जाइ ॥
verses.tr: jāteṃ hoi caran rati sok moh bhram jāi

trans: From the time that Rama took up his abode there, the saint lived happily and without fear. The mountains, woods, rivers and lakes were suffused with beauty and day by day grew yet more exceedingly lovely. The many birds and deer were full of joy and the bees added a charm by their sweet buzzing. Not even the serpent-king would be able to describe the forest, in which the glorious Rama had manifested himself. One day, asthe Lord was sitting at ease, Lakshman most humbly addressed him thus: ‘“Sovereign of gods, men and saints, and of all animate and inanimate creation, I have a question to ask of you as of my own special master. Speak, sire, and answer it for me, for I have left all to serve the dust of your feet. Explain to me knowledge, self-governance, and the delusion of Maya; tell me what is that faith to which you extend mercy.
Instruct me, my lord, in all the difference between (God and the soul, that I may be entirely devoted to your feet and free from grief, ignorance and error.”

sections.label: Doha 15
sections.name: माया ईस न आपु कहुँ जान कहिअ सो जीव

verses.sa:
थोरेहि महँ सब कहउँ बुझाई ।
सुनहु तात मति मन चित लाई ॥
verses.tr:
thorehi maham̐ sab kahaum̐ bujhāī
sunahu tāt mati man cit lāī

verses.sa:
मैं अरु मोर तोर तैं माया ।
जेहिं बस कीन्हे जीव निकाया ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ aru mor tor taiṃ māyā
jehiṃ bas kīnhe jīv nikāyā

verses.sa:
गो गोचर जहँ लगि मन जाई ।
सो सब माया जानेहु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
go gocar jaham̐ lagi man jāī
so sab māyā jānehu bhāī

verses.sa:
तेहि कर भेद सुनहु तुम्ह सोऊ ।
बिद्या अपर अबिद्या दोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tehi kar bhed sunahu tumh soū
bidyā apar abidyā doū

verses.sa:
एक दुष्ट अतिसय दुखरूपा ।
जा बस जीव परा भवकूपा ॥
verses.tr:
ek duṣṭ atisaya dukharūpā
jā bas jīv parā bhavakūpā

verses.sa:
एक रचइ जग गुन बस जाकें ।
प्रभु प्रेरित नहिं निज बल ताकें ॥
verses.tr:
ek racai jag gun bas jākeṃ
prabhu prerit nahiṃ nij bal tākeṃ

ग्यान मान जहँ एकउ नाहीं ।
देख ब्रह्म समान सब माही ॥
verses.tr:
gyān mān jaham̐ ekau nāhīṃ
dekh brahm samān sab māhī

कहिअ तात सो परम बिरागी ।
तृन सम सिद्धि तीनि गुन त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
kahia tāt so param birāgī
tṛn sam siddhi tīni gun tyāgī

माया ईस न आपु कहुँ जान कहिअ सो जीव ।
बंध मोच्छ प्रद सर्बपर माया प्रेरक सीव ॥
verses.tr:

trans: Cha pai. “[ will explain the whole matter in brief; hearken, brother, with attention of mind and soul. It is from egoism and distinctions between mine and thine, that the illusion is produced which has subjugated all classes of existence. The senses and the objects of the senses, as far as the mind can reach, are all a delusion, brother; understand that. Now learn its divisions: they are two, viz., knowledge and ignorance; the one utterly bad and calamitous, which forces the principle of life down into the pit of transmigration; the other, the power by virtue of which the world is created, being sent by God, and having no strength of itself. Knowledge, in which there is no particle of self-consciousness, sees the supreme spirit equally in all things; and he, brother, is to be reckoned chief of stoics, who abandons fortune, and the three elements of which the Universe, is composed as if of no more account than a blade of grass.

That is to be called soul which, through the power of delusion, does not recognize itself as being really God; God the giver of bondage and of deliverance, the head of all things, the sender forth of delusion, the one goal.

sections.label: Doha 16
sections.name: बचन कर्म मन मोरि गति भजनु करहिं निःकाम

verses.sa:
धर्म तें बिरति जोग तें ग्याना ।
ग्यान मोच्छप्रद बेद बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
dharm teṃ birati jog teṃ gyānā
gyān mocchaprad bed bakhānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जातें बेगि द्रवउँ मैं भाई ।
सो मम भगति भगत सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāteṃ begi dravaum̐ maiṃ bhāī
so mam bhagati bhagat sukhadāī

verses.sa:
सो सुतंत्र अवलंब न आना ।
तेहि आधीन ग्यान बिग्याना ॥
verses.tr:
so sutaṃtr avalaṃb na ānā
tehi ādhīn gyān bigyānā

verses.sa:
भगति तात अनुपम सुखमूला ।
मिलइ जो संत होइँ अनुकूला ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati tāt anupam sukhamūlā
milai jo saṃt hoim̐ anukūlā

verses.sa:
भगति कि साधन कहउँ बखानी ।
सुगम पंथ मोहि पावहिं प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati ki sādhan kahaum̐ bakhānī
sugam paṃth mohi pāvahiṃ prānī

verses.sa:
प्रथमहिं बिप्र चरन अति प्रीती ।
निज निज कर्म निरत श्रुति रीती ॥
verses.tr:
prathamahiṃ bipr caran ati prītī
nij nij karm nirat śruti rītī

verses.sa:
एहि कर फल पुनि बिषय बिरागा ।
तब मम धर्म उपज अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi kar phal puni biṣaya birāgā
tab mam dharm upaj anurāgā

verses.sa:
श्रवनादिक नव भक्ति दृढ़ाहीं ।
मम लीला रति अति मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
śravanādik nav bhakti dṛr̤hāhīṃ
mam līlā rati ati man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
संत चरन पंकज अति प्रेमा ।
मन क्रम बचन भजन दृढ़ नेमा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt caran paṃkaj ati premā
man kram bacan bhajan dṛr̤h nemā

verses.sa:
गुरु पितु मातु बंधु पति देवा ।
सब मोहि कहँ जाने दृढ़ सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
guru pitu mātu baṃdhu pati devā
sab mohi kaham̐ jāne dṛr̤h sevā

verses.sa:
मम गुन गावत पुलक सरीरा ।
गदगद गिरा नयन बह नीरा ॥
verses.tr:
mam gun gāvat pulak sarīrā
gadagad girā nayan bah nīrā

verses.sa:
काम आदि मद दंभ न जाकें ।
तात निरंतर बस मैं ताकें ॥
verses.tr:
kām ādi mad daṃbh na jākeṃ
tāt niraṃtar bas maiṃ tākeṃ

verses.sa: बचन कर्म मन मोरि गति भजनु करहिं निःकाम ॥
verses.tr: bacan karm man mori gati bhajanu karahiṃ niḥkām
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: तिन्ह के हृदय कमल महुँ करउँ सदा बिश्राम ॥
verses.tr: tinh ke hṛdaya kamal mahum̐ karaum̐ sadā biśrām

trans: After piety, asceticism; and after ascetic meditation knowledge; and knowledge, us the Vedas declare, is the giver of salvation. But that at which I melt more quickly, brother, is faith, which is the blessing of my votaries; it stands by itself without other support, and is above all knowledge whether spiritual or profane. Faith, brother, is an incomparable source of happiness, and only to be acquired by the favour of a saint. But I will explain the means towards it, the easy path by which men may find me. In the first place, an exceeding devotion to Brahmans and in every action a close adherence to scriptural prescription. Secondly, the fruit of this will be detachment from the world, and then will spring up a delight in my worship. The nine kinds of faith as exercised by the ears, &eo., will strengthen; there will be an exceeding love in the soul for my manifestations, a great affection for the lotus feet of the saints, a persistency in prayer—in deed and in heart as well as in toogae—xod faithfulness in service done to one’s guru, or father and mother, or family, or loads and masters, knowing it to be really done to me,
Biase oe ee 1 Or it may be thus translated: ‘That is to be called soul, which doubts
regarding itself whether it be a delusive manifestation or really God’

While singing my praises the body quivers, the voice trembles, the eyes flow with tears; and neither lust, pride, nor deceit, finds a place in the soul; 1 am ever, brother, at the command of such a one as this.
a take up my abode for ever in the lotus heart of those who in thought, word and deed make their fervent prayer to my incarnation.

sections.label: Doha 17
sections.name: लछिमन अति लाघवँ सो नाक कान बिनु कीन्हि

verses.sa:
भगति जोग सुनि अति सुख पावा ।
लछिमन प्रभु चरनन्हि सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati jog suni ati sukh pāvā
lachiman prabhu carananhi siru nāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि गए कछुक दिन बीती ।
कहत बिराग ग्यान गुन नीती ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi gae kachuk din bītī
kahat birāg gyān gun nītī

verses.sa:
सूपनखा रावन कै बहिनी ।
दुष्ट हृदय दारुन जस अहिनी ॥
verses.tr:
sūpanakhā rāvan kai bahinī
duṣṭ hṛdaya dārun jas ahinī

verses.sa:
पंचबटी सो गइ एक बारा ।
देखि बिकल भइ जुगल कुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
paṃcabaṭī so gai ek bārā
dekhi bikal bhai jugal kumārā

verses.sa:
भ्राता पिता पुत्र उरगारी ।
पुरुष मनोहर निरखत नारी ॥
verses.tr:
bhrātā pitā putr uragārī
puruṣ manohar nirakhat nārī

verses.sa:
होइ बिकल सक मनहि न रोकी ।
जिमि रबिमनि द्रव रबिहि बिलोकी ॥
verses.tr:
hoi bikal sak manahi na rokī
jimi rabimani drav rabihi bilokī

verses.sa:
रुचिर रुप धरि प्रभु पहिं जाई ।
बोली बचन बहुत मुसुकाई ॥
verses.tr:
rucir rup dhari prabhu pahiṃ jāī
bolī bacan bahut musukāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सम पुरुष न मो सम नारी ।
यह सँजोग बिधि रचा बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sam puruṣ na mo sam nārī
yah sam̐jog bidhi racā bicārī

verses.sa:
मम अनुरूप पुरुष जग माहीं ।
देखेउँ खोजि लोक तिहु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mam anurūp puruṣ jag māhīṃ
dekheum̐ khoji lok tihu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
ताते अब लगि रहिउँ कुमारी ।
मनु माना कछु तुम्हहि निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
tāte ab lagi rahium̐ kumārī
manu mānā kachu tumhahi nihārī

verses.sa:
सीतहि चितइ कही प्रभु बाता ।
अहइ कुआर मोर लघु भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
sītahi citai kahī prabhu bātā
ahai kuār mor laghu bhrātā

verses.sa:
गइ लछिमन रिपु भगिनी जानी ।
प्रभु बिलोकि बोले मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
gai lachiman ripu bhaginī jānī
prabhu biloki bole mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
सुंदरि सुनु मैं उन्ह कर दासा ।
पराधीन नहिं तोर सुपासा ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdari sunu maiṃ unh kar dāsā
parādhīn nahiṃ tor supāsā

verses.sa:
प्रभु समर्थ कोसलपुर राजा ।
जो कछु करहिं उनहि सब छाजा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu samarth kosalapur rājā
jo kachu karahiṃ unahi sab chājā

verses.sa:
सेवक सुख चह मान भिखारी ।
ब्यसनी धन सुभ गति बिभिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
sevak sukh cah mān bhikhārī
byasanī dhan subh gati bibhicārī

verses.sa:
लोभी जसु चह चार गुमानी ।
नभ दुहि दूध चहत ए प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
lobhī jasu cah cār gumānī
nabh duhi dūdh cahat e prānī

verses.sa:
पुनि फिरि राम निकट सो आई ।
प्रभु लछिमन पहिं बहुरि पठाई ॥
verses.tr:
puni phiri rām nikaṭ so āī
prabhu lachiman pahiṃ bahuri paṭhāī

verses.sa:
लछिमन कहा तोहि सो बरई ।
जो तृन तोरि लाज परिहरई ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman kahā tohi so baraī
jo tṛn tori lāj pariharaī

verses.sa:
तब खिसिआनि राम पहिं गई ।
रूप भयंकर प्रगटत भई ॥
verses.tr:
tab khisiāni rām pahiṃ gaī
rūp bhayaṃkar pragaṭat bhaī

verses.sa:
सीतहि सभय देखि रघुराई ।
कहा अनुज सन सयन बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
sītahi sabhaya dekhi raghurāī
kahā anuj san sayan bujhāī

verses.sa:
लछिमन अति लाघवँ सो नाक कान बिनु कीन्हि ।
ताके कर रावन कहँ मनौ चुनौती दीन्हि ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman ati lāghavam̐ so nāk kān binu kīnhi
tāke kar rāvan kaham̐ manau cunautī dīnhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing the doctrine of faith and devotion!, thus expounded, Lakshman was greatly rejoiced and bowed his head at his lords’ feet. In this manner several days were spent in discourse on asceticism, wisdom, virtue and morality. One day Ravan’s sister, Surpa-nakha, foul-hearted and venomous as a serpent, came to Panchavati and was excited by the sight of the two princes. A woman, Garur, must needs look after a handsome man, whether he be brother father or son. In her excitement she could not contain herself, life the sun-stone that melts at the sight of thesuo. Having assumed a beautiful form, she went to the Lord and with many smiles thus addressed him: “There is not another man like you, nor a woman like me; there is a match that God has taken some pains to make. I have searched the three spheres, but have not found anywhere in the world a man with beauty to equal mine. And for this reason I have till now remained 2 virgin, but now that I have seen you I am fairly satisfied.” The Lord looked at Sita and saidin reply: ‘My younger brother is a bachelor.’ The demon’s sister took the hint and went to Lakshman. He looked to his lord and said ir gentle tones: Hearken, fair lady, I am _ his servant; i is not right that you should be in subjection to any one My lord isthe mighty king of Kosala, and whatever he does is all done at his own pleasure. A servant who expects to take his ease, a beggar who expects honour, a spendthrift who hopes for wealth, a profligate who hopes for heaven, or an avaricious man who expects renown, these are four dreamers, men who would expect milk from milking the air.’ Again she turned and came to Rama, but he sent her back once more to Lakshman. Said Lakshman, ** The bridegroom for you must be a man lost to all senses of shame.’ Then in a fury she went to Rama, revealing herself in a shape of terror. Raghurdi, seeing that Sita was frightened madea sign to his brother;
And Lakshman with the greatest ease struck off her

sections.label: Doha 18
sections.name: आइ गए बगमेल धरहु धरहु धावत सुभट

verses.sa:
नाक कान बिनु भइ बिकरारा ।
जनु स्त्रव सैल गैरु कै धारा ॥
verses.tr:
nāk kān binu bhai bikarārā
janu strav sail gairu kai dhārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
खर दूषन पहिं गइ बिलपाता ।
धिग धिग तव पौरुष बल भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
khar dūṣan pahiṃ gai bilapātā
dhig dhig tav pauruṣ bal bhrātā

verses.sa:
तेहि पूछा सब कहेसि बुझाई ।
जातुधान सुनि सेन बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi pūchā sab kahesi bujhāī
jātudhān suni sen banāī

verses.sa:
धाए निसिचर निकर बरूथा ।
जनु सपच्छ कज्जल गिरि जूथा ॥
verses.tr:
dhāe nisicar nikar barūthā
janu sapacch kajjal giri jūthā

verses.sa:
नाना बाहन नानाकारा ।
नानायुध धर घोर अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bāhan nānākārā
nānāyudh dhar ghor apārā

verses.sa:
सुपनखा आगें करि लीनी ।
असुभ रूप श्रुति नासा हीनी ॥
verses.tr:
supanakhā āgeṃ kari līnī
asubh rūp śruti nāsā hīnī

verses.sa:
असगुन अमित होहिं भयकारी ।
गनहिं न मृत्यु बिबस सब झारी ॥
verses.tr:
asagun amit hohiṃ bhayakārī
ganahiṃ na mṛtyu bibas sab jhārī

verses.sa:
गर्जहि तर्जहिं गगन उड़ाहीं ।
देखि कटकु भट अति हरषाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
garjahi tarjahiṃ gagan ur̤āhīṃ
dekhi kaṭaku bhaṭ ati haraṣāhīṃ

verses.sa:
कोउ कह जिअत धरहु द्वौ भाई ।
धरि मारहु तिय लेहु छड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
kou kah jiat dharahu dvau bhāī
dhari mārahu tiya lehu char̤āī

verses.sa:
धूरि पूरि नभ मंडल रहा ।
राम बोलाइ अनुज सन कहा ॥
verses.tr:
dhūri pūri nabh maṃḍal rahā
rām bolāi anuj san kahā

verses.sa:
लै जानकिहि जाहु गिरि कंदर ।
आवा निसिचर कटकु भयंकर ॥
verses.tr:
lai jānakihi jāhu giri kaṃdar
āvā nisicar kaṭaku bhayaṃkar

verses.sa:
रहेहु सजग सुनि प्रभु कै बानी ।
चले सहित श्री सर धनु पानी ॥
verses.tr:
rahehu sajag suni prabhu kai bānī
cale sahit śrī sar dhanu pānī

verses.sa:
देखि राम रिपुदल चलि आवा ।
बिहसि कठिन कोदंड चढ़ावा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām ripudal cali āvā
bihasi kaṭhin kodaṃḍ car̤hāvā

verses.sa:
कोदंड कठिन चढ़ाइ सिर जट जूट बाँधत सोह क्यों ।
मरकत सयल पर लरत दामिनि कोटि सों जुग भुजग ज्यों ॥
verses.tr:
kodaṃḍ kaṭhin car̤hāi sir jaṭ jūṭ bām̐dhat soh kyoṃ
marakat sayal par larat dāmini koṭi soṃ jug bhujag jyoṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: कटि कसि निषंग बिसाल भुज गहि चाप बिसिख सुधारि कै ॥
verses.tr: kaṭi kasi niṣaṃg bisāl bhuj gahi cāp bisikh sudhāri kai

verses.sa: चितवत मनहुँ मृगराज प्रभु गजराज घटा निहारि कै ॥
verses.tr: citavat manahum̐ mṛgarāj prabhu gajarāj ghaṭā nihāri kai

verses.sa:
आइ गए बगमेल धरहु धरहु धावत सुभट ।
जथा बिलोकि अकेल बाल रबिहि घेरत दनुज ॥
verses.tr:
āi gae bagamel dharahu dharahu dhāvat subhaṭ
jathā biloki akel bāl rabihi gherat danuj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: nose and ears: her hands he sent to Ravan in defiance. Chaupdi.

Without nose and ears she was as hideous to look upon as a mountain flowing with torrents of red ochre. She went moaning to Khara and Dushan; “A curse, a curse, I say, on your manhood and strength, brother.” They questioned and she told them all. When they heard, the demons gathered an army, and a swarming multitude of fiends rushed forth like so many winged mountains of darkness, on diverse vehicles, of diverse shapes, armed with diverse weapons, terrible and beyond number. At the head went Siurpa-nakhe in hideous guise, without ears and nose. Many fearful omens of ill occurred, but the host heeded them not, being all death-doomed. They shouted, they defied the enemy, they leaped in the air, their captains inspected the ranks and rejoiced exceedingly. Said one, ‘Capture the two brothers alive and then take and kill] them and carry off the bride.’ The vault of heaven was filled with the dust of them. Rama called his brother and said: “Take Janaki away to some mountain-cave; a terrible array of demons has come; remain on your guard.” Obedient to his lord’s command he took his bow and arrows in hand and led Sita away. When Rama saw that the hostile force had drawn near, he smiled as he strung his massive bow.

As he strung his massive bow and bound up his long hair in a knot on his head, he seemed as it were a sapphire rock encircled with flushes of lightning and with two) snakes entwining its sammit. As the Lord girded up his: quiver by his side and clasped the bow in his mighty arm. and fitted the arrow to the string, he glared with the glance: of a lion on a herd of elephants. Sorathd 6.
