sections.label: Doha 19
sections.name: सावधान होइ धाए जानि सबल आराति

verses.sa:
प्रभु बिलोकि सर सकहिं न डारी ।
थकित भई रजनीचर धारी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu biloki sar sakahiṃ na ḍārī
thakit bhaī rajanīcar dhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सचिव बोलि बोले खर दूषन ।
यह कोउ नृपबालक नर भूषन ॥
verses.tr:
saciv boli bole khar dūṣan
yah kou nṛpabālak nar bhūṣan

verses.sa:
नाग असुर सुर नर मुनि जेते ।
देखे जिते हते हम केते ॥
verses.tr:
nāg asur sur nar muni jete
dekhe jite hate ham kete

verses.sa:
हम भरि जन्म सुनहु सब भाई ।
देखी नहिं असि सुंदरताई ॥
verses.tr:
ham bhari janm sunahu sab bhāī
dekhī nahiṃ asi suṃdaratāī

verses.sa:
जद्यपि भगिनी कीन्ह कुरूपा ।
बध लायक नहिं पुरुष अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi bhaginī kīnh kurūpā
badh lāyak nahiṃ puruṣ anūpā

verses.sa:
देहु तुरत निज नारि दुराई ।
जीअत भवन जाहु द्वौ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
dehu turat nij nāri durāī
jīat bhavan jāhu dvau bhāī

verses.sa:
मोर कहा तुम्ह ताहि सुनावहु ।
तासु बचन सुनि आतुर आवहु ॥
verses.tr:
mor kahā tumh tāhi sunāvahu
tāsu bacan suni ātur āvahu

verses.sa:
दूतन्ह कहा राम सन जाई ।
सुनत राम बोले मुसकाई ॥
verses.tr:
dūtanh kahā rām san jāī
sunat rām bole musakāī

verses.sa:
हम छत्री मृगया बन करहीं ।
तुम्ह से खल मृग खौजत फिरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ham chatrī mṛgayā ban karahīṃ
tumh se khal mṛg khaujat phirahīṃ

verses.sa:
रिपु बलवंत देखि नहिं डरहीं ।
एक बार कालहु सन लरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ripu balavaṃt dekhi nahiṃ ḍarahīṃ
ek bār kālahu san larahīṃ

verses.sa:
जद्यपि मनुज दनुज कुल घालक ।
मुनि पालक खल सालक बालक ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi manuj danuj kul ghālak
muni pālak khal sālak bālak

verses.sa:
जौं न होइ बल घर फिरि जाहू ।
समर बिमुख मैं हतउँ न काहू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ na hoi bal ghar phiri jāhū
samar bimukh maiṃ hataum̐ na kāhū

verses.sa:
रन चढ़ि करिअ कपट चतुराई ।
रिपु पर कृपा परम कदराई ॥
verses.tr:
ran car̤hi karia kapaṭ caturāī
ripu par kṛpā param kadarāī

verses.sa:
दूतन्ह जाइ तुरत सब कहेऊ ।
सुनि खर दूषन उर अति दहेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
dūtanh jāi turat sab kaheū
suni khar dūṣan ur ati daheū

verses.sa:
उर दहेउ कहेउ कि धरहु धाए बिकट भट रजनीचरा ।
सर चाप तोमर सक्ति सूल कृपान परिघ परसु धरा ॥
verses.tr:
ur daheu kaheu ki dharahu dhāe bikaṭ bhaṭ rajanīcarā
sar cāp tomar sakti sūl kṛpān parigh parasu dharā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
प्रभु कीन्ह धनुष टकोर प्रथम कठोर घोर भयावहा ।
भए बधिर ब्याकुल जातुधान न ग्यान तेहि अवसर रहा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu kīnh dhanuṣ ṭakor pratham kaṭhor ghor bhayāvahā
bhae badhir byākul jātudhān na gyān tehi avasar rahā

verses.sa:
सावधान होइ धाए जानि सबल आराति ।
लागे बरषन राम पर अस्त्र सस्त्र बहु भाँति ॥
verses.tr:
sāvadhān hoi dhāe jāni sabal ārāti
lāge baraṣan rām par astr sastr bahu bhām̐ti
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
तिन्ह के आयुध तिल सम करि काटे रघुबीर ।
तानि सरासन श्रवन लगि पुनि छाँड़े निज तीर ॥
verses.tr:
tinh ke āyudh til sam kari kāṭe raghubīr
tāni sarāsan śravan lagi puni chām̐r̤e nij tīr

trans: And at the sight of his majesty they could not discharge their arrows; the whole demon host became powerless. Khara and Dishan summoned their minister and said: “This ornament of the human race must be some king's son. Nagas, demons, gods, men and saints of all sorts I have seen, conquered and slain; but in the whole of my life—mark me my brethren all—I have never seen such beauty. Though he has disfigured my sister, so incomparable a hero is not worthy of death. ‘At once put away and surrender your bride and return home alive, you and your brother.’ Declare tc him this that I have said and quickly come back with his answer.” The heralds went and told Rama. He smiled to hear them and said: “I am a warrior by caste and am hunting this wood; wretches like you are the game that I am tracking. I am not dismayed at the sight of the enemy’s strength, but am ready to do combat with death himself. Though a man, I am the exterminator of the race of demons; and though a mere child I am the protector of the saints and the destroyer of the wicked. IE there is no strength ia you, turn and go home; I will never turn my back upon the battle. If you have come up to fight, show now your cunning and dexterity; mercy to an enemy is the height of weakness,” The heralds immediately went and repeated all this: Khara and Dushan’s heart was on fire when they heard it.

Their heart was on fire and they cried: ‘Rush upon him and seize him, ye mighty demon warriors, with your bows and arrows, clubs, pikes, spears, scymetars, maces and axes.” The lord gave his bow one twang; in a moment, at the awful and terrible sound the demons were deafencd and dismayed, they had no sense left in them.

When they had recovered themselves they made a rush, for they Knew the strength of their foe; and shafts and weapons of all kinds began to rain upon Rama. But Raghubir cleft them in twain, making them of no more account than so many sesamum seeds, and then drawing the bowstring to his ear he let fly his own arrows.

sections.label: Doha 20
sections.name: राम राम कहि तनु तजहिं पावहिं पद निर्बान

verses.sa: तब चले जान बबान कराल। फुंकरत जनु बहु ब्याल ॥
verses.tr: tab cale jān babān karāl phuṃkarat janu bahu byāl
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: कोपेउ समर श्रीराम। चले बिसिख निसित निकाम ॥
verses.tr: kopeu samar śrīrām cale bisikh nisit nikām

verses.sa: अवलोकि खरतर तीर। मुरि चले निसिचर बीर ॥
verses.tr: avaloki kharatar tīr muri cale nisicar bīr

verses.sa: भए क्रुद्ध तीनिउ भाइ। जो भागि रन ते जाइ ॥
verses.tr: bhae kruddh tīniu bhāi jo bhāgi ran te jāi

verses.sa: तेहि बधब हम निज पानि। फिरे मरन मन महुँ ठानि ॥
verses.tr: tehi badhab ham nij pāni phire maran man mahum̐ ṭhāni

verses.sa: आयुध अनेक प्रकार। सनमुख ते करहिं प्रहार ॥
verses.tr: āyudh anek prakār sanamukh te karahiṃ prahār

verses.sa: रिपु परम कोपे जानि। प्रभु धनुष सर संधानि ॥
verses.tr: ripu param kope jāni prabhu dhanuṣ sar saṃdhāni

verses.sa: छाँड़े बिपुल नाराच। लगे कटन बिकट पिसाच ॥
verses.tr: chām̐r̤e bipul nārāc lage kaṭan bikaṭ pisāc

verses.sa: उर सीस भुज कर चरन। जहँ तहँ लगे महि परन ॥
verses.tr: ur sīs bhuj kar caran jaham̐ taham̐ lage mahi paran

verses.sa: चिक्करत लागत बान। धर परत कुधर समान ॥
verses.tr: cikkarat lāgat bān dhar parat kudhar samān

verses.sa: भट कटत तन सत खंड। पुनि उठत करि पाषंड ॥
verses.tr: bhaṭ kaṭat tan sat khaṃḍ puni uṭhat kari pāṣaṃḍ

verses.sa: नभ उड़त बहु भुज मुंड। बिनु मौलि धावत रुंड ॥
verses.tr: nabh ur̤at bahu bhuj muṃḍ binu mauli dhāvat ruṃḍ

verses.sa: खग कंक काक सृगाल। कटकटहिं कठिन कराल ॥
verses.tr: khag kaṃk kāk sṛgāl kaṭakaṭahiṃ kaṭhin karāl

verses.sa:
कटकटहिं ज़ंबुक भूत प्रेत पिसाच खर्पर संचहीं ।
बेताल बीर कपाल ताल बजाइ जोगिनि नंचहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭakaṭahiṃ zaṃbuk bhūt pret pisāc kharpar saṃcahīṃ
betāl bīr kapāl tāl bajāi jogini naṃcahīṃ

verses.sa:
रघुबीर बान प्रचंड खंडहिं भटन्ह के उर भुज सिरा ।
जहँ तहँ परहिं उठि लरहिं धर धरु धरु करहिं भयकर गिरा ॥
verses.tr:
raghubīr bān pracaṃḍ khaṃḍahiṃ bhaṭanh ke ur bhuj sirā
jaham̐ taham̐ parahiṃ uṭhi larahiṃ dhar dharu dharu karahiṃ bhayakar girā

verses.sa: अंतावरीं गहि उड़त गीध पिसाच कर गहि धावहीं ॥
verses.tr: aṃtāvarīṃ gahi ur̤at gīdh pisāc kar gahi dhāvahīṃ

verses.sa: संग्राम पुर बासी मनहुँ बहु बाल गुड़ी उड़ावहीं ॥
verses.tr: saṃgrām pur bāsī manahum̐ bahu bāl gur̤ī ur̤āvahīṃ

verses.sa:
मारे पछारे उर बिदारे बिपुल भट कहँरत परे ।
अवलोकि निज दल बिकल भट तिसिरादि खर दूषन फिरे ॥
verses.tr:
māre pachāre ur bidāre bipul bhaṭ kaham̐rat pare
avaloki nij dal bikal bhaṭ tisirādi khar dūṣan phire

verses.sa:
सर सक्ति तोमर परसु सूल कृपान एकहि बारहीं ।
करि कोप श्रीरघुबीर पर अगनित निसाचर डारहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sar sakti tomar parasu sūl kṛpān ekahi bārahīṃ
kari kop śrīraghubīr par aganit nisācar ḍārahīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रभु निमिष महुँ रिपु सर निवारि पचारि डारे सायका ।
दस दस बिसिख उर माझ मारे सकल निसिचर नायका ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu nimiṣ mahum̐ ripu sar nivāri pacāri ḍāre sāyakā
das das bisikh ur mājh māre sakal nisicar nāyakā

verses.sa:
महि परत उठि भट भिरत मरत न करत माया अति घनी ।
सुर डरत चौदह सहस प्रेत बिलोकि एक अवध धनी ॥
verses.tr:
mahi parat uṭhi bhaṭ bhirat marat na karat māyā ati ghanī
sur ḍarat caudah sahas pret biloki ek avadh dhanī

verses.sa:
सुर मुनि सभय प्रभु देखि मायानाथ अति कौतुक कर् यो ।
देखहि परसपर राम करि संग्राम रिपुदल लरि मर् यो ॥
verses.tr:
sur muni sabhaya prabhu dekhi māyānāth ati kautuk kar yo
dekhahi parasapar rām kari saṃgrām ripudal lari mar yo

verses.sa:
राम राम कहि तनु तजहिं पावहिं पद निर्बान ।
करि उपाय रिपु मारे छन महुँ कृपानिधान ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām kahi tanu tajahiṃ pāvahiṃ pad nirbān
kari upāya ripu māre chan mahum̐ kṛpānidhān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
हरषित बरषहिं सुमन सुर बाजहिं गगन निसान ।
अस्तुति करि करि सब चले सोभित बिबिध बिमान ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣit baraṣahiṃ suman sur bājahiṃ gagan nisān
astuti kari kari sab cale sobhit bibidh bimān

trans: Then the terrible arrows sped forth, hissing like many serpents. The holy Rama waxed wrath in battle; his arrows flew of exceeding sharpness, When they saw his shafts so keen, the demon leaders turned to flight; but the three brothers became furious; ‘Whoever runs from the field I will slay with my own hand; let him stay then and make up his mind to die.’ Weapons of diverse kinds beat upon him from the front, and the Lord perceiving that the foe was exceedingly furious fitted an arrow to his bow. He let fly the huge bolts; the hideous demons were cut to pieces; bodies, heads, arms, hands and feet were scattered about all over the ground. The shrill arrows struck; like mountains the bodies fall. The leaders had their frames cut into a hundred pieces, yet they stood up again by power of magic. Many arms and heads flew through the air and headless trunks ran to and fro. Kites, crows and Jackals made an awful and horrible wrangling.

Jackals wrangled; ghosts, goblins and demons made cups of the skulls; more warlike devils clashed skulls together for music, and witches danced. Raghubir's mighty arrows smote off the leaders’ bodies, arms and heads; they fell on every side, but stood up again to fight with terrible cries of ‘strike, strike.’ Vultures flew away with men’s entrails in their claws, goblins scampered off with hands that they had seized; one might fancy all the children of Battle-town were flying kites. The mighty champions lay dead and vanquished, with mangled bodies. Seeing their army routed, Khara and Dishan, with Trisira and the other champions, stood at bay, and all at once demons innumerable hurled furiously against Raghubir arrow and spear, club, axe, javelin and dagger. In the twinkling _of an eye the Lord had warded of all his enemies’ missiles and sent forth his own arrows, slaying all the demon leaders with ten shafts planted in the breast of each of them. Though they fell to the ground, they rose again in their: valour and joined in the fray, and would not die, but made: the strangest sight. The gods feared, when they saw the: demons fourteen thousand in number, and the king of Avadh alone; till the Lord perceiving alarm of gods and saints and having power over all illusion, wrought a prodigy, and while they were yet looking at one another he finished the battle, and the army of the enemy all perished fighting,

Crying ‘Rama, Rama,’ as their soul left their body; they thus attained beatitude. Ina mcement the Fountain of mercy slew all his enemies by magic. The gods in their joy rained down flowers instruments of music sounded in the air, and with cries of ‘Glory, glory,’ they all departed, each in his own splendid carriage.

sections.label: Doha 21
sections.name: रिपु रुज पावक पाप प्रभु अहि गनिअ न छोट करि

verses.sa:
जब रघुनाथ समर रिपु जीते ।
सुर नर मुनि सब के भय बीते ॥
verses.tr:
jab raghunāth samar ripu jīte
sur nar muni sab ke bhaya bīte
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब लछिमन सीतहि लै आए ।
प्रभु पद परत हरषि उर लाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab lachiman sītahi lai āe
prabhu pad parat haraṣi ur lāe

verses.sa:
सीता चितव स्याम मृदु गाता ।
परम प्रेम लोचन न अघाता ॥
verses.tr:
sītā citav syām mṛdu gātā
param prem locan na aghātā

verses.sa:
पंचवटीं बसि श्रीरघुनायक ।
करत चरित सुर मुनि सुखदायक ॥
verses.tr:
paṃcavaṭīṃ basi śrīraghunāyak
karat carit sur muni sukhadāyak

verses.sa:
धुआँ देखि खरदूषन केरा ।
जाइ सुपनखाँ रावन प्रेरा ॥
verses.tr:
dhuām̐ dekhi kharadūṣan kerā
jāi supanakhām̐ rāvan prerā

verses.sa:
बोलि बचन क्रोध करि भारी ।
देस कोस कै सुरति बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
boli bacan krodh kari bhārī
des kos kai surati bisārī

verses.sa:
करसि पान सोवसि दिनु राती ।
सुधि नहिं तव सिर पर आराती ॥
verses.tr:
karasi pān sovasi dinu rātī
sudhi nahiṃ tav sir par ārātī

verses.sa:
राज नीति बिनु धन बिनु धर्मा ।
हरिहि समर्पे बिनु सतकर्मा ॥
verses.tr:
rāj nīti binu dhan binu dharmā
harihi samarpe binu satakarmā

verses.sa:
बिद्या बिनु बिबेक उपजाएँ ।
श्रम फल पढ़े किएँ अरु पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
bidyā binu bibek upajāem̐
śram phal par̤he kiem̐ aru pāem̐

verses.sa:
संग ते जती कुमंत्र ते राजा ।
मान ते ग्यान पान तें लाजा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃg te jatī kumaṃtr te rājā
mān te gyān pān teṃ lājā

verses.sa:
प्रीति प्रनय बिनु मद ते गुनी ।
नासहि बेगि नीति अस सुनी ॥
verses.tr:
prīti pranaya binu mad te gunī
nāsahi begi nīti as sunī

verses.sa:
रिपु रुज पावक पाप प्रभु अहि गनिअ न छोट करि ।
अस कहि बिबिध बिलाप करि लागी रोदन करन ॥
verses.tr:
ripu ruj pāvak pāp prabhu ahi gania na choṭ kari
as kahi bibidh bilāp kari lāgī rodan karan
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सभा माझ परि ब्याकुल बहु प्रकार कह रोइ ।
तोहि जिअत दसकंधर मोरि कि असि गति होइ ॥
verses.tr:
sabhā mājh pari byākul bahu prakār kah roi
tohi jiat dasakaṃdhar mori ki asi gati hoi

trans: When Raghunath had vanquished his foes in the battle, gods, men and saints were all relieved from fear. Lakshman then brought back Sita. As she fell at her lord’s feet, he took and rapturously clasped her to his bosom, and she fixed her gaze upon his dark and delicate form, but so vehement was her love that her eyes could never be satisfied. Thus the blessed Rama stayed at Panchavati, delighting gods and saints by the deeds that he did. But Surpanakha, when she saw the death of Khara and Diishan, went and called Ravan. In tones full of fury ‘she cried: ‘“‘ You have lost all thought of realm and treasure; you drink and sleep day and night and do not consider that the enemy is at your gate. A kingdom without policy, wealth without religion, good works without con-secration to Hari, knowledge without discretion, these all bring no fruits save trouble to the student, the doer, or the possessor. An ascetic is quickly undone by attachment, a king by ill-counsel, wisdom by conceit, modesty by drinking, friendship by want of consideration, and good sense by pride: so goes the saying.
An enemy, sickness, fire, sin, a master and a serpent are never to be accounted trifles.’ So saying and with much lamentation beside she set to weeping.
Tn her distress she threw herself down in the midst of the assembly with many tears and cries, “O Ravan, to think that you should live and see ‘me thus treated?”

sections.label: Doha 22
sections.name: सुपनखहि समुझाइ करि बल बोलेसि बहु भाँति

verses.sa:
सुनत सभासद उठे अकुलाई ।
समुझाई गहि बाहँ उठाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunat sabhāsad uṭhe akulāī
samujhāī gahi bāham̐ uṭhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कह लंकेस कहसि निज बाता ।
केंइँ तव नासा कान निपाता ॥
verses.tr:
kah laṃkes kahasi nij bātā
keṃim̐ tav nāsā kān nipātā

verses.sa:
अवध नृपति दसरथ के जाए ।
पुरुष सिंघ बन खेलन आए ॥
verses.tr:
avadh nṛpati dasarath ke jāe
puruṣ siṃgh ban khelan āe

verses.sa:
समुझि परी मोहि उन्ह कै करनी ।
रहित निसाचर करिहहिं धरनी ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi parī mohi unh kai karanī
rahit nisācar karihahiṃ dharanī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कर भुजबल पाइ दसानन ।
अभय भए बिचरत मुनि कानन ॥
verses.tr:
jinh kar bhujabal pāi dasānan
abhaya bhae bicarat muni kānan

verses.sa:
देखत बालक काल समाना ।
परम धीर धन्वी गुन नाना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat bālak kāl samānā
param dhīr dhanvī gun nānā

verses.sa:
अतुलित बल प्रताप द्वौ भ्राता ।
खल बध रत सुर मुनि सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
atulit bal pratāp dvau bhrātā
khal badh rat sur muni sukhadātā

verses.sa:
सोभाधाम राम अस नामा ।
तिन्ह के संग नारि एक स्यामा ॥
verses.tr:
sobhādhām rām as nāmā
tinh ke saṃg nāri ek syāmā

verses.sa:
रुप रासि बिधि नारि सँवारी ।
रति सत कोटि तासु बलिहारी ॥
verses.tr:
rup rāsi bidhi nāri sam̐vārī
rati sat koṭi tāsu balihārī

verses.sa:
तासु अनुज काटे श्रुति नासा ।
सुनि तव भगिनि करहिं परिहासा ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu anuj kāṭe śruti nāsā
suni tav bhagini karahiṃ parihāsā

verses.sa:
खर दूषन सुनि लगे पुकारा ।
छन महुँ सकल कटक उन्ह मारा ॥
verses.tr:
khar dūṣan suni lage pukārā
chan mahum̐ sakal kaṭak unh mārā

verses.sa:
खर दूषन तिसिरा कर घाता ।
सुनि दससीस जरे सब गाता ॥
verses.tr:
khar dūṣan tisirā kar ghātā
suni dasasīs jare sab gātā

verses.sa:
सुपनखहि समुझाइ करि बल बोलेसि बहु भाँति ।
गयउ भवन अति सोचबस नीद परइ नहिं राति ॥
verses.tr:
supanakhahi samujhāi kari bal bolesi bahu bhām̐ti
gayau bhavan ati socabas nīd parai nahiṃ rāti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When they heard this, the assembly rose in confusion and took her by the hand and lifted her up and consoled her. Said the king of Lanka: ‘Why do you not tell me what has happened? who has cut off your nose and ears?” ** The sons of Dasarath, the lord of Avadh, very lions of men, have come to hunt the forest. I understood that they were about; they would rid the earth of demons. Relying on the might of their arm, O Ravan, the saints roam the woods without any fear. They are children to look at, but in fact resistless as Death himself, the most intrepid of archers, with many strings to their bow. Both brothers are glorious with incomparable might, and have devoted themselves to the extermination of the wicked and the relief of gods and suints. KRamwa—for such. is his name —is the very perfection of beauty, and with him isa young girl, whom the Creator has made the loveliest of the sex: a hundred million Rati would be no match for her. It is his younger brother who cut off my ears and nose and made a mock of me, when he heard I was your sister. When Khara and Dishan were told of this, they gave him challenge; but in an instant he slew the whole of their army.” When he heard of the defeat of Khara, Dushan and Trisira, the Ten-headed was on fire all over.
After consoling Stirpa-nakhe and forcing himself to say much to her, he went to his palace in a great state of anxiety and had no sleep all night.

sections.label: Doha 23
sections.name: लछिमन गए बनहिं जब लेन मूल फल कंद

verses.sa:
सुर नर असुर नाग खग माहीं ।
मोरे अनुचर कहँ कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sur nar asur nāg khag māhīṃ
more anucar kaham̐ kou nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
खर दूषन मोहि सम बलवंता ।
तिन्हहि को मारइ बिनु भगवंता ॥
verses.tr:
khar dūṣan mohi sam balavaṃtā
tinhahi ko mārai binu bhagavaṃtā

verses.sa:
सुर रंजन भंजन महि भारा ।
जौं भगवंत लीन्ह अवतारा ॥
verses.tr:
sur raṃjan bhaṃjan mahi bhārā
jauṃ bhagavaṃt līnh avatārā

verses.sa:
तौ मै जाइ बैरु हठि करऊँ ।
प्रभु सर प्रान तजें भव तरऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
tau mai jāi bairu haṭhi karaūm̐
prabhu sar prān tajeṃ bhav taraūm̐

verses.sa:
होइहि भजनु न तामस देहा ।
मन क्रम बचन मंत्र दृढ़ एहा ॥
verses.tr:
hoihi bhajanu na tāmas dehā
man kram bacan maṃtr dṛr̤h ehā

verses.sa:
जौं नररुप भूपसुत कोऊ ।
हरिहउँ नारि जीति रन दोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nararup bhūpasut koū
harihaum̐ nāri jīti ran doū

verses.sa:
चला अकेल जान चढि तहवाँ ।
बस मारीच सिंधु तट जहवाँ ॥
verses.tr:
calā akel jān caḍhi tahavām̐
bas mārīc siṃdhu taṭ jahavām̐

verses.sa:
इहाँ राम जसि जुगुति बनाई ।
सुनहु उमा सो कथा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ rām jasi juguti banāī
sunahu umā so kathā suhāī

verses.sa:
लछिमन गए बनहिं जब लेन मूल फल कंद ।
जनकसुता सन बोले बिहसि कृपा सुख बृंद ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman gae banahiṃ jab len mūl phal kaṃd
janakasutā san bole bihasi kṛpā sukh bṛṃd
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘“ Among gods, men and demons, serpents and birds, there is none who can withstand my servants; and Khara and Dushan were my own equals in strength; who can have killed them, unless it be God himself? If God has become incarnate, in order to rejoice the saints and relieve earth of its burden, then if I go and fight against him and lose my life by an arrow of the Lord’s, I shall escape further transmigration; prayer will not do for one like me of demon form; thisis the plan upon which I am absolutely determined. If he is only some earthly king’s son, I shall conquer them both in battle and carry off the bride.” He mounted his chariot and went off alone to the spot where Maricha was living by the sea-shore. Hearken now, Uma, to the delectable account of the device that Rama iovented.
When Lakshman had gone into the wood to gather roots, fruits and herbs, the gentle and joyous god said with a smile to Janak’s daughter:

sections.label: Doha 24
sections.name: करि पूजा मारीच तब सादर पूछी बात

verses.sa:
सुनहु प्रिया ब्रत रुचिर सुसीला ।
मैं कछु करबि ललित नरलीला ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu priyā brat rucir susīlā
maiṃ kachu karabi lalit naralīlā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तुम्ह पावक महुँ करहु निवासा ।
जौ लगि करौं निसाचर नासा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh pāvak mahum̐ karahu nivāsā
jau lagi karauṃ nisācar nāsā

verses.sa:
जबहिं राम सब कहा बखानी ।
प्रभु पद धरि हियँ अनल समानी ॥
verses.tr:
jabahiṃ rām sab kahā bakhānī
prabhu pad dhari hiyam̐ anal samānī

verses.sa:
निज प्रतिबिंब राखि तहँ सीता ।
तैसइ सील रुप सुबिनीता ॥
verses.tr:
nij pratibiṃb rākhi taham̐ sītā
taisai sīl rup subinītā

verses.sa:
लछिमनहूँ यह मरमु न जाना ।
जो कछु चरित रचा भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
lachimanahūm̐ yah maramu na jānā
jo kachu carit racā bhagavānā

verses.sa:
दसमुख गयउ जहाँ मारीचा ।
नाइ माथ स्वारथ रत नीचा ॥
verses.tr:
dasamukh gayau jahām̐ mārīcā
nāi māth svārath rat nīcā

verses.sa:
नवनि नीच कै अति दुखदाई ।
जिमि अंकुस धनु उरग बिलाई ॥
verses.tr:
navani nīc kai ati dukhadāī
jimi aṃkus dhanu urag bilāī

verses.sa:
भयदायक खल कै प्रिय बानी ।
जिमि अकाल के कुसुम भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhayadāyak khal kai priya bānī
jimi akāl ke kusum bhavānī

verses.sa:
करि पूजा मारीच तब सादर पूछी बात ।
कवन हेतु मन ब्यग्र अति अकसर आयहु तात ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā mārīc tab sādar pūchī bāt
kavan hetu man byagr ati akasar āyahu tāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘“‘ Hearken, most lovely and amiable of faithful wives, I am going to act a fantastic human part. Be you absorbed into fire until I have completed the destruction of the demons.” As soon as Rama had finished speaking she pressed her lord’s feet to her heart and entered into the fire, leaving only an image of herself, of exactly the same appearance and the same amiable and gentle disposition. Lakshman did not know this mystery or that the god had taken any action. The Ten-headed approached Maericha and bowed his head, the selfish and contemptible wretch. When a mean creature bends, it is only to give more pain, like an elephant-goad, a bow, a snake, or a cat; the friendly speech of a churl] is as portentous, Bhavani, as flowers that blossom out of season.
After doing him homage, Maricha respectfully enquired of him his business: ‘What is the cause, my son, that you have come so disturbed in mind and all alone?”

sections.label: Doha 25
sections.name: जेहिं ताड़का सुबाहु हति खंडेउ हर कोदंड

verses.sa:
दसमुख सकल कथा तेहि आगें ।
कही सहित अभिमान अभागें ॥
verses.tr:
dasamukh sakal kathā tehi āgeṃ
kahī sahit abhimān abhāgeṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
होहु कपट मृग तुम्ह छलकारी ।
जेहि बिधि हरि आनौ नृपनारी ॥
verses.tr:
hohu kapaṭ mṛg tumh chalakārī
jehi bidhi hari ānau nṛpanārī

verses.sa:
तेहिं पुनि कहा सुनहु दससीसा ।
ते नररुप चराचर ईसा ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ puni kahā sunahu dasasīsā
te nararup carācar īsā

verses.sa:
तासों तात बयरु नहिं कीजे ।
मारें मरिअ जिआएँ जीजै ॥
verses.tr:
tāsoṃ tāt bayaru nahiṃ kīje
māreṃ maria jiāem̐ jījai

verses.sa:
मुनि मख राखन गयउ कुमारा ।
बिनु फर सर रघुपति मोहि मारा ॥
verses.tr:
muni makh rākhan gayau kumārā
binu phar sar raghupati mohi mārā

verses.sa:
सत जोजन आयउँ छन माहीं ।
तिन्ह सन बयरु किएँ भल नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sat jojan āyaum̐ chan māhīṃ
tinh san bayaru kiem̐ bhal nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भइ मम कीट भृंग की नाई ।
जहँ तहँ मैं देखउँ दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhai mam kīṭ bhṛṃg kī nāī
jaham̐ taham̐ maiṃ dekhaum̐ dou bhāī

verses.sa:
जौं नर तात तदपि अति सूरा ।
तिन्हहि बिरोधि न आइहि पूरा ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nar tāt tadapi ati sūrā
tinhahi birodhi na āihi pūrā

verses.sa: जेहिं ताड़का सुबाहु हति खंडेउ हर कोदंड ॥
verses.tr: jehiṃ tār̤akā subāhu hati khaṃḍeu har kodaṃḍ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: खर दूषन तिसिरा बधेउ मनुज कि अस बरिबंड ॥
verses.tr: khar dūṣan tisirā badheu manuj ki as baribaṃḍ

trans: Ravan put the whole matter before him and added presumptuously —the wretch—‘ Do you for the purpose of deception assumed the form of a deer, and by this means, I shall be able to carry off the princess.” He replied:-— “Hearken, Ravan; though in form as a man, this is the Lord of all animate and inanimate creation; there is no fighting against him, my son; if he kills, you die; and if you live, it is he who gives you life. He is the prince Raghupati, who when he went to protect the saint's sacrifice, smote me with a pointless arrow, and in an instant

_ was driven a distance of a hundred leagues: it is not well to quarrel with him. Wherever I look, I see these two brothers, and my senses are utterly bewildered like fly fascinated by a spider. Even if he be only a man my on, he is a tremendous hero, and opposition to him will lo no good.
- Bat can he possibly be a man, who was strong enough © vanquish Teraka and Subehn, who broke Siva’s bow and slew Khara, Dushan and Trisira?

sections.label: Doha 26
sections.name: मम पाछें धर धावत धरें सरासन बान

verses.sa:
जाहु भवन कुल कुसल बिचारी ।
सुनत जरा दीन्हिसि बहु गारी ॥
verses.tr:
jāhu bhavan kul kusal bicārī
sunat jarā dīnhisi bahu gārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गुरु जिमि मूढ़ करसि मम बोधा ।
कहु जग मोहि समान को जोधा ॥
verses.tr:
guru jimi mūr̤h karasi mam bodhā
kahu jag mohi samān ko jodhā

verses.sa:
तब मारीच हृदयँ अनुमाना ।
नवहि बिरोधें नहिं कल्याना ॥
verses.tr:
tab mārīc hṛdayam̐ anumānā
navahi birodheṃ nahiṃ kalyānā

verses.sa:
सस्त्री मर्मी प्रभु सठ धनी ।
बैद बंदि कबि भानस गुनी ॥
verses.tr:
sastrī marmī prabhu saṭh dhanī
baid baṃdi kabi bhānas gunī

verses.sa:
उभय भाँति देखा निज मरना ।
तब ताकिसि रघुनायक सरना ॥
verses.tr:
ubhaya bhām̐ti dekhā nij maranā
tab tākisi raghunāyak saranā

verses.sa:
उतरु देत मोहि बधब अभागें ।
कस न मरौं रघुपति सर लागें ॥
verses.tr:
utaru det mohi badhab abhāgeṃ
kas na marauṃ raghupati sar lāgeṃ

verses.sa:
अस जियँ जानि दसानन संगा ।
चला राम पद प्रेम अभंगा ॥
verses.tr:
as jiyam̐ jāni dasānan saṃgā
calā rām pad prem abhaṃgā

verses.sa:
मन अति हरष जनाव न तेही ।
आजु देखिहउँ परम सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
man ati haraṣ janāv na tehī
āju dekhihaum̐ param sanehī

verses.sa:
निज परम प्रीतम देखि लोचन सुफल करि सुख पाइहौं ।
श्री सहित अनुज समेत कृपानिकेत पद मन लाइहौं ॥
verses.tr:
nij param prītam dekhi locan suphal kari sukh pāihauṃ
śrī sahit anuj samet kṛpāniket pad man lāihauṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
निर्बान दायक क्रोध जा कर भगति अबसहि बसकरी ।
निज पानि सर संधानि सो मोहि बधिहि सुखसागर हरी ॥
verses.tr:
nirbān dāyak krodh jā kar bhagati abasahi basakarī
nij pāni sar saṃdhāni so mohi badhihi sukhasāgar harī

verses.sa:
मम पाछें धर धावत धरें सरासन बान ।
फिरि फिरि प्रभुहि बिलोकिहउँ धन्य न मो सम आन ॥
verses.tr:
mam pācheṃ dhar dhāvat dhareṃ sarāsan bān
phiri phiri prabhuhi bilokihaum̐ dhanya na mo sam ān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Consider the welfare of your family and go home.” When 1@ heard this, he was furious and abused him soundly: ‘You fool, you take upon yourself to teach me, as if you were my master!. Tell me where is there in the world any warrior my equal?” Mericha then thought to himself: ‘There are nine whom it is not good to make enemies; an armed man, an accomplice, a king, a man without principle, a rich man, a physician, a panegyrist, poet or any person of special ability.’ Either way he saw he must die; at he reflected that Rama would be his sanctuary. So he answered: ‘You will be the death of me, poor wretch; or how can I escape when smitten by Raghupati’s shaft?” Nith these thoughts at heart, he accompanied Ravan, staunch in his devotion to Rama's feet and with an exceed- 1g gladness of heart that he would not show: ‘To-day shall behold my best beloved.

My eyes will be rewarded with the sight of my best beloved, and I shall be happy. I shall imprint upon my pul the feet of the All-merciful with Sita too and his brother. Hari, the ocean of beatitude, whose very wrath confers salvation, who gives himself up entirely to the will of his worshippers, will] with his own hands fit an arrow to the string and slay me.
As he runs after me to seize me with his bow and ‘arrows, I shall ever and again turn and get a sight of my rd: there is none else so blessed as I am.”

sections.label: Doha 27
sections.name: बिपुल सुमन सुर बरषहिं गावहिं प्रभु गुन गाथ

verses.sa:
तेहि बन निकट दसानन गयऊ ।
तब मारीच कपटमृग भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tehi ban nikaṭ dasānan gayaū
tab mārīc kapaṭamṛg bhayaū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अति बिचित्र कछु बरनि न जाई ।
कनक देह मनि रचित बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
ati bicitr kachu barani na jāī
kanak deh mani racit banāī

verses.sa:
सीता परम रुचिर मृग देखा ।
अंग अंग सुमनोहर बेषा ॥
verses.tr:
sītā param rucir mṛg dekhā
aṃg aṃg sumanohar beṣā

verses.sa:
सुनहु देव रघुबीर कृपाला ।
एहि मृग कर अति सुंदर छाला ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu dev raghubīr kṛpālā
ehi mṛg kar ati suṃdar chālā

verses.sa:
सत्यसंध प्रभु बधि करि एही ।
आनहु चर्म कहति बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
satyasaṃdh prabhu badhi kari ehī
ānahu carm kahati baidehī

verses.sa:
तब रघुपति जानत सब कारन ।
उठे हरषि सुर काजु सँवारन ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghupati jānat sab kāran
uṭhe haraṣi sur kāju sam̐vāran

verses.sa:
मृग बिलोकि कटि परिकर बाँधा ।
करतल चाप रुचिर सर साँधा ॥
verses.tr:
mṛg biloki kaṭi parikar bām̐dhā
karatal cāp rucir sar sām̐dhā

verses.sa:
प्रभु लछिमनिहि कहा समुझाई ।
फिरत बिपिन निसिचर बहु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu lachimanihi kahā samujhāī
phirat bipin nisicar bahu bhāī

verses.sa:
सीता केरि करेहु रखवारी ।
बुधि बिबेक बल समय बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
sītā keri karehu rakhavārī
budhi bibek bal samaya bicārī

verses.sa:
प्रभुहि बिलोकि चला मृग भाजी ।
धाए रामु सरासन साजी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhuhi biloki calā mṛg bhājī
dhāe rāmu sarāsan sājī

verses.sa:
निगम नेति सिव ध्यान न पावा ।
मायामृग पाछें सो धावा ॥
verses.tr:
nigam neti siv dhyān na pāvā
māyāmṛg pācheṃ so dhāvā

verses.sa:
कबहुँ निकट पुनि दूरि पराई ।
कबहुँक प्रगटइ कबहुँ छपाई ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐ nikaṭ puni dūri parāī
kabahum̐k pragaṭai kabahum̐ chapāī

verses.sa:
प्रगटत दुरत करत छल भूरी ।
एहि बिधि प्रभुहि गयउ लै दूरी ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭat durat karat chal bhūrī
ehi bidhi prabhuhi gayau lai dūrī

verses.sa:
तब तकि राम कठिन सर मारा ।
धरनि परेउ करि घोर पुकारा ॥
verses.tr:
tab taki rām kaṭhin sar mārā
dharani pareu kari ghor pukārā

verses.sa:
लछिमन कर प्रथमहिं लै नामा ।
पाछें सुमिरेसि मन महुँ रामा ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman kar prathamahiṃ lai nāmā
pācheṃ sumiresi man mahum̐ rāmā

verses.sa:
प्रान तजत प्रगटेसि निज देहा ।
सुमिरेसि रामु समेत सनेहा ॥
verses.tr:
prān tajat pragaṭesi nij dehā
sumiresi rāmu samet sanehā

verses.sa:
अंतर प्रेम तासु पहिचाना ।
मुनि दुर्लभ गति दीन्हि सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
aṃtar prem tāsu pahicānā
muni durlabh gati dīnhi sujānā

verses.sa:
बिपुल सुमन सुर बरषहिं गावहिं प्रभु गुन गाथ ।
निज पद दीन्ह असुर कहुँ दीनबंधु रघुनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
bipul suman sur baraṣahiṃ gāvahiṃ prabhu gun gāth
nij pad dīnh asur kahum̐ dīnabaṃdhu raghunāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the Ten-headed drew near to the wood, Mericha took the form of a deer, so beautifully spotted as to defy description, with a body of gold, all bespangled with jewels. When Sita saw the wonderously beautiful creature clothed with loveliness in its every limb, she cried: “O Raghubir, hearken, kind sir, this deer has a most charming skin; I pray you, shoot it, most amiable lord, and bring me the hide.” Thereupon Rama, who understood the meaning of it all, arose with joy to execute the purpose of the gods, Having marked the deer, he girded up his waistbelt, took his bow in his hand and trimmed his shapely arrows. Then the lord cautioned Lakshman: ‘“ Many demons, brother, roam the forest; take care of Sita with all thought and consideration and with force too, if occasion require it.” The deer seeing the Lord, took to flight: Rama pursued with ready bow: even he, to whom the Veda cannot attain, nor Siva is able to contemplate, hastened in pursuit of a mimic deer. Now close at hand, now fleeing at a distance, at one time in sight, at another hid, alternately showing and concealing itself and practising every kind of wile, in this manner it took the Lord far away. At last Rama aimed and let fly the fatal shaft; the deer fell to the ground with a terrible cry, first calling aloud to Lakshman, but afterwards mentally invoking Rama. As life ebbed, he resumed his natural form and devoutly repeated the name of Rama, who in his wisdom recognizing his ioward Love, gave him such a place in heaven as saints can scarcely attain to.
The gods rained. down abundant flowers and hymned the. Lord’s high virtue: “Raghunath, the suppliant’s friend, raises to his own sphere even a demon |”

sections.label: Doha 28
sections.name: क्रोधवंत तब रावन लीन्हिसि रथ बैठाइ

verses.sa:
खल बधि तुरत फिरे रघुबीरा ।
सोह चाप कर कटि तूनीरा ॥
verses.tr:
khal badhi turat phire raghubīrā
soh cāp kar kaṭi tūnīrā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आरत गिरा सुनी जब सीता ।
कह लछिमन सन परम सभीता ॥
verses.tr:
ārat girā sunī jab sītā
kah lachiman san param sabhītā

verses.sa:
जाहु बेगि संकट अति भ्राता ।
लछिमन बिहसि कहा सुनु माता ॥
verses.tr:
jāhu begi saṃkaṭ ati bhrātā
lachiman bihasi kahā sunu mātā

verses.sa:
भृकुटि बिलास सृष्टि लय होई ।
सपनेहुँ संकट परइ कि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
bhṛkuṭi bilās sṛṣṭi laya hoī
sapanehum̐ saṃkaṭ parai ki soī

verses.sa:
मरम बचन जब सीता बोला ।
हरि प्रेरित लछिमन मन डोला ॥
verses.tr:
maram bacan jab sītā bolā
hari prerit lachiman man ḍolā

verses.sa:
बन दिसि देव सौंपि सब काहू ।
चले जहाँ रावन ससि राहू ॥
verses.tr:
ban disi dev sauṃpi sab kāhū
cale jahām̐ rāvan sasi rāhū

verses.sa:
सून बीच दसकंधर देखा ।
आवा निकट जती कें बेषा ॥
verses.tr:
sūn bīc dasakaṃdhar dekhā
āvā nikaṭ jatī keṃ beṣā

verses.sa:
जाकें डर सुर असुर डेराहीं ।
निसि न नीद दिन अन्न न खाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jākeṃ ḍar sur asur ḍerāhīṃ
nisi na nīd din ann na khāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सो दससीस स्वान की नाई ।
इत उत चितइ चला भड़िहाई ॥
verses.tr:
so dasasīs svān kī nāī
it ut citai calā bhar̤ihāī

verses.sa:
इमि कुपंथ पग देत खगेसा ।
रह न तेज बुधि बल लेसा ॥
verses.tr:
imi kupaṃth pag det khagesā
rah na tej budhi bal lesā

verses.sa:
नाना बिधि करि कथा सुहाई ।
राजनीति भय प्रीति देखाई ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bidhi kari kathā suhāī
rājanīti bhaya prīti dekhāī

verses.sa:
कह सीता सुनु जती गोसाईं ।
बोलेहु बचन दुष्ट की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
kah sītā sunu jatī gosāīṃ
bolehu bacan duṣṭ kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
तब रावन निज रूप देखावा ।
भई सभय जब नाम सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab rāvan nij rūp dekhāvā
bhaī sabhaya jab nām sunāvā

verses.sa:
कह सीता धरि धीरजु गाढ़ा ।
आइ गयउ प्रभु रहु खल ठाढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
kah sītā dhari dhīraju gār̤hā
āi gayau prabhu rahu khal ṭhār̤hā

verses.sa:
जिमि हरिबधुहि छुद्र सस चाहा ।
भएसि कालबस निसिचर नाहा ॥
verses.tr:
jimi haribadhuhi chudr sas cāhā
bhaesi kālabas nisicar nāhā

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन दससीस रिसाना ।
मन महुँ चरन बंदि सुख माना ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan dasasīs risānā
man mahum̐ caran baṃdi sukh mānā

verses.sa:
क्रोधवंत तब रावन लीन्हिसि रथ बैठाइ ।
चला गगनपथ आतुर भयँ रथ हाँकि न जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
krodhavaṃt tab rāvan līnhisi rath baiṭhāi
calā gaganapath ātur bhayam̐ rath hām̐ki na jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As soon as he bad slain the monster, Raghubir returned; the bow gleaming in his hand and the quiver by his side. When Sita heard the agonizing cry, she called to Lakshman in the greatest alarm: ‘Go in haste, your brother is in some sad strait.” Lakshman answered with a smile. “Hearken, mother; he, by the play of whose eyebrows the world is annihilated, cannot be imagined as having fallen into any difficulty.’ But when Sita urged him with taunt-ing words, Lakshman’s resolution such was Hari’s will

—was shaken; he made over charge of everything to the Forest. and its gods, and went after the Rehu of the moonlike Ravan. When the Ten-headed saw the ground vacant he drew near in the guise of an anchorite. He, for fear of whom gods and demons trembled and could neither sleep by night nor eat food by day, even that Ravan came looking this side and that, as furtively as a cur bent on thieving. After he had turned his steps, GarAr, to this vile course, not a particle of his majesty, or intellect, or strength of body was left in him. After repeating a variety of legends and moral sentiments, he had recourse to threats and blandishments. Said Sita, ““Hearken, reverend Father; what you say is hateful to me.’ Then Ravan showed himself in bis proper form; and she was terror-stricken when he declared his name. But placking up all her courage she said: “Wretch, stay as you are; my lord is at hand. Like asa hare that would wed a lioness, so have you wooed your own destruction, O demon king.” On hearing this speech the Ten-headed was furious, though in his heart he delighted to adore her feet. Dohd 24.
Ravan angrily seized her and seated her in his chariot. As he took his way through the air, he was so agitated with fear that he could scarcely drive.

sections.label: Doha 29
sections.name: हारि परा खल बहु बिधि भय अरु प्रीति देखाइ

verses.sa:
हा जग एक बीर रघुराया ।
केहिं अपराध बिसारेहु दाया ॥
verses.tr:
hā jag ek bīr raghurāyā
kehiṃ aparādh bisārehu dāyā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आरति हरन सरन सुखदायक ।
हा रघुकुल सरोज दिननायक ॥
verses.tr:
ārati haran saran sukhadāyak
hā raghukul saroj dinanāyak

verses.sa:
हा लछिमन तुम्हार नहिं दोसा ।
सो फलु पायउँ कीन्हेउँ रोसा ॥
verses.tr:
hā lachiman tumhār nahiṃ dosā
so phalu pāyaum̐ kīnheum̐ rosā

verses.sa:
बिबिध बिलाप करति बैदेही ।
भूरि कृपा प्रभु दूरि सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bilāp karati baidehī
bhūri kṛpā prabhu dūri sanehī

verses.sa:
बिपति मोरि को प्रभुहि सुनावा ।
पुरोडास चह रासभ खावा ॥
verses.tr:
bipati mori ko prabhuhi sunāvā
puroḍās cah rāsabh khāvā

verses.sa:
सीता कै बिलाप सुनि भारी ।
भए चराचर जीव दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
sītā kai bilāp suni bhārī
bhae carācar jīv dukhārī

verses.sa:
गीधराज सुनि आरत बानी ।
रघुकुलतिलक नारि पहिचानी ॥
verses.tr:
gīdharāj suni ārat bānī
raghukulatilak nāri pahicānī

verses.sa:
अधम निसाचर लीन्हे जाई ।
जिमि मलेछ बस कपिला गाई ॥
verses.tr:
adham nisācar līnhe jāī
jimi malech bas kapilā gāī

verses.sa:
सीते पुत्रि करसि जनि त्रासा ।
करिहउँ जातुधान कर नासा ॥
verses.tr:
sīte putri karasi jani trāsā
karihaum̐ jātudhān kar nāsā

verses.sa:
धावा क्रोधवंत खग कैसें ।
छूटइ पबि परबत कहुँ जैसे ॥
verses.tr:
dhāvā krodhavaṃt khag kaiseṃ
chūṭai pabi parabat kahum̐ jaise

verses.sa:
रे रे दुष्ट ठाढ़ किन होही ।
निर्भय चलेसि न जानेहि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
re re duṣṭ ṭhār̤h kin hohī
nirbhaya calesi na jānehi mohī

verses.sa:
आवत देखि कृतांत समाना ।
फिरि दसकंधर कर अनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dekhi kṛtāṃt samānā
phiri dasakaṃdhar kar anumānā

verses.sa:
की मैनाक कि खगपति होई ।
मम बल जान सहित पति सोई ॥
verses.tr:
kī maināk ki khagapati hoī
mam bal jān sahit pati soī

verses.sa:
जाना जरठ जटायू एहा ।
मम कर तीरथ छाँड़िहि देहा ॥
verses.tr:
jānā jaraṭh jaṭāyū ehā
mam kar tīrath chām̐r̤ihi dehā

verses.sa:
सुनत गीध क्रोधातुर धावा ।
कह सुनु रावन मोर सिखावा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat gīdh krodhātur dhāvā
kah sunu rāvan mor sikhāvā

verses.sa:
तजि जानकिहि कुसल गृह जाहू ।
नाहिं त अस होइहि बहुबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
taji jānakihi kusal gṛh jāhū
nāhiṃ ta as hoihi bahubāhū

verses.sa:
राम रोष पावक अति घोरा ।
होइहि सकल सलभ कुल तोरा ॥
verses.tr:
rām roṣ pāvak ati ghorā
hoihi sakal salabh kul torā

verses.sa:
उतरु न देत दसानन जोधा ।
तबहिं गीध धावा करि क्रोधा ॥
verses.tr:
utaru na det dasānan jodhā
tabahiṃ gīdh dhāvā kari krodhā

verses.sa:
धरि कच बिरथ कीन्ह महि गिरा ।
सीतहि राखि गीध पुनि फिरा ॥
verses.tr:
dhari kac birath kīnh mahi girā
sītahi rākhi gīdh puni phirā

verses.sa:
चौचन्ह मारि बिदारेसि देही ।
दंड एक भइ मुरुछा तेही ॥
verses.tr:
caucanh māri bidāresi dehī
daṃḍ ek bhai muruchā tehī

verses.sa:
तब सक्रोध निसिचर खिसिआना ।
काढ़ेसि परम कराल कृपाना ॥
verses.tr:
tab sakrodh nisicar khisiānā
kār̤hesi param karāl kṛpānā

verses.sa:
काटेसि पंख परा खग धरनी ।
सुमिरि राम करि अदभुत करनी ॥
verses.tr:
kāṭesi paṃkh parā khag dharanī
sumiri rām kari adabhut karanī

verses.sa:
सीतहि जानि चढ़ाइ बहोरी ।
चला उताइल त्रास न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sītahi jāni car̤hāi bahorī
calā utāil trās na thorī

verses.sa:
करति बिलाप जाति नभ सीता ।
ब्याध बिबस जनु मृगी सभीता ॥
verses.tr:
karati bilāp jāti nabh sītā
byādh bibas janu mṛgī sabhītā

verses.sa:
गिरि पर बैठे कपिन्ह निहारी ।
कहि हरि नाम दीन्ह पट डारी ॥
verses.tr:
giri par baiṭhe kapinh nihārī
kahi hari nām dīnh paṭ ḍārī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सीतहि सो लै गयऊ ।
बन असोक महँ राखत भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sītahi so lai gayaū
ban asok maham̐ rākhat bhayaū

verses.sa:
हारि परा खल बहु बिधि भय अरु प्रीति देखाइ ।
तब असोक पादप तर राखिसि जतन कराइ ॥
verses.tr:
hāri parā khal bahu bidhi bhaya aru prīti dekhāi
tab asok pādap tar rākhisi jatan karāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि कपट कुरंग सँग धाइ चले श्रीराम ।
सो छबि सीता राखि उर रटति रहति हरिनाम ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi kapaṭ kuraṃg sam̐g dhāi cale śrīrām
so chabi sītā rākhi ur raṭati rahati harinām

trans: “Ah! gallant Raghurdi, sovereign of the universe, for what fault of mine have you forgotten mercy? Ah reliever of distress, health-giving sanctuary, sun of the lotuses of the Raghu race. Ab Lakshman this is no fault of yours; I have reaped the fruit of the temper I showed.” Manifold were the lamentations that she uttered. “My affectionate and loving lord is far away; who will tell him of my calamity; that an ass is devouring the oblation intended for the gods!” At the sound of Sita’s woeful lament every created being, whether animate or inanimate, was made sad. The vulture-king, too, heard her piteous cry and recognized the wife of the glory of Raghu’s line, whom the vile demon was carrying away, as it were the famous dun cow that had fallen into the hands of some savage. “Fear not, Sita my daughter, I will annihilate this monster.” The bird darted forth in its fury, like a thunderbolt launched against a mountain. “Stop you villain, how dare you go on thus and take no heed of me.” Seeing him bearing down upon him like the angel of death, Ravan paused and considered: “Is it mount Maindka or the king of the birds anyhow they both know my might, as also do their lords.” When he pereeived that it was poor old Jateyu, he eried, ‘he shall leave his body at the shrine of my hands.” At this, the. vulture rushed on in a fury, crying: ‘Hearken, Ravan, to my advice; surrender Janaki and go home in peace; if not, despite your many arms, it will turn out thus; Rama’s wrath is like a fierce flame, and your whole house will be consumed in it like a moth.” The warrior demon gave no answer. Then the vulture rushed wildly on and clutched him by the hair and dragged him from his chariot so that he fell to the ground. Again, having sheltered Sita, the vulture turned and with his beak tore and rent his body. For nearly half an hour the demon was in a swoon, then gnashed ‘his teeth with rage and drew his monstrous sword and cut off Jateyu’s wings. The bird fell to the ground, calling upon Rama, and doing marvellous feats of courage. Then Ravan again seated Sitain the chariot and drove off in haste in no little alarm. Sita was borne through the air lamenting, like a frightened fawn in the power of a huntsman, Seeing the monkeys sitting on the rocks, she cried out Hari’s name and dropt her scarf. In this manner he went off with Sita and put her down in the Asoka forest.

_ Though he tried every kind of threat and blandishment, the monster could not succeed, and at last after exhausting all his devices he left her under the Asoka tree. With Rama's beauteous form impressed upon her heart, as he appeared when pursuing the mimic deer. Sita was incessantly invoking his name, “‘O Hari, Hari!”

sections.label: Doha 30
sections.name: कर सरोज सिर परसेउ कृपासिंधु रधुबीर

verses.sa:
रघुपति अनुजहि आवत देखी ।
बाहिज चिंता कीन्हि बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati anujahi āvat dekhī
bāhij ciṃtā kīnhi biseṣī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जनकसुता परिहरिहु अकेली ।
आयहु तात बचन मम पेली ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā pariharihu akelī
āyahu tāt bacan mam pelī

verses.sa:
निसिचर निकर फिरहिं बन माहीं ।
मम मन सीता आश्रम नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar nikar phirahiṃ ban māhīṃ
mam man sītā āśram nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
गहि पद कमल अनुज कर जोरी ।
कहेउ नाथ कछु मोहि न खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
gahi pad kamal anuj kar jorī
kaheu nāth kachu mohi na khorī

verses.sa:
अनुज समेत गए प्रभु तहवाँ ।
गोदावरि तट आश्रम जहवाँ ॥
verses.tr:
anuj samet gae prabhu tahavām̐
godāvari taṭ āśram jahavām̐

verses.sa:
आश्रम देखि जानकी हीना ।
भए बिकल जस प्राकृत दीना ॥
verses.tr:
āśram dekhi jānakī hīnā
bhae bikal jas prākṛt dīnā

verses.sa:
हा गुन खानि जानकी सीता ।
रूप सील ब्रत नेम पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
hā gun khāni jānakī sītā
rūp sīl brat nem punītā

verses.sa:
लछिमन समुझाए बहु भाँती ।
पूछत चले लता तरु पाँती ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman samujhāe bahu bhām̐tī
pūchat cale latā taru pām̐tī

verses.sa:
हे खग मृग हे मधुकर श्रेनी ।
तुम्ह देखी सीता मृगनैनी ॥
verses.tr:
he khag mṛg he madhukar śrenī
tumh dekhī sītā mṛganainī

verses.sa:
खंजन सुक कपोत मृग मीना ।
मधुप निकर कोकिला प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
khaṃjan suk kapot mṛg mīnā
madhup nikar kokilā prabīnā

verses.sa:
कुंद कली दाड़िम दामिनी ।
कमल सरद ससि अहिभामिनी ॥
verses.tr:
kuṃd kalī dār̤im dāminī
kamal sarad sasi ahibhāminī

verses.sa:
बरुन पास मनोज धनु हंसा ।
गज केहरि निज सुनत प्रसंसा ॥
verses.tr:
barun pās manoj dhanu haṃsā
gaj kehari nij sunat prasaṃsā

verses.sa:
श्रीफल कनक कदलि हरषाहीं ।
नेकु न संक सकुच मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
śrīphal kanak kadali haraṣāhīṃ
neku na saṃk sakuc man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनु जानकी तोहि बिनु आजू ।
हरषे सकल पाइ जनु राजू ॥
verses.tr:
sunu jānakī tohi binu ājū
haraṣe sakal pāi janu rājū

verses.sa:
किमि सहि जात अनख तोहि पाहीं ।
प्रिया बेगि प्रगटसि कस नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kimi sahi jāt anakh tohi pāhīṃ
priyā begi pragaṭasi kas nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि खौजत बिलपत स्वामी ।
मनहुँ महा बिरही अति कामी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi khaujat bilapat svāmī
manahum̐ mahā birahī ati kāmī

verses.sa:
पूरनकाम राम सुख रासी ।
मनुज चरित कर अज अबिनासी ॥
verses.tr:
pūranakām rām sukh rāsī
manuj carit kar aj abināsī

verses.sa:
आगे परा गीधपति देखा ।
सुमिरत राम चरन जिन्ह रेखा ॥
verses.tr:
āge parā gīdhapati dekhā
sumirat rām caran jinh rekhā

verses.sa: कर सरोज सिर परसेउ कृपासिंधु रधुबीर ॥
verses.tr: kar saroj sir paraseu kṛpāsiṃdhu radhubīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: निरखि राम छबि धाम मुख बिगत भई सब पीर ॥
verses.tr: nirakhi rām chabi dhām mukh bigat bhaī sab pīr

trans: . _ Chaupdi. Wheo Raghupati saw his brother coming, he was seized with a new and greater fear: “O brother, have you left Sita
there, so has he come to me to die by my hand.

alone and come here against my order, though so many demons roam the forest? My mind misgives me that Sita is not at the hermitage.” Lakshman clasped his lotus feet and cried with folded hand: ‘Hearken, my lord, it is no fault of mine.” When he found the hermitage bereft of Sita, he was as agitated as any common man. “Alas Janaki, my precious Sita, so beautifal and amiable, so divinely pious and devoted” [akshman did all’he could to comfort him. As he went along, he questioned all) the trees and flowers by the way: ‘“O ye birds and deer, O ye swarms of bees, have you seen the fawn-eyed Sita P The wagtails, parrots, and pigeons; the deer and fish; swarming bees and clever cuackoos: the jasmine and pomegranate flowers; the lightning, the lotus, the autumn moon; the gliding serpent: the meshes of Varuna, bow of Kamadeva; the swan, the elephant and the lion can now hear themselves praised; the cocoanut, the champa, and the plantain can now rejoice, without any doubt or misgiving at heart.!| Hearken, Janaki, now that you are away, they are all as glad as if they had gotten a kingdom. How can I endure this cruelty at your hands; why do you not at once disclose yourself, my beloved?” In this manner the lord searched and lamented, like a fond lover distressed by separation. Rama who has no wish unsatisfied, the perfection of bliss, the uncreated and the everlasting, acted the part of a man. Further on he saw the vulture-king lying, with his thoughts fixed on the prints of Rama’s feet. Dohe 26.
. The compassionate Raghubir laid his lotus hands upon his head. At the sight of Rama’s lovely face all his pain was forgotten,

sections.label: Doha 31
sections.name: सीता हरन तात जनि कहहु पिता सन जाइ

verses.sa:
तब कह गीध बचन धरि धीरा ।
सुनहु राम भंजन भव भीरा ॥
verses.tr:
tab kah gīdh bacan dhari dhīrā
sunahu rām bhaṃjan bhav bhīrā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ दसानन यह गति कीन्ही ।
तेहि खल जनकसुता हरि लीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
nāth dasānan yah gati kīnhī
tehi khal janakasutā hari līnhī

verses.sa:
लै दच्छिन दिसि गयउ गोसाई ।
बिलपति अति कुररी की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
lai dacchin disi gayau gosāī
bilapati ati kurarī kī nāī

verses.sa:
दरस लागी प्रभु राखेंउँ प्राना ।
चलन चहत अब कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
daras lāgī prabhu rākheṃum̐ prānā
calan cahat ab kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
राम कहा तनु राखहु ताता ।
मुख मुसकाइ कही तेहिं बाता ॥
verses.tr:
rām kahā tanu rākhahu tātā
mukh musakāi kahī tehiṃ bātā

verses.sa:
जा कर नाम मरत मुख आवा ।
अधमउ मुकुत होई श्रुति गावा ॥
verses.tr:
jā kar nām marat mukh āvā
adhamau mukut hoī śruti gāvā

verses.sa:
सो मम लोचन गोचर आगें ।
राखौं देह नाथ केहि खाँगें ॥
verses.tr:
so mam locan gocar āgeṃ
rākhauṃ deh nāth kehi khām̐geṃ

verses.sa:
जल भरि नयन कहहिं रघुराई ।
तात कर्म निज ते गतिं पाई ॥
verses.tr:
jal bhari nayan kahahiṃ raghurāī
tāt karm nij te gatiṃ pāī

verses.sa:
परहित बस जिन्ह के मन माहीं ।
तिन्ह कहुँ जग दुर्लभ कछु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
parahit bas jinh ke man māhīṃ
tinh kahum̐ jag durlabh kachu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तनु तजि तात जाहु मम धामा ।
देउँ काह तुम्ह पूरनकामा ॥
verses.tr:
tanu taji tāt jāhu mam dhāmā
deum̐ kāh tumh pūranakāmā

verses.sa: सीता हरन तात जनि कहहु पिता सन जाइ ॥
verses.tr: sītā haran tāt jani kahahu pitā san jāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: जौं मैं राम त कुल सहित कहिहि दसानन आइ ॥
verses.tr: jauṃ maiṃ rām ta kul sahit kahihi dasānan āi

trans: And the vulture recovered himself and spoke as follows: ‘“‘ Hearken Rama, remover of life’s troubles. My lord, this is Ravan’s doing; he is the wretch, who has carried off Janak’s daughter. He took her away, sire, to the south, crying as piteously as an osprey. I have kept alive, my lord, only to see you; now, O most merciful, [ would depart.” Said Rama: ‘Remain alive, father.” He smiled and answered: ‘He, by the repetition of whose name at the hour of death the vilest sinner, as the scriptures declare, attains salvation, has come in bodily form before my eyes; what need is there, sire, for me to live any longer?” Raghurdi’s eyes filled with tears as he replied: “Father, itis your own good, deeds that have saved you. There is nothing in the world beyond the reach of those who devote their soul to the good of others. When you pass out of the body, father, ascend to my sphere in heaven. What more can I give you? your every wish is gratified.” Dropping the form of a vulture, he appeared in all the beauty of Hari, bedecked with jewels and in gorgeous yellow attire, with dark-hued body and four mighty arms, and with his ‘eyes full of tears he chanted that hymn of praise:

sections.label: Doha 32
sections.name: अबिरल भगति मागि बर गीध गयउ हरिधाम

verses.sa:
गीध देह तजि धरि हरि रुपा ।
भूषन बहु पट पीत अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
gīdh deh taji dhari hari rupā
bhūṣan bahu paṭ pīt anūpā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
स्याम गात बिसाल भुज चारी ।
अस्तुति करत नयन भरि बारी ॥
verses.tr:
syām gāt bisāl bhuj cārī
astuti karat nayan bhari bārī

verses.sa:
जय राम रूप अनूप निर्गुन सगुन गुन प्रेरक सही ।
दससीस बाहु प्रचंड खंडन चंड सर मंडन मही ॥
verses.tr:
jaya rām rūp anūp nirgun sagun gun prerak sahī
dasasīs bāhu pracaṃḍ khaṃḍan caṃḍ sar maṃḍan mahī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
पाथोद गात सरोज मुख राजीव आयत लोचनं ।
नित नौमि रामु कृपाल बाहु बिसाल भव भय मोचनं ॥
verses.tr:
pāthod gāt saroj mukh rājīv āyat locanaṃ
nit naumi rāmu kṛpāl bāhu bisāl bhav bhaya mocanaṃ

verses.sa:
बलमप्रमेयमनादिमजमब्यक्तमेकमगोचरं ।
गोबिंद गोपर द्वंद्वहर बिग्यानघन धरनीधरं ॥
verses.tr:
balamaprameyamanādimajamabyaktamekamagocaraṃ
gobiṃd gopar dvaṃdvahar bigyānaghan dharanīdharaṃ

verses.sa:
जे राम मंत्र जपंत संत अनंत जन मन रंजनं ।
नित नौमि राम अकाम प्रिय कामादि खल दल गंजनं ॥
verses.tr:
je rām maṃtr japaṃt saṃt anaṃt jan man raṃjanaṃ
nit naumi rām akām priya kāmādi khal dal gaṃjanaṃ

verses.sa: जेहि श्रुति निरंजन ब्रह्म ब्यापक बिरज अज कहि गावहीं ॥
verses.tr: jehi śruti niraṃjan brahm byāpak biraj aj kahi gāvahīṃ

verses.sa: करि ध्यान ग्यान बिराग जोग अनेक मुनि जेहि पावहीं ॥
verses.tr: kari dhyān gyān birāg jog anek muni jehi pāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
सो प्रगट करुना कंद सोभा बृंद अग जग मोहई ।
मम हृदय पंकज भृंग अंग अनंग बहु छबि सोहई ॥
verses.tr:
so pragaṭ karunā kaṃd sobhā bṛṃd ag jag mohaī
mam hṛdaya paṃkaj bhṛṃg aṃg anaṃg bahu chabi sohaī

verses.sa:
जो अगम सुगम सुभाव निर्मल असम सम सीतल सदा ।
पस्यंति जं जोगी जतन करि करत मन गो बस सदा ॥
verses.tr:
jo agam sugam subhāv nirmal asam sam sītal sadā
pasyaṃti jaṃ jogī jatan kari karat man go bas sadā

verses.sa:
सो राम रमा निवास संतत दास बस त्रिभुवन धनी ।
मम उर बसउ सो समन संसृति जासु कीरति पावनी ॥
verses.tr:
so rām ramā nivās saṃtat dās bas tribhuvan dhanī
mam ur basau so saman saṃsṛti jāsu kīrati pāvanī

verses.sa:
अबिरल भगति मागि बर गीध गयउ हरिधाम ।
तेहि की क्रिया जथोचित निज कर कीन्ही राम ॥
verses.tr:
abiral bhagati māgi bar gīdh gayau haridhām
tehi kī kriyā jathocit nij kar kīnhī rām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Glory to Rama of incomparably beauty; the bodiless, the embodied; the veritable source of every bodily element; who with mighty arrows has broken the might of the arm of the ten-headed demon; the ornament of the earth. With his body dark as a rain-cloud, with his lotus face and his eyes large as the lotus flower, I unceasingly worship Rama the merciful, the mighty-armed, the dispeller of all life’s terrors; of immeasurable strength; without beginning and unborn; the indivisible; the one; beyond the reach of all the senses; the incarnate Govinda; the annihilator of duality; the profound in wisdom; the supporter of the earth; an everlasting delight to the soul of the saints, who _ practise the spell of Rama’s name. I unceasingly worship - Rama, the friend of the unsensual, the destroyer of lust and every other wickedness. He, whom the scriptures hymn under the name of the passionless Brahm, the all-pervading, the supreme spirit, the unbegotten; to whom the saints attain after infinite study and contemplation, penance and abstraction; he the all-merciful, the all-radiant, the unapproachable, has now become manifest for the delight of the world. He who is at once inaccessible and accessible, like and unlike, the essentially pure, the unfailing comforter, whom ascetics behold only when they have laboriously subdued their mind and senses; even Rama, the spouse of Lakshmi, who is ever at the command of his servants, though the lord of the three spheres, may he abide in my heart, the terminator of transmigration, whose praises make pure.”:..
After asking the boon of perfect faith, the vulture departed for Hari’s sphere. Rama with his own hands performed his funeral rites with all due ceremony.

sections.label: Doha 33
sections.name: मन क्रम बचन कपट तजि जो कर भूसुर सेव

verses.sa:
कोमल चित अति दीनदयाला ।
कारन बिनु रघुनाथ कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
komal cit ati dīnadayālā
kāran binu raghunāth kṛpālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गीध अधम खग आमिष भोगी ।
गति दीन्हि जो जाचत जोगी ॥
verses.tr:
gīdh adham khag āmiṣ bhogī
gati dīnhi jo jācat jogī

verses.sa:
सुनहु उमा ते लोग अभागी ।
हरि तजि होहिं बिषय अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu umā te log abhāgī
hari taji hohiṃ biṣaya anurāgī

verses.sa:
पुनि सीतहि खोजत द्वौ भाई ।
चले बिलोकत बन बहुताई ॥
verses.tr:
puni sītahi khojat dvau bhāī
cale bilokat ban bahutāī

verses.sa:
संकुल लता बिटप घन कानन ।
बहु खग मृग तहँ गज पंचानन ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkul latā biṭap ghan kānan
bahu khag mṛg taham̐ gaj paṃcānan

verses.sa:
आवत पंथ कबंध निपाता ।
तेहिं सब कही साप कै बाता ॥
verses.tr:
āvat paṃth kabaṃdh nipātā
tehiṃ sab kahī sāp kai bātā

verses.sa:
दुरबासा मोहि दीन्ही सापा ।
प्रभु पद पेखि मिटा सो पापा ॥
verses.tr:
durabāsā mohi dīnhī sāpā
prabhu pad pekhi miṭā so pāpā

verses.sa:
सुनु गंधर्ब कहउँ मै तोही ।
मोहि न सोहाइ ब्रह्मकुल द्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
sunu gaṃdharb kahaum̐ mai tohī
mohi na sohāi brahmakul drohī

verses.sa:
मन क्रम बचन कपट तजि जो कर भूसुर सेव ।
मोहि समेत बिरंचि सिव बस ताकें सब देव ॥
verses.tr:
man kram bacan kapaṭ taji jo kar bhūsur sev
mohi samet biraṃci siv bas tākeṃ sab dev
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The tender-hearted and compassionate Raghunath, who shows mercy even on the andeserving, bestowed upon a vulture, an unclean flesh-eating bird, such a place in heaven as the greatest ascetics desire. Hearken, Uma; the most miserable of men are they who abandon Hari and become attached to objects of sense.

The two brothers in their search for Sita visited and examined man¥ woods, tangled with creepers, dense with trees, and swarming with birds, deer, elephants and lions. As they went on their way they overthrew Kabandha, who declared the whole history of the curse. ‘Durvdsas cursed, me, but now that I have seen my lord’s feet, my sin has been blotted out.” Hearken, Gandharva; those who trouble Brahmans are displeasing to me. —
They who without guile in thought, word and deed. do service to the gods of earth, subdue unto themselves Brahma, Siva, myself and every other divinity.

sections.label: Doha 34
sections.name: कंद मूल फल सुरस अति दिए राम कहुँ आनि

verses.sa:
सापत ताड़त परुष कहंता ।
बिप्र पूज्य अस गावहिं संता ॥
verses.tr:
sāpat tār̤at paruṣ kahaṃtā
bipr pūjya as gāvahiṃ saṃtā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पूजिअ बिप्र सील गुन हीना ।
सूद्र न गुन गन ग्यान प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
pūjia bipr sīl gun hīnā
sūdr na gun gan gyān prabīnā

verses.sa:
कहि निज धर्म ताहि समुझावा ।
निज पद प्रीति देखि मन भावा ॥
verses.tr:
kahi nij dharm tāhi samujhāvā
nij pad prīti dekhi man bhāvā

verses.sa:
रघुपति चरन कमल सिरु नाई ।
गयउ गगन आपनि गति पाई ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati caran kamal siru nāī
gayau gagan āpani gati pāī

verses.sa:
ताहि देइ गति राम उदारा ।
सबरी कें आश्रम पगु धारा ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi dei gati rām udārā
sabarī keṃ āśram pagu dhārā

verses.sa:
सबरी देखि राम गृहँ आए ।
मुनि के बचन समुझि जियँ भाए ॥
verses.tr:
sabarī dekhi rām gṛham̐ āe
muni ke bacan samujhi jiyam̐ bhāe

verses.sa:
सरसिज लोचन बाहु बिसाला ।
जटा मुकुट सिर उर बनमाला ॥
verses.tr:
sarasij locan bāhu bisālā
jaṭā mukuṭ sir ur banamālā

verses.sa:
स्याम गौर सुंदर दोउ भाई ।
सबरी परी चरन लपटाई ॥
verses.tr:
syām gaur suṃdar dou bhāī
sabarī parī caran lapaṭāī

verses.sa:
प्रेम मगन मुख बचन न आवा ।
पुनि पुनि पद सरोज सिर नावा ॥
verses.tr:
prem magan mukh bacan na āvā
puni puni pad saroj sir nāvā

verses.sa:
सादर जल लै चरन पखारे ।
पुनि सुंदर आसन बैठारे ॥
verses.tr:
sādar jal lai caran pakhāre
puni suṃdar āsan baiṭhāre

verses.sa:
कंद मूल फल सुरस अति दिए राम कहुँ आनि ।
प्रेम सहित प्रभु खाए बारंबार बखानि ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃd mūl phal suras ati die rām kahum̐ āni
prem sahit prabhu khāe bāraṃbār bakhāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: A Brahman, though he ourse, beat and abuse you, is still an object of reverence; so declare the saints. A Brahman must be honoured, though devoid of every virtue and merit; but a Stdra never, though distinguished for all virtue and learning.” So saying, he instructed him in his doctrine and was pleased to see his devotion to his feet. When the beneficent [Rama had given him beatitude, he passed on to the hermitage of Savari.!| When ‘she saw that Rama had come to her abode, she remembered the saint's promise and was glad of heart. With lotus eyes, mighty arms, hair fastened op io a knot on their head, anda garland of wild flowers upon their breast, one dark of hue, the other fair, stood the two brothers. Savari fell and embraced their feet. She was so drowned in love that no speech came to her lips, but again and again she bowed her head at their lotus feet, then reverently brought water and laved their feet and finally conducted them to a seat of honour. Dohe 29.
Then she brought and presented to Rama the most delicious fruits and herbs and roots, and the lord graciously ate of them, again and again thinkiog her.

sections.label: Doha 35
sections.name: गुर पद पंकज सेवा तीसरि भगति अमान

verses.sa:
पानि जोरि आगें भइ ठाढ़ी ।
प्रभुहि बिलोकि प्रीति अति बाढ़ी ॥
verses.tr:
pāni jori āgeṃ bhai ṭhār̤hī
prabhuhi biloki prīti ati bār̤hī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
केहि बिधि अस्तुति करौ तुम्हारी ।
अधम जाति मैं जड़मति भारी ॥
verses.tr:
kehi bidhi astuti karau tumhārī
adham jāti maiṃ jar̤amati bhārī

verses.sa:
अधम ते अधम अधम अति नारी ।
तिन्ह महँ मैं मतिमंद अघारी ॥
verses.tr:
adham te adham adham ati nārī
tinh maham̐ maiṃ matimaṃd aghārī

verses.sa:
कह रघुपति सुनु भामिनि बाता ।
मानउँ एक भगति कर नाता ॥
verses.tr:
kah raghupati sunu bhāmini bātā
mānaum̐ ek bhagati kar nātā

verses.sa:
जाति पाँति कुल धर्म बड़ाई ।
धन बल परिजन गुन चतुराई ॥
verses.tr:
jāti pām̐ti kul dharm bar̤āī
dhan bal parijan gun caturāī

verses.sa:
भगति हीन नर सोहइ कैसा ।
बिनु जल बारिद देखिअ जैसा ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati hīn nar sohai kaisā
binu jal bārid dekhia jaisā

verses.sa:
नवधा भगति कहउँ तोहि पाहीं ।
सावधान सुनु धरु मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
navadhā bhagati kahaum̐ tohi pāhīṃ
sāvadhān sunu dharu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रथम भगति संतन्ह कर संगा ।
दूसरि रति मम कथा प्रसंगा ॥
verses.tr:
pratham bhagati saṃtanh kar saṃgā
dūsari rati mam kathā prasaṃgā

verses.sa:
गुर पद पंकज सेवा तीसरि भगति अमान ।
चौथि भगति मम गुन गन करइ कपट तजि गान ॥
verses.tr:
gur pad paṃkaj sevā tīsari bhagati amān
cauthi bhagati mam gun gan karai kapaṭ taji gān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: She stood before him with folded hands and as she gazed upon the Lord her love waxed yet more vehement. “How can I hymn thy praises, seeing that { am of meanest descent and of dullest wit: the lowest of the low and a woman vo boot; nay among the lowest of woman the one who is of all most ignorant, O sinless god.” Said Raghupati: ‘Hearken, lady, to my words: I recognize no kinsman-ship save that of faith; neither lineage, family, religion rank, wealth, power, connections, virtue, nor ability. A man without faith is of no more account than a cloud without water. I will explain to you the nine kinds of faith; hearken attentively and lay them up in your mind The first step in faith is communion with the saints; the second a love for the legends relating to me;
feet of the guru; the fourth, singing my praises with a guileless purpose.
The fifth, as the Vedas have expounded, prayer and the repetition, with an assured confidence, of mystic spells:

sections.label: Doha 36
sections.name: जाति हीन अघ जन्म महि मुक्त कीन्हि असि नारि

verses.sa:
मंत्र जाप मम दृढ़ बिस्वासा ।
पंचम भजन सो बेद प्रकासा ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtr jāp mam dṛr̤h bisvāsā
paṃcam bhajan so bed prakāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
छठ दम सील बिरति बहु करमा ।
निरत निरंतर सज्जन धरमा ॥
verses.tr:
chaṭh dam sīl birati bahu karamā
nirat niraṃtar sajjan dharamā

verses.sa:
सातवँ सम मोहि मय जग देखा ।
मोतें संत अधिक करि लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
sātavam̐ sam mohi maya jag dekhā
moteṃ saṃt adhik kari lekhā

verses.sa:
आठवँ जथालाभ संतोषा ।
सपनेहुँ नहिं देखइ परदोषा ॥
verses.tr:
āṭhavam̐ jathālābh saṃtoṣā
sapanehum̐ nahiṃ dekhai paradoṣā

verses.sa:
नवम सरल सब सन छलहीना ।
मम भरोस हियँ हरष न दीना ॥
verses.tr:
navam saral sab san chalahīnā
mam bharos hiyam̐ haraṣ na dīnā

verses.sa:
नव महुँ एकउ जिन्ह के होई ।
नारि पुरुष सचराचर कोई ॥
verses.tr:
nav mahum̐ ekau jinh ke hoī
nāri puruṣ sacarācar koī

verses.sa:
सोइ अतिसय प्रिय भामिनि मोरे ।
सकल प्रकार भगति दृढ़ तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
soi atisaya priya bhāmini more
sakal prakār bhagati dṛr̤h toreṃ

verses.sa:
जोगि बृंद दुरलभ गति जोई ।
तो कहुँ आजु सुलभ भइ सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jogi bṛṃd duralabh gati joī
to kahum̐ āju sulabh bhai soī

verses.sa:
मम दरसन फल परम अनूपा ।
जीव पाव निज सहज सरूपा ॥
verses.tr:
mam darasan phal param anūpā
jīv pāv nij sahaj sarūpā

verses.sa:
जनकसुता कइ सुधि भामिनी ।
जानहि कहु करिबरगामिनी ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā kai sudhi bhāminī
jānahi kahu karibaragāminī

verses.sa:
पंपा सरहि जाहु रघुराई ।
तहँ होइहि सुग्रीव मिताई ॥
verses.tr:
paṃpā sarahi jāhu raghurāī
taham̐ hoihi sugrīv mitāī

verses.sa:
सो सब कहिहि देव रघुबीरा ।
जानतहूँ पूछहु मतिधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
so sab kahihi dev raghubīrā
jānatahūm̐ pūchahu matidhīrā

verses.sa:
बार बार प्रभु पद सिरु नाई ।
प्रेम सहित सब कथा सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār prabhu pad siru nāī
prem sahit sab kathā sunāī

verses.sa:
कहि कथा सकल बिलोकि हरि मुख हृदयँ पद पंकज धरे ।
तजि जोग पावक देह हरि पद लीन भइ जहँ नहिं फिरे ॥
verses.tr:
kahi kathā sakal biloki hari mukh hṛdayam̐ pad paṃkaj dhare
taji jog pāvak deh hari pad līn bhai jaham̐ nahiṃ phire
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
नर बिबिध कर्म अधर्म बहु मत सोकप्रद सब त्यागहू ।
बिस्वास करि कह दास तुलसी राम पद अनुरागहू ॥
verses.tr:
nar bibidh karm adharm bahu mat sokaprad sab tyāgahū
bisvās kari kah dās tulasī rām pad anurāgahū

verses.sa:
जाति हीन अघ जन्म महि मुक्त कीन्हि असि नारि ।
महामंद मन सुख चहसि ऐसे प्रभुहि बिसारि ॥
verses.tr:
jāti hīn agh janm mahi mukt kīnhi asi nāri
mahāmaṃd man sukh cahasi aise prabhuhi bisāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: the sixth, selfgovernance, kindness, detachment from the world and in every action a loving and _ persevering piety; the seventh, seeing the whole world full of me, and holding the saints in yet greater account than myself; the eighth, contentment with what one has, without ever a thought of spying out fault in others; the ninth, a guileless simplicity towards all, and a hearty confidence in me without either exultation or dejection. Verily, lady, whoever possesses any one of these, whether he be man or woman, rational or irrational, is my friend; and you have them all in the highest degree. The heavenly. prize, which the greatest ascetics scarcely. win, is to-day within your easy reach. The result of seeing me is something most marvellous; every creature at once attains its proper consummation. But lady, have you any tidings of JAnaki; tell me, fair dame, all that you know.” “Go Raghurdi, to the lake Pampa; there make friends with Sugriva; he will tell] you all. You know it already my god Raghubir, yet have the patience to ask him.” After again and again bowing her head at the Lord’s feet, she lovingly repeated the whole story.

After repeating the whole story, as she gazed on Hari’s face and imprinted his. lotus feet on her heart, she left her body in the sacrificial fire and became absorbed’in Hari’s feet beyond return. O men, abandon all your religious observances, which are unrighteousness, and your many sects, which yield only sorrow, and with all confidence (says Tulsi Das) lovingly embrace the feet of Rama.
He gave salvation to a woman of such low descent and

sections.label: Doha 37
sections.name: बिरह बिकल बलहीन मोहि जानेसि निपट अकेल

verses.sa:
चले राम त्यागा बन सोऊ ।
अतुलित बल नर केहरि दोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
cale rām tyāgā ban soū
atulit bal nar kehari doū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिरही इव प्रभु करत बिषादा ।
कहत कथा अनेक संबादा ॥
verses.tr:
birahī iv prabhu karat biṣādā
kahat kathā anek saṃbādā

verses.sa:
लछिमन देखु बिपिन कइ सोभा ।
देखत केहि कर मन नहिं छोभा ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman dekhu bipin kai sobhā
dekhat kehi kar man nahiṃ chobhā

verses.sa:
नारि सहित सब खग मृग बृंदा ।
मानहुँ मोरि करत हहिं निंदा ॥
verses.tr:
nāri sahit sab khag mṛg bṛṃdā
mānahum̐ mori karat hahiṃ niṃdā

verses.sa:
हमहि देखि मृग निकर पराहीं ।
मृगीं कहहिं तुम्ह कहँ भय नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
hamahi dekhi mṛg nikar parāhīṃ
mṛgīṃ kahahiṃ tumh kaham̐ bhaya nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्ह आनंद करहु मृग जाए ।
कंचन मृग खोजन ए आए ॥
verses.tr:
tumh ānaṃd karahu mṛg jāe
kaṃcan mṛg khojan e āe

verses.sa:
संग लाइ करिनीं करि लेहीं ।
मानहुँ मोहि सिखावनु देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
saṃg lāi karinīṃ kari lehīṃ
mānahum̐ mohi sikhāvanu dehīṃ

verses.sa:
सास्त्र सुचिंतित पुनि पुनि देखिअ ।
भूप सुसेवित बस नहिं लेखिअ ॥
verses.tr:
sāstr suciṃtit puni puni dekhia
bhūp susevit bas nahiṃ lekhia

verses.sa:
राखिअ नारि जदपि उर माहीं ।
जुबती सास्त्र नृपति बस नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rākhia nāri jadapi ur māhīṃ
jubatī sāstr nṛpati bas nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
देखहु तात बसंत सुहावा ।
प्रिया हीन मोहि भय उपजावा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahu tāt basaṃt suhāvā
priyā hīn mohi bhaya upajāvā

verses.sa:
बिरह बिकल बलहीन मोहि जानेसि निपट अकेल ।
सहित बिपिन मधुकर खग मदन कीन्ह बगमेल ॥
verses.tr:
birah bikal balahīn mohi jānesi nipaṭ akel
sahit bipin madhukar khag madan kīnh bagamel
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
देखि गयउ भ्राता सहित तासु दूत सुनि बात ।
डेरा कीन्हेउ मनहुँ तब कटकु हटकि मनजात ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi gayau bhrātā sahit tāsu dūt suni bāt
ḍerā kīnheu manahum̐ tab kaṭaku haṭaki manajāt

trans: so altogether born in sin as even this Savari was: foolish
indeed are they who desire peace of mind after forgetting such a lord.
' When they had left this wood, they went on their way
Rama and his brother, two lions among men, of immeasur-
able strength. The Lord, like a bereaved lover, kept
making lamentation and turning his discourse to many
topics: “Observe, Lakshman, the beauty of the forest;

whose heart is not moved to see it? The birds and deer, all accompanied by their mates, seem to laugh and jeer at me. When the deer see me and would scamper away, he does cry; ‘Have no fear, enjoy yourselves, for you are genuine deer, and it is only a golden deer that these people have come to look for.’ The female elephants, as they take aside their lords, seem to be giving me this caution; ‘The scriptures, however well studied, must be read over and over again; a king, however well served, is never to be depended upon; and a woman like the scriptures and the king, though you cherish her in your bosom, is never thoroughly mastered.’ See, brother, how beautiful the spring is; yet to me without my beloved it is frightful.

Love, finding me tortured by separation, powerless and absolutely alone, has made a raid upon me with the bees and birds of the forest. His spy has seen me with only my brother, and on his report the amorous god has, as it were, resolutely encamped against me with his army.

sections.label: Doha 38
sections.name: तात तीनि अति प्रबल खल काम क्रोध अरु लोभ

verses.sa:
बिटप बिसाल लता अरुझानी ।
बिबिध बितान दिए जनु तानी ॥
verses.tr:
biṭap bisāl latā arujhānī
bibidh bitān die janu tānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कदलि ताल बर धुजा पताका ।
दैखि न मोह धीर मन जाका ॥
verses.tr:
kadali tāl bar dhujā patākā
daikhi na moh dhīr man jākā

verses.sa:
बिबिध भाँति फूले तरु नाना ।
जनु बानैत बने बहु बाना ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bhām̐ti phūle taru nānā
janu bānait bane bahu bānā

verses.sa:
कहुँ कहुँ सुन्दर बिटप सुहाए ।
जनु भट बिलग बिलग होइ छाए ॥
verses.tr:
kahum̐ kahum̐ sundar biṭap suhāe
janu bhaṭ bilag bilag hoi chāe

verses.sa:
कूजत पिक मानहुँ गज माते ।
ढेक महोख ऊँट बिसराते ॥
verses.tr:
kūjat pik mānahum̐ gaj māte
ḍhek mahokh ūm̐ṭ bisarāte

verses.sa:
मोर चकोर कीर बर बाजी ।
पारावत मराल सब ताजी ॥
verses.tr:
mor cakor kīr bar bājī
pārāvat marāl sab tājī

verses.sa:
तीतिर लावक पदचर जूथा ।
बरनि न जाइ मनोज बरुथा ॥
verses.tr:
tītir lāvak padacar jūthā
barani na jāi manoj baruthā

verses.sa:
रथ गिरि सिला दुंदुभी झरना ।
चातक बंदी गुन गन बरना ॥
verses.tr:
rath giri silā duṃdubhī jharanā
cātak baṃdī gun gan baranā

verses.sa:
मधुकर मुखर भेरि सहनाई ।
त्रिबिध बयारि बसीठीं आई ॥
verses.tr:
madhukar mukhar bheri sahanāī
tribidh bayāri basīṭhīṃ āī

verses.sa:
चतुरंगिनी सेन सँग लीन्हें ।
बिचरत सबहि चुनौती दीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
caturaṃginī sen sam̐g līnheṃ
bicarat sabahi cunautī dīnheṃ

verses.sa:
लछिमन देखत काम अनीका ।
रहहिं धीर तिन्ह कै जग लीका ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman dekhat kām anīkā
rahahiṃ dhīr tinh kai jag līkā

verses.sa:
एहि कें एक परम बल नारी ।
तेहि तें उबर सुभट सोइ भारी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi keṃ ek param bal nārī
tehi teṃ ubar subhaṭ soi bhārī

verses.sa:
तात तीनि अति प्रबल खल काम क्रोध अरु लोभ ।
मुनि बिग्यान धाम मन करहिं निमिष महुँ छोभ ॥
verses.tr:
tāt tīni ati prabal khal kām krodh aru lobh
muni bigyān dhām man karahiṃ nimiṣ mahum̐ chobh
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
लोभ कें इच्छा दंभ बल काम कें केवल नारि ।
क्रोध के परुष बचन बल मुनिबर कहहिं बिचारि ॥
verses.tr:
lobh keṃ icchā daṃbh bal kām keṃ keval nāri
krodh ke paruṣ bacan bal munibar kahahiṃ bicāri

trans: The huge trees and tangled creepers are as it were the diverse pavilions that he has spread; the plantains and stately palms his pennons and standards, that none but the stoutest could see without amazement; the many kinds of different flowering shrubs are his warriors, arrayed in all their various kinds of panoply; the magnificent forest-trees, that stand here and there, are the separate encampments of warrior chiefs; the murmuring cuckoos are his infuriated elephants, and the herons his bulls, camels and mules; the peacocks, chakors and parrots are his war horses; the pigeons and swans his Arab steeds; the partridges and quails his foot soldiers; but there is no describing the whole of Love’s host. The mountains and rocks are his chariots, the waterfalls his kettle-drums, the chdtaks the bards that sing his praises, the garrulous bees are his trumpets and clarions, and the three kinds of wind his scouts. With an army complete in all itsYour branches, he goes about and exhorts every one. QO Lakshman, they who can see Love's battle-array and stand firm, they are men of mark in the world. His greatest strength lies in woman; any one who can escape her is a mighty champion indeed.

Brother, there are three evils of surpassing strength, love, anger, and greed: in an instant they upset the souls of the wisest philosopher. The weapons of greed are desire and pride; of love, nothing but woman; while anger’s weapon is harsh speech; so thoughtful sages have declared.”

sections.label: Doha 39
sections.name: पुरइनि सबन ओट जल बेगि न पाइअ मर्म

verses.sa:
गुनातीत सचराचर स्वामी ।
राम उमा सब अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
gunātīt sacarācar svāmī
rām umā sab aṃtarajāmī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कामिन्ह कै दीनता देखाई ।
धीरन्ह कें मन बिरति दृढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
kāminh kai dīnatā dekhāī
dhīranh keṃ man birati dṛr̤hāī

verses.sa:
क्रोध मनोज लोभ मद माया ।
छूटहिं सकल राम कीं दाया ॥
verses.tr:
krodh manoj lobh mad māyā
chūṭahiṃ sakal rām kīṃ dāyā

verses.sa:
सो नर इंद्रजाल नहिं भूला ।
जा पर होइ सो नट अनुकूला ॥
verses.tr:
so nar iṃdrajāl nahiṃ bhūlā
jā par hoi so naṭ anukūlā

verses.sa:
उमा कहउँ मैं अनुभव अपना ।
सत हरि भजनु जगत सब सपना ॥
verses.tr:
umā kahaum̐ maiṃ anubhav apanā
sat hari bhajanu jagat sab sapanā

verses.sa:
पुनि प्रभु गए सरोबर तीरा ।
पंपा नाम सुभग गंभीरा ॥
verses.tr:
puni prabhu gae sarobar tīrā
paṃpā nām subhag gaṃbhīrā

verses.sa:
संत हृदय जस निर्मल बारी ।
बाँधे घाट मनोहर चारी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt hṛdaya jas nirmal bārī
bām̐dhe ghāṭ manohar cārī

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ पिअहिं बिबिध मृग नीरा ।
जनु उदार गृह जाचक भीरा ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ piahiṃ bibidh mṛg nīrā
janu udār gṛh jācak bhīrā

verses.sa:
पुरइनि सबन ओट जल बेगि न पाइअ मर्म ।
मायाछन्न न देखिऐ जैसे निर्गुन ब्रह्म ॥
verses.tr:
puraini saban oṭ jal begi na pāia marm
māyāchann na dekhiai jaise nirgun brahm
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सुखि मीन सब एकरस अति अगाध जल माहिं ।
जथा धर्मसीलन्ह के दिन सुख संजुत जाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
sukhi mīn sab ekaras ati agādh jal māhiṃ
jathā dharmasīlanh ke din sukh saṃjut jāhiṃ

trans: O Uma Rama is without attributes, the lord of all animate and inanimate creation, and knows all secrets; yet he exhibited all the distress of a lover no less than the detachment and steadfastness of a philosopher. Anger, love, greed, pride, delusion, all are dissipated by the grace of Rama, and the only man superior to all this jugglery is he to whom the great conjuror has shown favour. [ tell you, Uma, what is my conclusion; the worship of Hari is real and all the world is 4 dream.

The Lord went on from there to the shore of the deep and beautiful lake called Pampa; its water as clear as the soul of the saints; with charming flights of steps on each of its four sides; where beasts of different kinds came as they listed, to drink of the flood, like crowds of beggars at a good man’s gate.

Under its cover of dense leaves the water was as difficult to distinguish as is the unembodied supreme spirit under the veil of delusive phenomena. The happy fish were all in placid repose at the bottom of the deep pool, like the days of the righteous that are passed in peace.

sections.label: Doha 40
sections.name: फल भारन नमि बिटप सब रहे भूमि निअराइ

verses.sa:
बिकसे सरसिज नाना रंगा ।
मधुर मुखर गुंजत बहु भृंगा ॥
verses.tr:
bikase sarasij nānā raṃgā
madhur mukhar guṃjat bahu bhṛṃgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बोलत जलकुक्कुट कलहंसा ।
प्रभु बिलोकि जनु करत प्रसंसा ॥
verses.tr:
bolat jalakukkuṭ kalahaṃsā
prabhu biloki janu karat prasaṃsā

verses.sa:
चक्रवाक बक खग समुदाई ।
देखत बनइ बरनि नहिं जाई ॥
verses.tr:
cakravāk bak khag samudāī
dekhat banai barani nahiṃ jāī

verses.sa:
सुन्दर खग गन गिरा सुहाई ।
जात पथिक जनु लेत बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
sundar khag gan girā suhāī
jāt pathik janu let bolāī

verses.sa:
ताल समीप मुनिन्ह गृह छाए ।
चहु दिसि कानन बिटप सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
tāl samīp muninh gṛh chāe
cahu disi kānan biṭap suhāe

verses.sa:
चंपक बकुल कदंब तमाला ।
पाटल पनस परास रसाला ॥
verses.tr:
caṃpak bakul kadaṃb tamālā
pāṭal panas parās rasālā

verses.sa:
नव पल्लव कुसुमित तरु नाना ।
चंचरीक पटली कर गाना ॥
verses.tr:
nav pallav kusumit taru nānā
caṃcarīk paṭalī kar gānā

verses.sa:
सीतल मंद सुगंध सुभाऊ ।
संतत बहइ मनोहर बाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sītal maṃd sugaṃdh subhāū
saṃtat bahai manohar bāū

verses.sa:
कुहू कुहू कोकिल धुनि करहीं ।
सुनि रव सरस ध्यान मुनि टरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kuhū kuhū kokil dhuni karahīṃ
suni rav saras dhyān muni ṭarahīṃ

verses.sa:
फल भारन नमि बिटप सब रहे भूमि निअराइ ।
पर उपकारी पुरुष जिमि नवहिं सुसंपति पाइ ॥
verses.tr:
phal bhāran nami biṭap sab rahe bhūmi niarāi
par upakārī puruṣ jimi navahiṃ susaṃpati pāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Lotuses of many colours displayed their flowers; there was o buzzing of garrulous bees, both honey-makers and humble-bees; while swans and waterfowls were so noisy you would think they had recognized the Lord and were telling his praises. The geese and cranes and other birds were so numerous that only seeing would be believing, no words could describe them. The delighted voice of so many beautiful birds seemed as an invitation to the wayfarers. The saints had built themselves a house near the lake with magnificent forest-trees all round, the champa, the mdlsari, the kadamb and tamdla, the pdtala, the kathal the dhdk
