and the mango. Every tree had put forth its new leaves and flowers was and resonant with swarms of bees. A delightful air, soft, cool and fragrant, was ever in delicious motion, and the cooing of the cuckoos was pleasant to hear that a saint’s meditation would be broken by it.
The trees laden with fruit bowed low to the ground; like a generous soul whom every increase of fortune renders only more humble than before.

sections.label: Doha 41
sections.name: नाना बिधि बिनती करि प्रभु प्रसन्न जियँ जानि

verses.sa:
देखि राम अति रुचिर तलावा ।
मज्जनु कीन्ह परम सुख पावा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām ati rucir talāvā
majjanu kīnh param sukh pāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखी सुंदर तरुबर छाया ।
बैठे अनुज सहित रघुराया ॥
verses.tr:
dekhī suṃdar tarubar chāyā
baiṭhe anuj sahit raghurāyā

verses.sa:
तहँ पुनि सकल देव मुनि आए ।
अस्तुति करि निज धाम सिधाए ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ puni sakal dev muni āe
astuti kari nij dhām sidhāe

verses.sa:
बैठे परम प्रसन्न कृपाला ।
कहत अनुज सन कथा रसाला ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhe param prasann kṛpālā
kahat anuj san kathā rasālā

verses.sa:
बिरहवंत भगवंतहि देखी ।
नारद मन भा सोच बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
birahavaṃt bhagavaṃtahi dekhī
nārad man bhā soc biseṣī

verses.sa:
मोर साप करि अंगीकारा ।
सहत राम नाना दुख भारा ॥
verses.tr:
mor sāp kari aṃgīkārā
sahat rām nānā dukh bhārā

verses.sa:
ऐसे प्रभुहि बिलोकउँ जाई ।
पुनि न बनिहि अस अवसरु आई ॥
verses.tr:
aise prabhuhi bilokaum̐ jāī
puni na banihi as avasaru āī

verses.sa:
यह बिचारि नारद कर बीना ।
गए जहाँ प्रभु सुख आसीना ॥
verses.tr:
yah bicāri nārad kar bīnā
gae jahām̐ prabhu sukh āsīnā

verses.sa:
गावत राम चरित मृदु बानी ।
प्रेम सहित बहु भाँति बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
gāvat rām carit mṛdu bānī
prem sahit bahu bhām̐ti bakhānī

verses.sa:
करत दंडवत लिए उठाई ।
राखे बहुत बार उर लाई ॥
verses.tr:
karat daṃḍavat lie uṭhāī
rākhe bahut bār ur lāī

verses.sa:
स्वागत पूँछि निकट बैठारे ।
लछिमन सादर चरन पखारे ॥
verses.tr:
svāgat pūm̐chi nikaṭ baiṭhāre
lachiman sādar caran pakhāre

verses.sa:
नाना बिधि बिनती करि प्रभु प्रसन्न जियँ जानि ।
नारद बोले बचन तब जोरि सरोरुह पानि ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bidhi binatī kari prabhu prasann jiyam̐ jāni
nārad bole bacan tab jori saroruh pāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Rama saw tkis most beautiful lake, he bathed in it with great delight, and then with his brother sat down in the shade of the magnificent trees. There all the gods and saints came once more to hymn his praises and then returned each to hisown home. The All-merciful rested in supreme content and addressed his brother in edifying discourse. When Narad saw the Lord God thus sorrowing for the loss of his beloved, his soul was much disturbed. ‘Tn submission to my curse Rama endures all this weight of woe. I must go and visit so noble a lord, for I may never have such an opportunity again.” Having thus reflected, Narad with his lute in his hand,® approached the spot where the Lord was sitting at ease. In duicet tones he sang his acts, affectionately dwelling upon them in all dotail. Ashe prostrated himself, Rama took and lifted him up, and again and again clasped him to his bosom and

asked him of his welfare and seated him by his side. Then Lakshman reverently laved his feet.
Perceiving that his lord was well pleased, Narad made much supplication and clasping his lotus hands addressed him in these words:

sections.label: Doha 42
sections.name: राका रजनी भगति तव राम नाम सोइ सोम

verses.sa:
सुनहु उदार सहज रघुनायक ।
सुंदर अगम सुगम बर दायक ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu udār sahaj raghunāyak
suṃdar agam sugam bar dāyak
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देहु एक बर मागउँ स्वामी ।
जद्यपि जानत अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
dehu ek bar māgaum̐ svāmī
jadyapi jānat aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
जानहु मुनि तुम्ह मोर सुभाऊ ।
जन सन कबहुँ कि करउँ दुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jānahu muni tumh mor subhāū
jan san kabahum̐ ki karaum̐ durāū

verses.sa:
कवन बस्तु असि प्रिय मोहि लागी ।
जो मुनिबर न सकहु तुम्ह मागी ॥
verses.tr:
kavan bastu asi priya mohi lāgī
jo munibar na sakahu tumh māgī

verses.sa:
जन कहुँ कछु अदेय नहिं मोरें ।
अस बिस्वास तजहु जनि भोरें ॥
verses.tr:
jan kahum̐ kachu adeya nahiṃ moreṃ
as bisvās tajahu jani bhoreṃ

verses.sa:
तब नारद बोले हरषाई ।
अस बर मागउँ करउँ ढिठाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab nārad bole haraṣāī
as bar māgaum̐ karaum̐ ḍhiṭhāī

verses.sa:
जद्यपि प्रभु के नाम अनेका ।
श्रुति कह अधिक एक तें एका ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi prabhu ke nām anekā
śruti kah adhik ek teṃ ekā

verses.sa:
राम सकल नामन्ह ते अधिका ।
होउ नाथ अघ खग गन बधिका ॥
verses.tr:
rām sakal nāmanh te adhikā
hou nāth agh khag gan badhikā

verses.sa:
राका रजनी भगति तव राम नाम सोइ सोम ।
अपर नाम उडगन बिमल बसुहुँ भगत उर ब्योम ॥
verses.tr:
rākā rajanī bhagati tav rām nām soi som
apar nām uḍagan bimal basuhum̐ bhagat ur byom
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
एवमस्तु मुनि सन कहेउ कृपासिंधु रघुनाथ ।
तब नारद मन हरष अति प्रभु पद नायउ माथ ॥
verses.tr:
evamastu muni san kaheu kṛpāsiṃdhu raghunāth
tab nārad man haraṣ ati prabhu pad nāyau māth

trans: ‘Hearken, most generous Raghu-ndyak, beautiful and beneficent, at once unapproachable and easy of approach, grant me, my lord, the one boon that I ask; thoogh you know it without my asking, since you know the secrets of all hearts.” ‘“‘ Reverend father, you understand my character can I ever turn away my face from any one of my worshippers? There is nothing I hold sodeur that you, most excellent of saints, may not ask icof me. There is nothing of mine that I would refuse toa believer; never allow yourself to abandon this confidence in me.” Then Narad was glad and said: “This is the boon that I presameto ask. Though my lord has many names, each more glorious than the other, as declared in the scriptures, may the name Rama, sire, surpass all names, exterminating the whole brood of sin, as when 4 fowler ensnares an entire flock of birds.

May your name Rama be as the moon in the bright night of cloudless faith, and your other names as brilliant stars in the heaven of the believer’s soul.”” Raghunath, the ocean of mercy, said to the saint, ‘so be it,’ Then was Narad’s soul rejoiced exceedingly and he bowed his head at his lord’s feet.

sections.label: Doha 43
sections.name: काम क्रोध लोभादि मद प्रबल मोह कै धारि

verses.sa:
अति प्रसन्न रघुनाथहि जानी ।
पुनि नारद बोले मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
ati prasann raghunāthahi jānī
puni nārad bole mṛdu bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम जबहिं प्रेरेउ निज माया ।
मोहेहु मोहि सुनहु रघुराया ॥
verses.tr:
rām jabahiṃ prereu nij māyā
mohehu mohi sunahu raghurāyā

verses.sa:
तब बिबाह मैं चाहउँ कीन्हा ।
प्रभु केहि कारन करै न दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
tab bibāh maiṃ cāhaum̐ kīnhā
prabhu kehi kāran karai na dīnhā

verses.sa:
सुनु मुनि तोहि कहउँ सहरोसा ।
भजहिं जे मोहि तजि सकल भरोसा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu muni tohi kahaum̐ saharosā
bhajahiṃ je mohi taji sakal bharosā

verses.sa:
करउँ सदा तिन्ह कै रखवारी ।
जिमि बालक राखइ महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
karaum̐ sadā tinh kai rakhavārī
jimi bālak rākhai mahatārī

verses.sa:
गह सिसु बच्छ अनल अहि धाई ।
तहँ राखइ जननी अरगाई ॥
verses.tr:
gah sisu bacch anal ahi dhāī
taham̐ rākhai jananī aragāī

verses.sa:
प्रौढ़ भएँ तेहि सुत पर माता ।
प्रीति करइ नहिं पाछिलि बाता ॥
verses.tr:
praur̤h bhaem̐ tehi sut par mātā
prīti karai nahiṃ pāchili bātā

verses.sa:
मोरे प्रौढ़ तनय सम ग्यानी ।
बालक सुत सम दास अमानी ॥
verses.tr:
more praur̤h tanaya sam gyānī
bālak sut sam dās amānī

verses.sa:
जनहि मोर बल निज बल ताही ।
दुहु कहँ काम क्रोध रिपु आही ॥
verses.tr:
janahi mor bal nij bal tāhī
duhu kaham̐ kām krodh ripu āhī

verses.sa:
यह बिचारि पंडित मोहि भजहीं ।
पाएहुँ ग्यान भगति नहिं तजहीं ॥
verses.tr:
yah bicāri paṃḍit mohi bhajahīṃ
pāehum̐ gyān bhagati nahiṃ tajahīṃ

verses.sa:
काम क्रोध लोभादि मद प्रबल मोह कै धारि ।
तिन्ह महँ अति दारुन दुखद मायारूपी नारि ॥
verses.tr:
kām krodh lobhādi mad prabal moh kai dhāri
tinh maham̐ ati dārun dukhad māyārūpī nāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Seeing Raghunath so gracious, Narad spoke again in winning tones: “O Rama, when you sent forth your delusive power and infatuated me—hearken, O Raghurai— I was anxious to accomplish a marriage, why was it, my lord, that you did not allow me to do?’ ‘Hearken, O saint, and I will tell you, if you will not be angry: If men will abandon all other hope and worship me only, I always keep watch over them as a mother over her infant child. IE an infant child ran to lay hold of the fire or a snake, the mother at once rescues it; when her son has grown up, the mother does not show her affection to him in the same way as before. The wise are, as it were, my grown up sons and humble worshippers my infant children. The latter are protected by my strength, the former by their own, and both have to fight against love and anger. Philosophers know this and worship me, and though they have acquired wisdom, still they do not discard faith.
Lust, anger, greed and all other violent passion form a rushing torrent of deception; but among them all the most formidable and the most calamitous is that incarnation of vanity, woman. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 44
sections.name: अवगुन मूल सूलप्रद प्रमदा सब दुख खानि

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि कह पुरान श्रुति संता ।
मोह बिपिन कहुँ नारि बसंता ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni kah purān śruti saṃtā
moh bipin kahum̐ nāri basaṃtā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जप तप नेम जलाश्रय झारी ।
होइ ग्रीषम सोषइ सब नारी ॥
verses.tr:
jap tap nem jalāśraya jhārī
hoi grīṣam soṣai sab nārī

verses.sa:
काम क्रोध मद मत्सर भेका ।
इन्हहि हरषप्रद बरषा एका ॥
verses.tr:
kām krodh mad matsar bhekā
inhahi haraṣaprad baraṣā ekā

verses.sa:
दुर्बासना कुमुद समुदाई ।
तिन्ह कहँ सरद सदा सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
durbāsanā kumud samudāī
tinh kaham̐ sarad sadā sukhadāī

verses.sa:
धर्म सकल सरसीरुह बृंदा ।
होइ हिम तिन्हहि दहइ सुख मंदा ॥
verses.tr:
dharm sakal sarasīruh bṛṃdā
hoi him tinhahi dahai sukh maṃdā

verses.sa:
पुनि ममता जवास बहुताई ।
पलुहइ नारि सिसिर रितु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
puni mamatā javās bahutāī
paluhai nāri sisir ritu pāī

verses.sa:
पाप उलूक निकर सुखकारी ।
नारि निबिड़ रजनी अँधिआरी ॥
verses.tr:
pāp ulūk nikar sukhakārī
nāri nibir̤ rajanī am̐dhiārī

verses.sa:
बुधि बल सील सत्य सब मीना ।
बनसी सम त्रिय कहहिं प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
budhi bal sīl satya sab mīnā
banasī sam triya kahahiṃ prabīnā

verses.sa:
अवगुन मूल सूलप्रद प्रमदा सब दुख खानि ।
ताते कीन्ह निवारन मुनि मैं यह जियँ जानि ॥
verses.tr:
avagun mūl sūlaprad pramadā sab dukh khāni
tāte kīnh nivāran muni maiṃ yah jiyam̐ jāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearken, O saint, to the teaching of the Puranas, the Vedas and the saints: Woman is like the season of spring to the forest of infatuation; like the heat of summer to dry up the pools and waterfalls of prayer, penance and devotional exercises; like the rains to rejoice the gnats and frogs of lust, anger and pride; like the autumn to revive the lilylike growth of evil propensities; like the winter to distress and deaden all the lotus beds of piety; and lastly, like the dewy season to foster the jawdsa weeds of selfishness. Woman, again, is like a dark and murky night, in which owls and deeds of darkness delight, or like a hook to catch the fish of sense and strength and honour and truth wso say the wise.
Wanton woman is the root of all evil, a source of torment, mine of all unhappiness; therefore, O saint, knowing all this, I prevented your marriage.”

sections.label: Doha 45
sections.name: गुनागार संसार दुख रहित बिगत संदेह

verses.sa:
सुनि रघुपति के बचन सुहाए ।
मुनि तन पुलक नयन भरि आए ॥
verses.tr:
suni raghupati ke bacan suhāe
muni tan pulak nayan bhari āe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहहु कवन प्रभु कै असि रीती ।
सेवक पर ममता अरु प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu kavan prabhu kai asi rītī
sevak par mamatā aru prītī

verses.sa:
जे न भजहिं अस प्रभु भ्रम त्यागी ।
ग्यान रंक नर मंद अभागी ॥
verses.tr:
je na bhajahiṃ as prabhu bhram tyāgī
gyān raṃk nar maṃd abhāgī

verses.sa:
पुनि सादर बोले मुनि नारद ।
सुनहु राम बिग्यान बिसारद ॥
verses.tr:
puni sādar bole muni nārad
sunahu rām bigyān bisārad

verses.sa:
संतन्ह के लच्छन रघुबीरा ।
कहहु नाथ भव भंजन भीरा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃtanh ke lacchan raghubīrā
kahahu nāth bhav bhaṃjan bhīrā

verses.sa:
सुनु मुनि संतन्ह के गुन कहऊँ ।
जिन्ह ते मैं उन्ह कें बस रहऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
sunu muni saṃtanh ke gun kahaūm̐
jinh te maiṃ unh keṃ bas rahaūm̐

verses.sa:
षट बिकार जित अनघ अकामा ।
अचल अकिंचन सुचि सुखधामा ॥
verses.tr:
ṣaṭ bikār jit anagh akāmā
acal akiṃcan suci sukhadhāmā

verses.sa:
अमितबोध अनीह मितभोगी ।
सत्यसार कबि कोबिद जोगी ॥
verses.tr:
amitabodh anīh mitabhogī
satyasār kabi kobid jogī

verses.sa:
सावधान मानद मदहीना ।
धीर धर्म गति परम प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
sāvadhān mānad madahīnā
dhīr dharm gati param prabīnā

verses.sa: गुनागार संसार दुख रहित बिगत संदेह ॥
verses.tr: gunāgār saṃsār dukh rahit bigat saṃdeh
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: तजि मम चरन सरोज प्रिय तिन्ह कहुँ देह न गेह ॥
verses.tr: taji mam caran saroj priya tinh kahum̐ deh na geh

trans: As the saint listened to Raghupati’s delightful discourse, his body quivered with emotion and his eyes filled with tears. “Tell me, is there any other lord, whose wont it is to be so kind and considerate to his servants? All, who will not abandon their errors, nor worship such a lord as this are indeed dali and witless fools.” Nadarad the-sage reverentially enquired farther: ‘Hearken Rama, versed in all

2. Sisira, the dewy season,’ consists of the month that come between the winter and the spring. Ea Se wisdom: tell me, my lord Raghubir, lightener of earth’s burdens, what are the marks of a saint?” Listen, reverend sir, and I will tell you what are the qualities of the saints, by virtue of which they hold meia their power, They have overcome the six disturbing influence; are sinless, passionless, and imperturbable; have no worldly goods, but live a life of chastity and contentedness; their wisdom is immeasurable; they are without desires and temperate in enjoyment; oceans of truth, inspired bards, practised in meditation; circumspect; void of pride and arrogance; persevering and eminently wise in the mystery of salvation;
Mines of virtue, free from the troubles of the world and with all their doubts solved; who, rather than abandon my lotus feet, account neither life nor home precious;

sections.label: Doha 46
sections.name: रावनारि जसु पावन गावहिं सुनहिं जे लोग

verses.sa:
निज गुन श्रवन सुनत सकुचाहीं ।
पर गुन सुनत अधिक हरषाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nij gun śravan sunat sakucāhīṃ
par gun sunat adhik haraṣāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सम सीतल नहिं त्यागहिं नीती ।
सरल सुभाउ सबहि सन प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
sam sītal nahiṃ tyāgahiṃ nītī
saral subhāu sabahi san prītī

verses.sa:
जप तप ब्रत दम संजम नेमा ।
गुरु गोबिंद बिप्र पद प्रेमा ॥
verses.tr:
jap tap brat dam saṃjam nemā
guru gobiṃd bipr pad premā

verses.sa:
श्रद्धा छमा मयत्री दाया ।
मुदिता मम पद प्रीति अमाया ॥
verses.tr:
śraddhā chamā mayatrī dāyā
muditā mam pad prīti amāyā

verses.sa:
बिरति बिबेक बिनय बिग्याना ।
बोध जथारथ बेद पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
birati bibek binaya bigyānā
bodh jathārath bed purānā

verses.sa:
दंभ मान मद करहिं न काऊ ।
भूलि न देहिं कुमारग पाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
daṃbh mān mad karahiṃ na kāū
bhūli na dehiṃ kumārag pāū

verses.sa:
गावहिं सुनहिं सदा मम लीला ।
हेतु रहित परहित रत सीला ॥
verses.tr:
gāvahiṃ sunahiṃ sadā mam līlā
hetu rahit parahit rat sīlā

verses.sa:
मुनि सुनु साधुन्ह के गुन जेते ।
कहि न सकहिं सारद श्रुति तेते ॥
verses.tr:
muni sunu sādhunh ke gun jete
kahi na sakahiṃ sārad śruti tete

verses.sa:
कहि सक न सारद सेष नारद सुनत पद पंकज गहे ।
अस दीनबंधु कृपाल अपने भगत गुन निज मुख कहे ॥
verses.tr:
kahi sak na sārad seṣ nārad sunat pad paṃkaj gahe
as dīnabaṃdhu kṛpāl apane bhagat gun nij mukh kahe
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सिरु नाइ बारहिं बार चरनन्हि ब्रह्मपुर नारद गए ।
ते धन्य तुलसीदास आस बिहाइ जे हरि रँग रँए ॥
verses.tr:
siru nāi bārahiṃ bār carananhi brahmapur nārad gae
te dhanya tulasīdās ās bihāi je hari ram̐g ram̐e

verses.sa:
रावनारि जसु पावन गावहिं सुनहिं जे लोग ।
राम भगति दृढ़ पावहिं बिनु बिराग जप जोग ॥
verses.tr:
rāvanāri jasu pāvan gāvahiṃ sunahiṃ je log
rām bhagati dṛr̤h pāvahiṃ binu birāg jap jog
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
दीप सिखा सम जुबति तन मन जनि होसि पतंग ।
भजहि राम तजि काम मद करहि सदा सतसंग ॥
verses.tr:
dīp sikhā sam jubati tan man jani hosi pataṃg
bhajahi rām taji kām mad karahi sadā satasaṃg

trans: Who. are abashed when they hear themselves praised, and exceedingly glad to hear the praises of others; who are always equable and calm, consistent in virtuous practice; honest and kindly disposed to all men; distinguished for prayer, penance, religious observances, temperance, selfdenial, and performance of pious vows; for devotion to their guru, to Gobinda and to Brahmans; for faith, forbearance, charitableness and compassion; for a rapturous love of my feet; 8 superiority to all material delusions; an absolute composure, discrimination, hemility and knowledge; and for doctrine in strict accordance with the Vedas and Puranas; who never display ostentation, arrogance, or pride, nor ever by any chance set their foot on the way of wickedness; who are always either hearing or singing my acts and have no selfish object, but are devoted to good of others; in short, reverend sir, the characteristics of the saints are so numerous that not even Saerada or the scriptures could tell them all.

Not Sarade nor Sheshnag could tell them.” Hearing this Narad clasped his lotus feet, orying, “Thus the friend of the suppliant, the all-merciful, has with his own mouth declared the characteristics of his worshippers.” After again and again bowing his head at his feet, Narad returned to the city of Brahma. Blessed, says Tulsi Das, are all they who abandon other hope and attach themselves to Hari.

People who hear or recite the sanctifying praises of Ravan's foe, even without asceticism, prayer and meditation, are rewarded with steadfast faith in Rama. Woman is like the fame of a candle; let not your soul be as the moth, but discard love and intoxication, worship Rama “and hold communion with the saints.
